title: 13F amendment-aware effective books: concentration, turnover, overlap, crowding
frame: DIKETAHUI: tabel SEC SUBMISSION/COVERPAGE/SUMMARYPAGE/INFOTABLE (tab), daftar manajer (CIK, order, label) dan periode (order, period_end). DITANYAKAN: buku efektif tiap (manajer, periode) setelah amandemen, lalu konsentrasi, turnover, overlap, crowding. RUMUS: w_i = VALUE_i / sum VALUE; HHI = sum w_i^2; N_eff = 1/HHI; turnover = 1/2 sum_{union} |w_curr - w_prev|; overlap_ij = sum_{common} min(w_i, w_j); crowding per CUSIP: holder_count, total_value, mean/max w. JAWAB: 1) filter 13F-HR/13F-HR/A dengan REPORTTYPE 13F HOLDINGS REPORT, periode submission == cover. 2) per (CIK, periode) urutkan FILING_DATE, AMENDMENTNO, accession; original -> replace_initial, RESTATEMENT -> replace_restatement (ganti seluruh state), NEW HOLDINGS -> append_new_holdings. 3) bersihkan baris berurutan: CUSIP kosong, SSHPRNAMTTYPE != SH, PUTCALL terisi, VALUE/SSHPRNAMT <= 0. 4) agregasi per CUSIP, hitung bobot dan metrik. 5) tulis semua file dan summary.
formulas: weight_i = VALUE_i / sum_j VALUE_j (per manager-period book)
hhi = sum_i weight_i^2 ; effective_num_names = 1 / hhi ; top_weight = max_i weight_i
turnover(prev->curr) = 0.5 * sum_{CUSIP in union} |w_curr - w_prev| (missing = 0)
weighted_overlap(i,j) = sum_{CUSIP in both} min(w_i, w_j) ; common_names_count = |intersection|
summarypage_row_diff = rows_in_filing - TABLEENTRYTOTAL ; summarypage_value_diff = sum VALUE - TABLEVALUETOTAL
avg_holder_weight = mean of holder weights for the CUSIP ; max_holder_weight = max
steps: Read the SEC tables with sep tab, dtype=str, keep_default_na=False; helper CSVs with comma; sort managers by manager_order and periods by period_order

Join SUBMISSION+COVERPAGE (+SUMMARYPAGE left) on ACCESSION_NUMBER; keep SUBMISSIONTYPE in {13F-HR, 13F-HR/A} and REPORTTYPE == 13F HOLDINGS REPORT; parse PERIODOFREPORT and REPORTCALENDARORQUARTER as DD-MON-YYYY and require equality
Match manager by CIK with leading zeros stripped (never derive manager from the accession prefix)

For each (manager, period): sort eligible filings by FILING_DATE, AMENDMENTNO (numeric, blank=0), ACCESSION_NUMBER; walk them keeping a state list of accessions: not amendment -> action replace_initial, state=[acc]; AMENDMENTTYPE NEW HOLDINGS -> append_new_holdings, state += [acc]; otherwise (RESTATEMENT) -> replace_restatement, state=[acc]; one filing_resolution row per applied filing with rows_in_filing, value_total_in_filing and summary-page diffs

raw_effective_rows = INFOTABLE rows whose accession is in the final state; sequential filters counting each rejected row once: blank CUSIP -> SSHPRNAMTTYPE != SH -> PUTCALL non-blank -> VALUE <= 0 or SSHPRNAMT <= 0; write cleaning_audit.csv

Group kept rows by stripped upper-case CUSIP: sum VALUE, SSHPRNAMT, VOTING_AUTH_SOLE/SHARED/NONE; canonical issuer/class = most frequent label (tie -> alphabetical); weight = VALUE / total; write effective_holdings.csv
manager_metrics.csv: num_positions, total_value, top_cusip/top_issuer_name/top_weight (sort weight desc, CUSIP asc), hhi, effective_num_names
turnover.csv for consecutive periods in target order: 0.5*sum|dw| over the union, new/exited/common name counts
overlap_latest.csv for unordered manager pairs (itertools.combinations) in the latest period: sum of min weights over common CUSIPs
crowded_securities_latest.csv: per CUSIP holder_count, total_value, avg/max holder weight, holder_list = labels joined by ';'; sort holder_count desc, total_value desc, CUSIP asc; rank from 1

summary.json: counts, latest_period_end, max turnover manager/value, max overlap pair/value, top crowded CUSIP/holder count, weights_sum_check_passed, summarypage_checks_passed, all_required_files_written, all_checks_passed
conventions: RESTATEMENT amendments replace the whole report literally, even when tiny or marked confidential-treatment expired
NEW HOLDINGS amendments append to the current state; rows from appended filings are summed per CUSIP with the base filing
Aggregation is by CUSIP even when issuer names differ across rows; any representative label is accepted
FILING_DATE written as YYYY-MM-DD; numeric columns as python float/int; summary diffs may be NaN when summary page missing
weights_sum_check: every non-empty book sums to 1 within tolerance
pitfalls: Treating restatements as appends for economic reasons fails the checker
Deriving the manager from the accession-number prefix (filing agent CIK)
Counting a rejected row under more than one filter

title: Cross-sectional momentum z-score, monthly long-short backtest, FF3 residual alpha
frame: DIKETAHUI: return harian N saham, return faktor harian (Mkt_RF, SMB, HML), params (lookback_alpha, trade_start_day, signal_start_day, long_top_n, short_bottom_n, bobot per saham, biaya bps, faktor anualisasi AF). DITANYAKAN: sinyal momentum z-score, backtest long-short bulanan, metrik, regresi faktor residual. RUMUS: sig_t = zscore_xs(mean r_{t-LB..t-1}); cost_t = sum|w_new - w_old| * bps/1e4; s_t = w.r_t - cost_t; ann_ret = mean(s)*AF; ann_vol = std(s,ddof=1)*sqrt(AF); Sharpe = ann_ret/ann_vol; MDD = max(1 - W/peak W); OLS s = a + b.F + e; alpha_ann = a*AF; TE = std(e,ddof=1)*sqrt(AF); IR = alpha_ann/TE; hit = mean(s>0). JAWAB: 1) sort ticker alfabetis, coerce numeric, hitung nan_count, fillna(0). 2) sinyal tiap hari dari LB return sebelum t, z-score lintas saham ddof=1. 3) rebalance pada hari pertama tiap bulan kalender dalam periode trading: top-N +w, bottom-N -w, bebankan biaya turnover. 4) metrik. 5) OLS pada [1, faktor]. 6) tulis results.json dan solution.json.
formulas: signal_t = (mom_t - mean_xs(mom_t)) / std_xs(mom_t, ddof=1), mom_t = mean of returns over the LB days strictly before t
cost_t = sum_i |w_new_i - w_old_i| * tc_bps / 1e4 (only on rebalance days) ; s_t = w_t . r_t - cost_t
ann_ret = mean(s) * AF ; ann_vol = std(s, ddof=1) * sqrt(AF) ; sharpe = ann_ret / ann_vol (rf = 0)
max_drawdown = max(1 - W_t / running_max(W_t)), W = cumprod(1 + s), peak includes 1.0 start
OLS s_t = a + b1 Mkt_RF + b2 SMB + b3 HML + e_t via lstsq ; alpha_ann = a * AF ; tracking_error_annual = std(e, ddof=1) * sqrt(AF)
information_ratio = alpha_ann / tracking_error_annual ; hit_rate = fraction of trading days with s_t > 0
steps: Load returns.csv and factors.csv with parse_dates, sort by date; align factors to the return dates (reindex, fill 0); read params.json and use every value as given
Sort tickers alphabetically, coerce to numeric; nan_count = total NaN in the raw stock matrix; fill NaN with 0
Build the signal matrix for t from signal_start_day: mean of the lookback_alpha rows before t, z-scored across stocks with ddof=1

Loop t from trade_start_day to the end; a rebalance happens when month(date_t) != month(date_{t-1}); rank by signal descending with stable argsort, set long_top_n to +long_weight_per_stock and short_bottom_n to -short_weight_per_stock, charge cost on turnover, count n_rebalances
Daily strategy return = w . r_t - cost_t with the weights in force after that day's rebalance
Compute annualized_return, annualized_volatility, sharpe_ratio, max_drawdown with the formulas
Regress the strategy series on [1, Mkt_RF, SMB, HML] over the trading period; annualized_alpha, market/smb/hml beta residual, tracking_error_annual, information_ratio, hit_rate

Write results.json (annualized_return, annualized_volatility, sharpe_ratio, max_drawdown, annualized_alpha, market_beta_residual, n_rebalances) and solution.json intermediates as {key: {value: x}} with python floats/ints
conventions: Missing returns filled with 0 after counting them
Signal uses only returns strictly before day t (no look-ahead)

Rebalance only on the first trading day of a calendar month inside the trading window; the trade-start day itself is not a rebalance unless it is a month start; positions zero before the first rebalance
std with ddof=1 everywhere; Sharpe with zero risk-free rate; max_drawdown as a positive magnitude
pitfalls: Rebalancing daily instead of monthly
Treating trade_start_day as a forced rebalance

title: Crank-Nicolson PSOR American/European pricing with discrete cash dividends
frame: DIKETAHUI: S0, K, r, q, sigma, T, daftar dividen tunai (t_d, D_d), grid N_S, N_T, S_max (dari instruksi), grid kasar untuk Richardson. DITANYAKAN: harga American/European put/call dengan dan tanpa dividen, batas exercise S*(t), delta, estimasi Richardson. RUMUS: koefisien CN untuk node i: a_i = dt/4 (sigma^2 i^2 - r i), b_i = -dt/2 (sigma^2 i^2 + r), c_i = dt/4 (sigma^2 i^2 + r i); LHS (1-b) V^n - a V^n_{i-1} - c V^n_{i+1} = RHS a V^{n+1}_{i-1} + (1+b) V^{n+1}_i + c V^{n+1}_{i+1}; dividen: V_before(S) = V_after(max(S - D, 0)) interpolasi; American: V = max(V, payoff) via PSOR; P_rich = (4 P_fine - P_coarse)/3. JAWAB: 1) payoff terminal, mundur dari n=N_T-1 ke 0 dengan Dirichlet terdiskonto. 2) European: Thomas tridiagonal; American: PSOR sampai toleransi. 3) saat n == round(t_d/dt) terapkan lompatan dividen lalu proyeksi payoff. 4) S*(t_n) = S_i terbesar <= K dengan |V - payoff| <= tol. 5) harga interpolasi di S0, delta beda pusat. 6) ulang grid kasar, Richardson, tulis file.
formulas: alpha_i = 0.25 dt (sigma^2 i^2 - r i) ; beta_i = -0.5 dt (sigma^2 i^2 + r) ; gamma_i = 0.25 dt (sigma^2 i^2 + r i), i = 1..N_S-1
Crank-Nicolson: (1 - beta_i) V_i - alpha_i V_{i-1} - gamma_i V_{i+1} = alpha_i V^{+}_{i-1} + (1 + beta_i) V^{+}_i + gamma_i V^{+}_{i+1} (V^{+} = later time level)
Boundaries at time t: put V(0) = K e^{-r (T-t)}, V(S_max) = 0 ; call V(0) = 0, V(S_max) = S_max - K e^{-r (T-t)}
PSOR update: v_i <- max(payoff_i, v_i + omega (x_i - v_i)), x_i = (rhs_i + alpha_i v_{i-1} + gamma_i v_{i+1}) / (1 - beta_i), stop when max|dv| < tol
Cash dividend crossing (backward): V_pre(S) = interp(V_post, at max(S - D, 0)), then for American V = max(V, payoff)
delta = (V(S0 + dS) - V(S0 - dS)) / (2 dS) at t = 0 on the grid ; P_rich = (4 P_fine - P_coarse) / 3 ; convergence_ratio = |P_coarse - P_rich| / |P_fine - P_rich|
steps: Build S_i = i dS with dS = S_max/N_S, dt = T/N_T; payoff vector for put or call; store V at every time level for grid sampling
Precompute alpha, beta, gamma for interior nodes; dividend steps = round(t_d / dt)

March backward n = N_T-1..0: set Dirichlet boundary values from the discounted strike, form RHS from the later level including boundary terms, solve interior: Thomas algorithm (European) or PSOR with projection onto payoff (American) to the stated tolerance
If n equals a dividend step: shift V by interpolation at S - D (floored at 0) and re-project onto payoff for American
For the American put record S*(t_n): largest grid S_i <= K with |V_i - payoff_i| within tolerance, 0.0 if none; S*(T) = K
Price = V at S0 (interp or exact node) at n = 0; delta by central difference on the two neighbouring nodes
Run all four option types with dividends and again with an empty dividend list; run the American put on the coarse grid; Richardson estimate and convergence ratio

Write option_values.json (eight keys), greeks.csv (option_type, delta), convergence.csv (grid fine/coarse/richardson, price), early_exercise_boundary.csv (t, S_star; N_T+1 rows), american_put_grid.csv (S column then time headers, every 5th stock node and 10th time node as stated), exercise_boundary.png (matplotlib Agg), summary.json with the listed comparison keys
conventions: Time marched backward from T to 0; boundary conditions re-evaluated at each level with tau = T - t
No-dividend American call reported equal to the European call (no early exercise), premium differences computed from the reported values
Summary booleans compare with a tiny tolerance; S*(t) written as 0.0 when no exercise region exists
Whole script must finish within the stated time budget: vectorise the RHS, keep PSOR loops tight
pitfalls: Forgetting to re-project onto payoff after the dividend shift for American options
Scanning the boundary from low S upward instead of taking the largest S with V = payoff

title: Discrete arithmetic Asian calls: geometric exact, Levy, Curran, MC benchmark
frame: DIKETAHUI: OHLCV harian (close), r dari instruksi, grid T, n_monitoring, moneyness m, N_mc, seed. DITANYAKAN: sigma terkalibrasi, harga Asian call aritmetik (Levy, Curran), geometrik eksak, MC aritmetik/geometrik dengan standard error, ringkasan. RUMUS: x_i = ln(close_i/close_{i-1}); sigma = std(x, ddof=1) sqrt(252); K = m S0; t_i = i T/n (tanpa t0); geo: H = sigma^2/n^2 sum t_i (2n - 2i + 1), M = (r - sigma^2/2) T (n+1)/(2n), F_G = S0 e^{M + H/2}, C = e^{-rT}[F_G N(d1) - K N(d2)], d1 = (ln(F_G/K) + H/2)/sqrt H; Levy: M1 = mean S0 e^{r t_i}, M2 = S0^2/n^2 sum_ij e^{r(t_i+t_j)} e^{sigma^2 min(t_i,t_j)}, s^2 = ln(M2/M1^2), harga BS dengan forward M1 dan vol sqrt(s^2/T); MC: S(t_i) = S0 exp((r - sigma^2/2) t_i + sigma W_i). JAWAB: 1) kalibrasi. 2) loop T x n x K: toolkit asian_geometric_price, asian_arithmetic_levy, asian_curran. 3) MC gbm_paths dengan seed, rata-rata aritmetik dan geometrik, payoff diskonto, SE = std(ddof=1)/sqrt(N). 4) sort T, n, K; tulis CSV dan summary.
formulas: log_return_i = ln(close_i / close_{i-1}) ; return_std = std(log_return, ddof=1) ; sigma = return_std * sqrt(trading days per year as stated) ; S0 = last close

Geometric exact: H = (sigma^2 / n^2) sum_i t_i (2n - 2i + 1), M = (r - sigma^2/2) T (n+1)/(2n), F_G = S0 exp(M + H/2), C_geo = e^{-rT} (F_G N(d1) - K N(d2)), d1 = (ln(F_G/K) + H/2)/sqrt(H), d2 = d1 - sqrt(H)
Levy: M1 = (1/n) sum S0 e^{r t_i} ; M2 = (S0^2/n^2) sum_{i,j} e^{r (t_i + t_j)} e^{sigma^2 min(t_i, t_j)} ; s2 = ln(M2 / M1^2) ; C_levy = BS_call(forward M1, K, T, r, vol = sqrt(s2 / T))
Curran (geometric conditioning): condition on G with log-variance H and forward F_G; shift by delta = M1 - F_G, i.e. BS on G with strike K - delta (toolkit asian_curran implements the passed variant)
MC: W_i = cumsum(Z) sqrt(T/n), S(t_i) = S0 exp((r - sigma^2/2) t_i + sigma W_i) ; mc_arith = e^{-rT} mean(max(mean_i S(t_i) - K, 0)) ; mc_geo likewise with exp(mean ln S)
mc_std_err = std(e^{-rT} payoff_arith, ddof=1) / sqrt(N_mc)
steps: Load the daily file, parse and sort by date; close series; log returns by diff of log; n_prices = number of closes; return_mean, return_std (ddof=1); S0 = last close; sigma annualised
Write calibration.json: n_prices, sigma, S0, return_mean, return_std

Loop T in the maturity list, n in the monitoring list, K = S0 * m for each moneyness: geo_exact = asian_geometric_price(S0, K, T, r, sigma, kind='call', q=0, n=n, include_t0=False); levy_arith = asian_arithmetic_levy(...same...); curran_arith = asian_curran(...same...)

MC: paths = gbm_paths(S0, mu=r, sigma=sigma, T=T, n_steps=n, n_paths=N_mc, seed=seed, drift_is_log=True, include_t0=True); drop the t0 column; arithmetic and geometric averages per path; discounted payoffs; mc_arith, mc_geo, mc_std_err
Assemble rows T, n_monitoring, K, moneyness, geo_exact, levy_arith, curran_arith, mc_arith, mc_geo, mc_std_err; sort by T, n_monitoring, K ascending; write asian_prices.csv

summary.json: n_rows, geo_less_than_arith_pct = 100 * mean(geo_exact < mc_arith), levy_vs_mc_max_error = max|levy - mc_arith|, curran_vs_mc_max_error, curran_better_than_levy = curran error < levy error
conventions: Monitoring dates t_i = i T / n for i = 1..n, t0 excluded from the average
Risk-neutral drift r, no dividend; same seed reused for every grid cell
Standard error uses ddof=1 on discounted payoffs divided by sqrt(N_mc)
All JSON values cast to python float/int/bool
pitfalls: Including S0 (t0) in the average changes every price
Using a fresh RNG state per cell makes summary comparisons noisy

title: Barone-Adesi-Whaley American approximation vs Black-Scholes and CRR
frame: DIKETAHUI: close harian, r dan D dari instruksi, grid moneyness S/K, grid T, grid T untuk permukaan S*, grid D untuk sensitivitas, N langkah CRR. DITANYAKAN: harga BAW call/put Amerika, premi exercise awal, S* dan S**, pembanding CRR, sensitivitas dividen. RUMUS: sigma = std(ln return, ddof=1) sqrt(252); K = S0/m; M = 2r/sigma^2, N = 2(r-D)/sigma^2, Kf = 1 - e^{-rT}; q2 = [-(N-1) + sqrt((N-1)^2 + 4M/Kf)]/2, q1 = [-(N-1) - sqrt(.)]/2; call: S* - K = c(S*) + [1 - e^{-DT} N(d1(S*))] S*/q2, A2 = (S*/q2)[1 - e^{-DT} N(d1(S*))], C = c + A2 (S/S*)^q2 jika S < S*, selain itu S - K; put: K - S** = p(S**) - [1 - e^{-DT} N(-d1(S**))] S**/q1, A1 = -(S**/q1)[1 - e^{-DT} N(-d1(S**))], P = p + A1 (S/S**)^q1 jika S > S**, selain itu K - S. JAWAB: 1) kalibrasi. 2) loop grid: bs_price dan baw_american (harga, S*). 3) permukaan S* ATM per T. 4) crr_price american=True, reldiff = |BAW - CRR|/CRR. 5) loop D ATM T=1. 6) summary dengan flag monotonik.
formulas: sigma = std(ln(close_t/close_{t-1}), ddof=1) * sqrt(252) ; n_returns = len(close) - 1 ; K = S0 / moneyness (moneyness = S/K)
Call: S* solves S* - K = c_BS(S*) + (1 - e^{-DT} N(d1(S*))) S*/q2 ; A2 = (S*/q2)(1 - e^{-DT} N(d1(S*))) ; C = c_BS + A2 (S/S*)^q2 if S < S* else S - K ; D = 0 -> C = c_BS, S* = inf
Put: S** solves K - S** = p_BS(S**) - (1 - e^{-DT} N(-d1(S**))) S**/q1 ; A1 = -(S**/q1)(1 - e^{-DT} N(-d1(S**))) ; P = p_BS + A1 (S/S**)^q1 if S > S** else K - S
premium_call = baw_call - bs_call ; premium_put = baw_put - bs_put ; ratio = S*/S0
CRR: u = e^{sigma sqrt(dt)}, d = 1/u, p = (e^{(r-D)dt} - d)/(u - d), backward induction with max(continuation, exercise) ; reldiff = |BAW - CRR| / CRR
steps: read_table the daily file, parse and sort dates; S0 = last close; log returns; sigma = annualized_vol(log_returns, periods_per_year=252); n_returns; write calibration.json (S0, sigma, r, D, n_returns)

For each moneyness and T: K = S0/m; bs_call, bs_put = bs_price(S0, K, T, r, sigma, kind, q=D); (baw_call, S_star_call) = baw_american(S0, K, T, r, sigma, kind='call', q=D) and the put likewise; premiums; write baw_prices.csv with columns moneyness,T,K,bs_call,bs_put,baw_call,baw_put,premium_call,premium_put,S_star_call,S_star_put
Critical price surface: for each T in the long maturity list with K = S0 (ATM) take S_star from baw_american for call and put; ratios S*/S0; write critical_prices.csv
Binomial comparison ATM for each T: crr_price(S0, S0, T, r, sigma, steps=N, kind, american=True, q=D); diffs and reldiffs; write binomial_comparison.csv
Dividend sensitivity ATM at the stated T: loop D values, baw and bs prices, premiums; write dividend_sensitivity.csv

summary.json: ATM T=1 BAW call/put, premiums, S* call/put, max CRR reldiff call/put, call_premium_increases_with_D (diff >= -tol), put_premium_positive, call_geq_euro, put_geq_euro, S_star_call_increases_with_T, S_star_put_decreases_with_T, zero_D_call_premium_negligible (< 0.01)
conventions: Critical prices solved with brentq: call bracket (K, 2K doubled until sign change), put bracket (K/2 halved, K)
D = 0: American call equals European call, premium exactly 0, S* infinite
Monotonicity flags evaluated with a tiny tolerance on consecutive differences
Only mean-free formulas: q2 for calls, q1 for puts
pitfalls: Mixing moneyness definitions (S/K here, so K = S0/m)
OTM short-dated call premium must be exactly zero when S >= S* never triggers

title: GARCH(1,1) forecast vol into down-and-out call, FD Greeks, delta-gamma-vega VaR
frame: DIKETAHUI: log-return harian, params (S0, K, B, r, T, confidence_level, n_contracts, fd_dS_pct, fd_dsigma). DITANYAKAN: VaR portofolio opsi dan pangsa varians delta/gamma/vega (%), plus parameter GARCH, vol forecast, harga, Greeks. RUMUS: sigma_t^2 = omega + alpha eps_{t-1}^2 + beta sigma_{t-1}^2 (mean nol); sigma2_f = omega + alpha r_T^2 + beta sigma_T^2; garch_vol = sqrt(252 sigma2_f); V_L = omega/(1 - alpha - beta); C_do = S[N(d1) - (B/S)^{2 lambda} N(d1')] - K e^{-rT}[N(d2) - (B/S)^{2 lambda - 2} N(d2')], lambda = (r + sigma^2/2)/sigma^2, d1' pakai ln(B^2/(S K)); Delta = [V(S+h) - V(S-h)]/2h, Gamma = [V(S+h) - 2V + V(S-h)]/h^2, Vega = [V(s+k) - V(s-k)]/2k; var_delta = (n Delta S0)^2 sigma2_f, var_gamma = 1/2 (n Gamma)^2 S0^4 sigma2_f^2, var_vega = (n Vega sigma_sigma)^2; VaR = z_c sqrt(total); pct_i = 100 var_i/total. JAWAB: 1) fit arch_model mean Zero, Garch(1,1), Normal. 2) parameter dan forecast dari observasi terakhir. 3) harga dan FD Greeks pada fungsi yang sama. 4) sigma_sigma = std(diff(sigma_t sqrt 252), ddof=1). 5) VaR dan pangsa. 6) tulis JSON.
formulas: GARCH(1,1), zero mean: sigma_t^2 = omega + alpha r_{t-1}^2 + beta sigma_{t-1}^2 ; persistence = alpha + beta ; long_run_variance = omega / (1 - persistence)
sigma2_f = omega + alpha r_last^2 + beta sigma_last^2 (one step ahead from the final observation) ; garch_vol = sqrt(252 * sigma2_f)

Down-and-out call (q = 0, B < S): lambda = (r + sigma^2/2)/sigma^2 ; d1 = (ln(S/K) + (r + sigma^2/2) T)/(sigma sqrt T), d2 = d1 - sigma sqrt T ; d1' = (ln(B^2/(S K)) + (r + sigma^2/2) T)/(sigma sqrt T), d2' = d1' - sigma sqrt T ; C = S (N(d1) - (B/S)^{2 lambda} N(d1')) - K e^{-rT} (N(d2) - (B/S)^{2 lambda - 2} N(d2')), floored at 0, 0 if B >= S
dS = fd_dS_pct * S0 ; delta = (V(S0+dS) - V(S0-dS)) / (2 dS) ; gamma = (V(S0+dS) - 2 V(S0) + V(S0-dS)) / dS^2 ; vega = (V(sigma + fd_dsigma) - V(sigma - fd_dsigma)) / (2 fd_dsigma)
sigma_sigma = std(diff(sigma_t * sqrt(252)), ddof=1) (daily change of annualised conditional vol; already a 1-day quantity)

var_delta = (n delta S0)^2 sigma2_f ; var_gamma = 0.5 (n gamma)^2 S0^4 sigma2_f^2 ; var_vega = (n vega sigma_sigma)^2 ; total = sum ; portfolio_var = norm.ppf(c) sqrt(total) ; x_var_pct = 100 var_x / total
steps: Load returns.csv (log_return) and params.json; read S0, K, B, r, T, confidence_level, n_contracts, fd_dS_pct, fd_dsigma

Fit arch_model(returns, mean='Zero', vol='Garch', p=1, q=1, dist='Normal').fit(disp='off'); if the optimiser returns start values on decimal data, fit on returns*100 and rescale omega by 1/100^2 and conditional vol by 1/100 (alpha, beta scale-free)
garch_omega, garch_alpha, garch_beta from res.params; garch_persistence; long_run_variance (diagnostic only)
sigma2_f from the last return and last conditional variance; garch_vol annualised with 252
analytical_price = closed-form down-and-out call at (S0, K, B, r, T, garch_vol)
Central finite-difference delta, gamma (relative bump on S0) and vega (absolute bump on vol) on the same pricing function
Portfolio Greeks = n_contracts * Greek; vol-of-vol from the annualised conditional vol series; three variance terms, total, portfolio_var, percentage shares

Write results.json (portfolio_var, delta_var_pct, gamma_var_pct, vega_var_pct) and solution.json intermediates (garch_omega, garch_alpha, garch_beta, garch_persistence, long_run_variance, garch_vol, analytical_price, delta, gamma, vega) each as {value: float}
conventions: Pricing and VaR use the conditional one-step-ahead forecast vol, never the long-run vol
Variance terms use daily sigma2_f (1-day horizon), no annualisation of the VaR inputs
Shares are of variance on a 0-100 scale and sum to 100 exactly; no cross terms
VaR reported as a positive loss magnitude with z = norm.ppf(confidence_level)
pitfalls: Using res.forecast() with a mean model or the last in-sample sigma instead of the one-step-ahead forecast
Reporting shares as fractions or as shares of std/VaR
Self-check asserting a wrong intermediate count and aborting after outputs are written

title: Participation-capped bucket fill replay and TCA metrics in bps
frame: DIKETAHUI: quotes (update_id, transaction_time, event_time, best_bid_price, best_ask_price), trades (agg_trade_id, price, quantity, transact_time), order_spec (start_time_ms, end_time_ms, bucket_ms, target_quantity, participation_cap, max_child_quantity, side, realized_horizon_ms), tca_rules. DITANYAKAN: fill per bucket dan metrik TCA. RUMUS: mid = (bid+ask)/2; n_bucket = (end-start)//bucket_ms; eligible: bucket_start <= t < bucket_end; cap = participation_cap * bucket_volume; child = min(remaining, cap, max_child); fill di ask (buy)/bid (sell) dari quote pertama >= bucket_start; fill_rate = executed/target; avg_fill = sum(q p)/executed; vwap = sum(p q)/sum q; IS = 1e4 (avg_fill - arr)/arr; eff = 2e4 (avg_fill - arr)/arr; real = 2e4 (avg_fill - fut)/arr; temp = 1e4 (fut - arr)/arr. JAWAB: 1) stable sort quotes/trades by time. 2) arrival quote = pertama >= start; future quote = pertama >= end + horizon. 3) loop bucket, bawa remaining, baris kosong jika tanpa trade. 4) agregasi, tulis CSV manual (6 desimal, ms 13 digit), results.json urutan kunci tetap, solution.json dengan checkpoints.
formulas: arrival_mid = (bid + ask)/2 of the first quote with transaction_time >= start_time_ms ; future_mid likewise for the first quote with transaction_time >= end_time_ms + realized_horizon_ms
bucket i = [start + i*bucket_ms, start + (i+1)*bucket_ms), i = 0..(end-start)//bucket_ms - 1 ; eligible trades: bucket_start <= transact_time < bucket_end

participation_cap_qty = participation_cap * eligible_trade_qty ; child_order_qty = min(remaining_qty, participation_cap_qty, max_child_quantity) ; fill_price = reference ask (buy) or bid (sell) of the first quote with transaction_time >= bucket_start

executed_qty = sum fill_qty ; unfilled_qty = target - executed ; fill_rate = executed / target ; avg_fill_price = sum(fill_qty * fill_price) / executed ; market_vwap = sum(price*qty)/sum(qty) over all window trades

implementation_shortfall_bps = 1e4 (avg_fill - arrival_mid)/arrival_mid ; effective_spread_bps = 2e4 (avg_fill - arrival_mid)/arrival_mid ; realized_spread_bps = 2e4 (avg_fill - future_mid)/arrival_mid ; temporary_impact_bps = 1e4 (future_mid - arrival_mid)/arrival_mid
bucket_count_filled = #buckets with fill_qty > 0 ; bucket_count_empty = #buckets with eligible_trade_count == 0 ; future_reference_time_ms = end_time_ms + realized_horizon_ms
steps: Load order_spec.json, tca_rules.json, quotes.csv, trades.csv; sort quotes by transaction_time and trades by transact_time with kind='mergesort'
Arrival quote and future quote by first-at-or-after lookups on transaction_time; keep update_id, transaction_time, event_time of each
Window trades = [start, end); market_trade_count, market_volume, market_vwap from them

Loop buckets carrying remaining_qty: eligible trades, count/qty/notional, first/last trade id and time; empty bucket -> zero qty fields, empty strings for ids/prices/quote links, is_empty_bucket true; otherwise reference quote, cap, child; child > 0 -> fill at touch, record quote link fields, update remaining, track first/last fill quote transaction time; child == 0 with trades -> zero fill, empty fill fields, is_empty_bucket false
Write fills.csv by hand in the exact column order: floats with 6 fixed decimals, ms timestamps as 13-digit zero-padded ints, ids as plain ints, booleans lowercase true/false, missing as empty strings
results.json with keys in the exact listed order (schema_version, task_slug, symbol, side, ... bucket_count_empty), floats rounded to 6 decimals, ints as ints

solution.json: intermediates (bucket counts, eligible totals, first/last fill quote tx time, arrival/future quote times) and checkpoints for the stated bucket indices (bucket_start_ms, eligible_trade_count, eligible_trade_qty, child_order_qty, remaining_qty, is_empty_bucket) each as {value: x}
conventions: All time filters half-open; quote lookups use transaction_time (not event_time) with >=
Buy fills at the ask, sell at the bid; bps formulas applied literally without sign flips
future_reference_time_ms is the target instant end + horizon; the quote found at/after it goes in future_quote_* fields
Empty means zero eligible trades; a bucket with trades but zero child is not empty
Identity to check: effective_spread = realized_spread + 2 * temporary_impact
pitfalls: Writing fills.csv with pandas default formatting (NaN, True/False, scientific notation)
Using the previous quote (<= t) instead of the first quote at/after bucket start
Counting zero-child buckets as empty

title: Two-state Gaussian HMM regime covariance feeding Black-Litterman weights
frame: DIKETAHUI: return harian N aset, params (market_cap_weights, risk_aversion delta, tau, views absolut tahunan {asset_index, expected_return, confidence}, init_pi, init_trans_matrix, hmm_max_iter, hmm_tol, annualization_factor AF). DITANYAKAN: rezim saat ini dan probabilitasnya, bobot BL, metrik portofolio. RUMUS: p_t = R_t . w_mkt; emisi Gaussian; forward-backward log-space; M-step mu_k = sum g_tk x_t / sum g_tk, sigma_k = sqrt(sum g_tk (x_t - mu_k)^2 / sum g_tk), A_ij = sum xi_tij / sum_j; stop bila max|mu_new - mu_old| < tol; bull = argmax mu; hard assign g_t(bull) > 0.5; Sigma_regime = cov(ddof=1) baris rezim (fallback tak-bersyarat jika < 10 hari); Pi = delta Sigma w_mkt; Q_d = Q_ann/AF, Omega_d = diag(conf^2)/AF^2; mu_BL = [(tau Sigma)^-1 + P' Omega^-1 P]^-1 [(tau Sigma)^-1 Pi + P' Omega^-1 Q]; w* = Sigma^-1 mu_BL / delta; w = w*/sum|w*|. JAWAB: 1) inisialisasi mu/sigma dari paruh pertama/kedua (ddof=1). 2) EM. 3) rezim dan kovarians. 4) BL. 5) metrik pada seluruh histori. 6) tulis JSON.
formulas: log_emit(x; mu_k, sigma_k) = -0.5 (ln 2pi + 2 ln sigma_k + ((x - mu_k)/sigma_k)^2) ; log_alpha, log_beta via logaddexp ; log_gamma = log_alpha + log_beta - loglik ; xi from alpha, A, emission, beta

M-step: mu_k = sum_t g_tk x_t / sum_t g_tk ; sigma_k = sqrt(sum_t g_tk (x_t - mu_k)^2 / sum_t g_tk) ; A_ij = sum_t xi_tij / sum_j sum_t xi_tij ; pi = gamma_0 ; stop when max_k |mu_new - mu_old| < hmm_tol
Init: mu_0 = mean(p[:N//2]), mu_1 = mean(p[N//2:]) ; sigma_k = std(..., ddof=1) ; A, pi from params

bull = argmax mu ; regime_prob_bull = gamma_last[bull] ; current_regime = bull if > 0.5 ; bull_mask = gamma[:, bull] > 0.5 ; cov_regime = np.cov(returns[mask], ddof=1, rowvar=False) with fallback to unconditional cov when fewer than 10 days
Pi_daily = delta Sigma_curr w_mkt ; implied annual = Pi_daily * AF ; P one-hot per view ; Q_daily = Q_ann / AF ; Omega_daily = diag(conf_ann^2) / AF^2
mu_BL = solve((tau Sigma)^-1 + P' Omega^-1 P, (tau Sigma)^-1 Pi + P' Omega^-1 Q) ; w* = Sigma^-1 mu_BL / delta ; w_BL = w* / sum|w*|
port = returns @ w_BL ; ann_return = mean * AF ; ann_vol = std(ddof=1) sqrt(AF) ; sharpe = ann_return/ann_vol ; max_drawdown = max((runmax(cum) - cum)/runmax(cum)), cum = cumprod(1 + port)
steps: Load returns.csv (asset columns in file order) and params.json; portfolio series = returns @ market_cap_weights
Initialise mu and sigma from the first-half/second-half split with ddof=1; A and pi from init_trans_matrix and init_pi
Run Baum-Welch in log space: E-step (forward, backward, gamma, xi), M-step, convergence on max|dmu| < hmm_tol, cap at hmm_max_iter; record hmm_iterations as the number of iterations performed
Final E-step with converged parameters for the smoothed posteriors; bull state = higher mean; regime_prob_bull from the last day; current_regime label
Hard-assign days by gamma_bull > 0.5; n_bull_days; cov_bull and cov_bear with ddof=1 and the fallback rule; cov_curr for the current regime
Reverse optimisation Pi = delta cov_curr w_mkt; build P, Q, Omega from views converting annual to daily; BL posterior mean; w* = cov_curr^-1 mu_BL / delta; normalise to gross exposure 1
Apply w_BL to the full return history; annualized_return, annualized_volatility, sharpe_ratio, max_drawdown

Write results.json (current_regime, regime_prob_bull, annualized_return, annualized_volatility, sharpe_ratio, max_drawdown) and solution.json intermediates (hmm_iterations, hmm_mu_bull, hmm_sigma_bear, regime_prob_bull, implied_return_asset1 annualised, bl_weight_asset1, n_bull_days, cov_bull_diag_asset1, annualized_volatility, max_drawdown)
conventions: HMM emissions are the market-cap-weighted portfolio return; covariances are of the multi-asset returns
Hard 0.5-threshold assignment, no probability-weighted covariance
Views converted to daily: Q / AF and Omega / AF^2; implied returns reported annualised (x AF)
Final weights normalised by sum of absolute weights (gross exposure 1), not sum to 1
Sharpe = annualized_return / annualized_volatility with rf = 0; max_drawdown positive magnitude
pitfalls: Mixing the state index with the bull/bear label when the second state has the higher mean
Forgetting the extra E-step after convergence so posteriors match the final parameters

title: Bollinger mean-reversion backtest: costs, risk sizing, trailing stop, next-open fills
frame: DIKETAHUI: OHLCV harian dengan adj_close dan adj_open; konstanta instruksi: modal awal V0, window W, k std, fee tetap F, komisi c, risiko per trade rho, trailing stop s. DITANYAKAN: metrik, log trade, kurva kumulatif, analisis per trade. RUMUS: SMA_t, sd_t (ddof=1) atas adj_close; upper/lower = SMA +/- k sd; buy cost = q P (1+c) + F; sell net = q P (1-c) - F; sizing: q_risk = floor(rho cash / (P_exec - lower_signal)) jika > 0 else 0; q_cash = floor((cash - F)/(P_exec (1+c))); q = min; stop: close < peak (1 - s); r_t = V_t/V_{t-1} - 1, r_0 = 0; cum = cumprod(1+r); MDD = max((runmax - cum)/runmax); ann_ret = mean r * 252; ann_vol = std(r, ddof=1) sqrt 252; Sharpe = ann_ret/ann_vol; Calmar = ann_ret/MDD. JAWAB: 1) hitung band. 2) loop harian: eksekusi exit tertunda di open, lalu buy tertunda di open (sizing dengan lower band HARI SINYAL, peak = close hari sinyal), lalu cek exit di close (Bollinger dulu, lalu stop), lalu sinyal buy baru jika flat, lalu mark-to-market. 3) forced close di close terakhir. 4) metrik dan file.
formulas: SMA_t = mean(adj_close_{t-W+1..t}) ; sd_t = std(same, ddof=1) ; upper = SMA + k sd ; lower = SMA - k sd
buy_total_cost = q P (1 + c) + F ; sell_net_revenue = q P (1 - c) - F ; pnl = sell_net_revenue - buy_total_cost
q_risk = floor(rho * cash / stop_distance) if stop_distance = P_exec - lower_band[signal day] > 0 else 0 ; q_cash = floor((cash - F) / (P_exec (1 + c))) ; q = max(0, min(q_risk, q_cash))
trailing stop: adj_close_t < peak * (1 - s), peak initialised to the signal-day adj_close and updated with each day's adj_close while in position ; Bollinger exit: adj_close_t > upper_t (priority)
V_t = cash + q adj_close_t (or cash when flat) ; r_t = V_t / V_{t-1} - 1, r_0 = 0 ; cum = cumprod(1 + r) ; max_drawdown = max((runmax(cum) - cum)/runmax(cum))

annualized_return = mean(r) * 252 ; annualized_volatility = std(r, ddof=1) sqrt(252) ; sharpe = ann_ret/ann_vol ; calmar = ann_ret / max_drawdown ; total_return = (final_capital - V0)/V0 ; win_rate = #pnl > 0 / num_trades
intra_trade_max_drawdown = max((runmax(p) - p)/runmax(p)) over adj_close from entry exec day to exit exec day inclusive
steps: Load prices with parse_dates, sort ascending; rolling SMA and std (ddof=1) on adj_close; upper/lower bands (first W-1 rows NaN, no signals there)

Single day loop i with state (cash, shares, in_position, pending_buy + signal index, pending_exit + reason, peak, entry info): a) pending exit -> sell all at adj_open[i], book pnl and intra-trade drawdown; b) pending buy -> size at adj_open[i] using the signal day's lower band and cash as portfolio value, buy if q > 0, set peak = adj_close[signal day], consume the signal either way; c) if in position and no exit pending: update peak, check Bollinger exit then trailing stop on today's close; d) if flat with no pending orders, bands defined and a next day exists: close < lower -> pending buy; e) mark V_i = cash + shares * adj_close[i]

After the loop, if still holding: forced close at the last adj_close with costs (exit_reason forced_close); final_capital = round(cash, 2) including this sale; the daily value series stays marked at close without forced-close costs
Daily returns, cumulative curve, drawdown, metrics; num_trades = number of BUY rows

Write results.json nested under the ticker (total_return, final_capital, annualized_return, annualized_volatility, sharpe_ratio, max_drawdown, calmar_ratio, num_trades, win_rate, total_pnl, num_trading_days)

trades.csv (ticker,type,signal_date,exec_date,price,shares,pnl) with empty pnl on BUY rows; daily_portfolio.csv (date, cumulative_return) starting at 1.0; trade_analysis.json trades list (trade_num, entry_date, exit_date, entry_price, exit_price, pnl 2dp, exit_reason, intra_trade_max_drawdown 6dp); plotly HTML with a horizontal line at 1.0 and the stated title/axes
conventions: Signals on day t adj_close, fills at day t+1 adj_open; forced close at the final adj_close
Peak initialised to the signal-day close, not the fill price; Bollinger exit has priority over the stop
A buy signal that sizes to zero shares is consumed (dropped), never retried on later opens
Money rounded to 2 dp (final capital before total_return, pnl, total_pnl); dates as YYYY-MM-DD; ratios as raw floats
Entry and exit dates in trade_analysis are execution dates
pitfalls: Keeping a zero-share buy signal pending and retrying it (manufactures extra trades)
Using the execution-day lower band for the stop distance
Including forced-close costs in the daily value series

title: Brinson-Fachler monthly sector attribution with drifting portfolio weights and cash
frame: DIKETAHUI: harga close harian ETF sektor (benchmark dan pengganti), params (benchmark_weights per kuartal, portfolio_weights, portfolio_etfs mapping), cash_rates bulanan (month, annual_rate). DITANYAKAN: dekomposisi active return bulanan/tahunan/kuartalan/per sektor, snapshot bobot. RUMUS: R_m(e) = P_last(m)/P_last(m-1) - 1; R_cash = annual_rate/12; R^b = sum w^b_i R^b_i; R^p = sum w^p_i R^p_i + w_cash R_cash; A_i = (w^p_i - w^b_i)(R^b_i - R^b); S_i = w^b_i (R^p_i - R^b_i); I_i = (w^p_i - w^b_i)(R^p_i - R^b_i); A_cash = w^p_cash (R_cash - R^b); drift: w' = w (1+R)/sum w (1+R); tahunan = prod(1+R_m) - 1. JAWAB: 1) hari terakhir tiap bulan, return bulanan dengan jangkar bulan sebelum Januari. 2) loop bulan: pada bulan rebalance set w^p = target, w^b = bobot kuartal; hitung efek dengan bobot awal bulan; drift w^p ke bulan berikutnya. 3) jumlahkan: total, kuartal, per sektor; compound return. 4) tulis results.json.
formulas: R_m(e) = P_lastday(m)(e) / P_lastday(m-1)(e) - 1 ; R_cash(m) = annual_rate(m) / 12
R^b_m = sum_i w^b_i R^b_i ; R^p_m = sum_i w^p_i R(portfolio_etfs[i]) + w^p_cash R_cash

allocation_i = (w^p_i - w^b_i)(R^b_i - R^b) ; selection_i = w^b_i (R^p_i - R^b_i) ; interaction_i = (w^p_i - w^b_i)(R^p_i - R^b_i) ; allocation_cash = w^p_cash (R_cash - R^b), selection_cash = interaction_cash = 0
drift: w^p_i(next) = w^p_i (1 + R^p_i) / sum_j w^p_j (1 + R^p_j) (cash included with R_cash) ; reset to target weights in rebalance months
annual compound return = prod_m (1 + R_m) - 1 ; active_return = portfolio_return - benchmark_return ; totals = sums of the 12 monthly effects ; quarterly = sums of 3 months
steps: Load prices, parse Date, sort; last trading day per calendar month; monthly simple returns for every ETF column using the prior month's last close (prior-year December anchors January)
Load params (benchmark_weights by Q1..Q4, portfolio_weights incl. CASH, portfolio_etfs mapping) and cash_rates; cash monthly return = annual_rate / 12 keyed by month

Loop the 12 months: in rebalance months (first month of each quarter) set benchmark weights to that quarter's weights and portfolio weights to target; store the beginning-of-month portfolio weights (snapshot for the requested month)
Compute R^b and R^p with beginning-of-month weights; per-sector allocation, selection, interaction; cash allocation only; append monthly totals and per-sector monthly allocation
Drift portfolio weights proportionally to each holding's return and renormalise for the next month; benchmark weights stay at the quarter's values

Aggregate: compound portfolio/benchmark return, active_return, total effects, q1..q4 allocation, sector_allocation (with CASH), sector_selection and sector_interaction (equity sectors only), monthly_sector_allocation (with CASH), weight_snapshot_march; write results.json
conventions: Beginning-of-month weights for attribution; portfolio drifts between quarterly rebalances, benchmark weights are fixed within a quarter
Sector keys are the benchmark ETF tickers; portfolio return for a sector uses the mapped portfolio ETF
CASH appears in allocation and snapshot only, never in selection/interaction

Identity: active_return = total_allocation + total_selection + total_interaction (holds to ~1e-9 with arithmetic monthly sums vs compound annual only approximately; the checker used sums of monthly effects)
pitfalls: Using SPY as the benchmark
Dropping the prior-year December anchor so January return is missing

title: Black-Scholes-Merton Greeks surface with PDE residual and parity checks
frame: DIKETAHUI: close harian; r, D dari instruksi; K = S0; grid moneyness m = S/K dan grid T. DITANYAKAN: harga dan Greeks call/put tiap titik grid, residual PDE, error paritas, ringkasan. RUMUS: sigma = std(ln return, ddof=1) sqrt(252); d1 = [ln(S/K) + (r - D + sigma^2/2) T]/(sigma sqrt T), d2 = d1 - sigma sqrt T; C = S e^{-DT} N(d1) - K e^{-rT} N(d2); P = K e^{-rT} N(-d2) - S e^{-DT} N(-d1); Delta_c = e^{-DT} N(d1), Delta_p = e^{-DT}(N(d1) - 1); Gamma = e^{-DT} n(d1)/(S sigma sqrt T); Vega = S e^{-DT} n(d1) sqrt T; Theta_c = -S e^{-DT} n(d1) sigma/(2 sqrt T) - r K e^{-rT} N(d2) + D S e^{-DT} N(d1); Theta_p = -S e^{-DT} n(d1) sigma/(2 sqrt T) + r K e^{-rT} N(-d2) - D S e^{-DT} N(-d1); Rho_c = K T e^{-rT} N(d2), Rho_p = -K T e^{-rT} N(-d2); residual = Theta + (r-D) S Delta + sigma^2 S^2 Gamma/2 - r V; parity_error = |C - P - (S e^{-DT} - K e^{-rT})|. JAWAB: 1) kalibrasi. 2) meshgrid, S = m K. 3) bs_price/bs_greeks dengan q=D. 4) residual dan paritas. 5) sort T lalu moneyness, tulis CSV. 6) summary.
formulas: d1 = (ln(S/K) + (r - D + sigma^2/2) T) / (sigma sqrt T) ; d2 = d1 - sigma sqrt T ; C = S e^{-DT} N(d1) - K e^{-rT} N(d2) ; P = K e^{-rT} N(-d2) - S e^{-DT} N(-d1)
call_delta = e^{-DT} N(d1) ; put_delta = e^{-DT} (N(d1) - 1) ; gamma = e^{-DT} n(d1) / (S sigma sqrt T) ; vega = S e^{-DT} n(d1) sqrt T (per unit vol)
call_theta = -S e^{-DT} n(d1) sigma/(2 sqrt T) - r K e^{-rT} N(d2) + D S e^{-DT} N(d1) ; put_theta = -S e^{-DT} n(d1) sigma/(2 sqrt T) + r K e^{-rT} N(-d2) - D S e^{-DT} N(-d1) (per year, dV/dt)
call_rho = K T e^{-rT} N(d2) ; put_rho = -K T e^{-rT} N(-d2)
pde_residual = theta + (r - D) S delta + 0.5 sigma^2 S^2 gamma - r V (call and put separately)
parity_error = |C - P - (S e^{-DT} - K e^{-rT})|
steps: Load the daily file, sort by date; log returns from close; n_returns = number of returns; return_mean, return_std (ddof=1); S0 = last close; sigma = return_std * sqrt(252); K = S0
Write calibration.json (S0, sigma, r, D, K, n_returns, return_mean, return_std)
meshgrid(moneyness, maturity) ravelled; S = m * K
Vectorised prices and Greeks: bs_price(S, K, T, r, sigma, kind, q=D) and bs_greeks(S, K, T, r, sigma, kind, q=D) returning delta, gamma, theta, vega, rho
Build greeks_surface.csv (T, moneyness, S, call_price, put_price, call_delta, put_delta, gamma, call_theta, put_theta, vega, call_rho, put_rho) sorted by T then moneyness ascending
pde_verification.csv (T, moneyness, S, call_pde_residual, put_pde_residual, parity_error) same sort

summary.json: n_grid_points, n_maturities, n_moneyness, max |residual| call/put, max parity error, ATM call prices per maturity and ATM delta/gamma/vega at the longest T (lookup with np.isclose on moneyness), max_gamma_moneyness at the middle T via argmax, delta_call_range_valid (0 <= delta_c <= e^{-DT}), gamma_positive_everywhere, vega_positive_everywhere
conventions: Theta per year with the calendar-time sign so the PDE residual is ~1e-12; no /252 scaling
Vega and rho per unit (1.00) change; gamma and vega shared between call and put
ATM lookups with np.isclose, never exact float equality on derived values
Report the computed gamma-argmax moneyness; do not force it to 1.0 (analytically it sits slightly below ATM)
pitfalls: Dropping the D S e^{-DT} N(d1) term from call theta (residual then equals that term)
n_returns counted as number of prices (off by one)
Writing a combined results.json instead of the required summary.json

title: CIR MLE via non-central chi-squared, Riccati ZCB prices, yields, forwards
frame: DIKETAHUI: deret harian DFF (persen) dan kolom DGS, tanggal awal kalibrasi, batas parameter, daftar tau. DITANYAKAN: (kappa, theta, sigma) MLE, log-likelihood, Feller, harga ZCB, yield, forward, perbandingan pasar. RUMUS: r = DFF/100; dt = 1/252; c = 2 kappa/(sigma^2 (1 - e^{-kappa dt})); df = 4 kappa theta/sigma^2; LL = sum ln ncx2.pdf(2c r_{t+1}; df, nc = 2c r_t) + ln(2c); Feller ratio = 2 kappa theta/sigma^2 >= 1; gamma = sqrt(kappa^2 + 2 sigma^2); B = 2(e^{gamma tau} - 1)/((gamma + kappa)(e^{gamma tau} - 1) + 2 gamma); A = [2 gamma e^{(kappa+gamma) tau/2}/((gamma + kappa)(e^{gamma tau} - 1) + 2 gamma)]^{2 kappa theta/sigma^2}; P = A e^{-B r}; y = -ln P/tau; f(tau1, tau2) = -(ln P2 - ln P1)/(tau2 - tau1). JAWAB: 1) filter tanggal, statistik r. 2) minimize -LL dengan L-BFGS-B, bounds, >= 5 restart acak berseed, simpan LL terbaik. 3) Feller. 4) harga dan yield per tau dengan r terakhir. 5) market yield dari DGS pada tanggal terakhir (/100), NaN jika tak ada. 6) forward. 7) tulis file.
formulas: r_t = DFF_t / 100 ; dt = 1/252 ; c = 2 kappa / (sigma^2 (1 - e^{-kappa dt})) ; df = 4 kappa theta / sigma^2
LL = sum_t [ ln ncx2.pdf(2 c r_{t+1}, df, nc = 2 c r_t) + ln(2 c) ] (change of variables x = 2 c r) ; minimise -LL with L-BFGS-B inside the stated bounds, best of >= 5 random restarts
feller_ratio = 2 kappa theta / sigma^2 ; feller_condition_satisfied = ratio >= 1

gamma = sqrt(kappa^2 + 2 sigma^2) ; B(tau) = 2 (e^{gamma tau} - 1) / ((gamma + kappa)(e^{gamma tau} - 1) + 2 gamma) ; A(tau) = (2 gamma e^{(kappa + gamma) tau / 2} / ((gamma + kappa)(e^{gamma tau} - 1) + 2 gamma))^{2 kappa theta / sigma^2}
P(tau) = A(tau) e^{-B(tau) r_current} ; zero_rate = -ln P ; model_yield = -ln P / tau ; yield_diff = model_yield - market_yield
forward_rate(tau1, tau2) = -(ln P(tau2) - ln P(tau1)) / (tau2 - tau1)
steps: Load the rates CSV with parse_dates; DFF / 100; filter date >= the stated start; rates array (dropna); n_obs, r_mean, r_std (ddof=1), r_min, r_max, r_current = last
Define the negative log-likelihood with scipy.stats.ncx2.logpdf on x = 2 c r_next with df and nc = 2 c r_prev plus log(2c) Jacobian; return a large penalty for non-positive parameters
Seeded RNG; >= 5 uniform random starts inside the bounds; scipy.optimize.minimize(method='L-BFGS-B', bounds=bounds); keep the solution with the highest log-likelihood
feller_ratio and flag; write calibration.json (n_obs, kappa, theta, sigma, log_likelihood, feller_condition_satisfied, feller_ratio, r_current, r_mean, r_std, r_min, r_max)

For each tau: A, B, zcb_price, zero_rate, model_yield; market_yield from the DGS column matching tau (1,2,5,10,30 years) at the last observation /100, NaN otherwise; yield_diff; write bond_prices.csv sorted by tau
Consecutive-tau forward rates from the ZCB prices; write forward_rates.csv (tau1, tau2, forward_rate)

summary.json: kappa, theta, sigma, r_current, feller_satisfied, mean_yield_error and max_yield_error (mean/max |model - market| over available maturities), yield_curve_upward_sloping = model_yield(longest tau) > model_yield(shortest tau)
conventions: Daily step dt = 1/252 in the transition density
Likelihood evaluated in the scaled variable 2 c r with the log(2c) Jacobian (house-model form)
Market yields and DFF converted from percent to decimal; missing market maturities written as NaN
Bond prices use the last observed short rate; row counts equal the number of maturities and pairs
pitfalls: Forgetting the Jacobian term when evaluating the density in the scaled variable
Keeping a failed optimiser result or a start point outside the bounds

title: Cliquet as a sum of Black-Scholes forward-start ATM calls vs European
frame: DIKETAHUI: close harian; r, D dari instruksi; daftar T dan jumlah reset N. DITANYAKAN: statistik return, harga cliquet per (T, N), harga European ATM per T, rasio, detail forward-start. RUMUS: x = ln(close_t/close_{t-1}); sigma = std(x, ddof=1) sqrt(252); skew, kurtosis(fisher=True); tau = T/N; t_i = i tau; forward-start ATM call ke-i = BS_call(S0 e^{-D t_i}, K = S0 e^{-D t_i}, tau, r, sigma, q=D) = S0 e^{-D t_i}[e^{-D tau} N(d1) - e^{-r tau} N(d2)], d1 = (r - D + sigma^2/2) tau/(sigma sqrt tau); cliquet = sum_i; European = BS_call(S0, S0, T, r, sigma, q=D); ratio = cliquet/European. JAWAB: 1) kalibrasi dan calibration.json. 2) loop T, N: hitung N forward-start, jumlahkan, European per T, rasio. 3) sort T, N; tulis cliquet_prices.csv. 4) detail per periode (period_index, t_start, t_end, forward_start_price). 5) summary: n_configurations, total_forward_starts, max/min cliquet, mean ratio, cliquet_increases_with_N.
formulas: log_return = ln(close_t / close_{t-1}) ; return_std = std(ddof=1) ; annualized_vol = return_std sqrt(252) ; return_skewness = scipy.stats.skew ; return_excess_kurtosis = scipy.stats.kurtosis(fisher=True) ; S0 = last close
tau = T / N ; t_start_i = i tau ; t_end_i = (i+1) tau, i = 0..N-1

forward_start_price_i = bs_price(S0 e^{-D t_start_i}, S0 e^{-D t_start_i}, tau, r, sigma, kind='call', q=D) = S0 e^{-D t_start_i} (e^{-D tau} N(d1) - e^{-r tau} N(d2)), d1 = (r - D + sigma^2/2) tau / (sigma sqrt tau), d2 = d1 - sigma sqrt tau
cliquet_price(T, N) = sum_i forward_start_price_i ; european_price(T) = bs_price(S0, S0, T, r, sigma, kind='call', q=D) ; ratio_cliquet_over_european = cliquet / european
cliquet_increases_with_N = all_T (cliquet(T, N_high) > cliquet(T, N_low))
steps: Load the daily file, sort by date, log returns from close; n_returns, return_mean, return_std, skewness, excess kurtosis, annualized_vol, S0; write calibration.json
For each T and N: tau = T/N; for i in range(N) price the forward-start ATM call with spot and strike S0 e^{-D i tau} and maturity tau via bs_price(kind='call', q=D); sum to the cliquet price
European ATM call per T with bs_price(S0, S0, T, r, sigma, kind='call', q=D)
cliquet_prices.csv: T, N, period_length, cliquet_price, european_price, ratio_cliquet_over_european sorted by T then N
forward_start_details.csv: T, N, period_index, t_start, t_end, forward_start_price (one row per forward start)
summary.json: n_configurations, total_forward_starts, max_cliquet_price, min_cliquet_price, mean_ratio_cliquet_over_european, cliquet_increases_with_N
conventions: Forward-start value = BS call on the dividend-discounted forward spot with strike equal to that spot (ATM reset), q = D in the inner BS
Period length tau = T/N; 0-indexed periods
skew and kurtosis via scipy.stats with fisher=True for excess kurtosis
write_json/write_csv for outputs; counts as int, flags as bool
pitfalls: Pricing forward starts with strike S0 instead of the reset spot
Omitting the e^{-D t_start} factor on the forward spot

title: Monthly HDD call: burn analysis, OU anomaly Monte Carlo, bump Greeks
frame: DIKETAHUI: file GHCN-Daily tanpa header (station_id, date YYYYMMDD, element, value, flags), kontrak (station_id, contract_month, sample_start_year, sample_end_year, base_temperature_f, strike_hdd, tick_value_usd, risk_free_rate, days_to_expiry, mc_num_paths, mc_random_seed). DITANYAKAN: harga burn, parameter OU, harga MC dengan SE, Greeks. RUMUS: base_C = (F - 32) 5/9; T_avg = (TMAX + TMIN)/20 (persepuluh C); HDD_d = max(base_C - T_avg, 0); index tahun = sum HDD; payoff = tick max(index - K, 0); DF = e^{-r days/365}; burn = DF mean payoff; x_t = T_avg - musiman(hari-bulan); OLS dx = alpha + beta x + eps pada pasangan berurutan dalam tahun; dt = 1/365; kappa = -beta/dt; sigma = std(eps, ddof=1)/sqrt dt; theta = -alpha/beta; OU eksak: x' = theta + (x - theta) e^{-kappa dt} + sigma sqrt((1 - e^{-2 kappa dt})/(2 kappa)) Z; Greek = (P_up - P_down)/(2h). JAWAB: 1) bersihkan dan pivot. 2) burn. 3) fit OU. 4) MC dari x_0 = 0, HDD hari j dari x saat ini sebelum maju. 5) Greeks dengan seed sama. 6) tulis semua file.
formulas: base_c = (base_temperature_f - 32) * 5/9 ; tavg_c = (TMAX + TMIN)/2 / 10 ; hdd = max(base_c - tavg_c, 0)

monthly_hdd(year) = sum of daily hdd ; payoff = tick * max(monthly_hdd - strike, 0) ; DF = exp(-r * days_to_expiry / 365) ; burn_expected_payoff = mean(payoff) ; burn_price = DF * burn_expected_payoff

seasonal(dom) = mean tavg across years for that day-of-month ; x_t = tavg_t - seasonal(dom_t) ; OLS dx_t = alpha + beta x_t + eps on within-year adjacent-day pairs ; dt = 1/365 ; kappa = -beta/dt ; sigma = std(eps, ddof=1)/sqrt(dt) ; theta = -alpha/beta
exact OU step: x_{j+1} = theta + (x_j - theta) e^{-kappa dt} + sigma sqrt((1 - e^{-2 kappa dt})/(2 kappa)) Z_j ; HDD_j = max(base_c - (seasonal_j + x_j), 0) computed before the step, x_0 = 0
mc_price = DF mean(tick max(index - K, 0)) ; mc_std_error = DF std(payoff, ddof=1)/sqrt(n_paths) ; burn_mc_diff_pct = |burn - mc| / mc * 100
temp_delta = (P(seasonal + h_T) - P(seasonal - h_T))/(2 h_T) ; vega = (P(sigma(1+p)) - P(sigma(1-p)))/(2 p sigma) ; kappa_sens likewise with kappa, same seed for every leg
steps: Read the observations with header=None and the seven GHCN column names, date as string parsed with %Y%m%d; num_raw_rows = len

Filter station, element in {TMAX, TMIN}, contract month, years in [start, end]; pivot to wide by date; drop days missing either extreme; /10 to Celsius; tavg_c, hdd; write clean_daily.csv (date ISO, year, tmin_c, tmax_c, tavg_c, hdd) sorted by date
Group by year: monthly_hdd, payoff; write yearly_hdd.csv; DF, burn_expected_payoff, burn_price
Seasonal mean per day-of-month; anomaly x; adjacent pairs only when same year and date gap of one day; lstsq on [1, x] for alpha, beta; residuals; kappa, sigma, theta, r_squared, n_pairs, half-life

MC with numpy.random.default_rng(seed): Z of shape (n_paths, n_days); x = 0; for each day accumulate HDD from the current x then apply the exact OU step; payoff, mc_price, mc_std_error, index mean/std/5th/95th percentile
Greeks by central differences re-running the MC with the same seed: seasonal shift +/- h_T degrees, sigma +/- p relative, kappa +/- p relative; divide by 2 times the bump in parameter units

Write results.json (station_id, contract_month, base_temperature_c, strike_hdd, num_clean_days, num_years, discount_factor, burn_expected_payoff, burn_price, ou_kappa, ou_theta, ou_sigma, mc_price, mc_std_error, burn_mc_diff_pct, greeks{temp_delta, vega, kappa_sens}), mc_stats.json, ou_diagnostics.json, greeks.json (with bump sizes), solution.json intermediates as {value: x}
conventions: Everything (station, month, years, base, strike, tick, rate, horizon, seed, paths) read from the contract JSON, never hard-coded
Day count 365 for both the discount factor and the OU dt
Common random numbers: identical seed and Z for base and bumped runs
std_monthly_hdd with ddof=1; dates ISO YYYY-MM-DD; year as int
pitfalls: Linking the last day of one year's month to the first day of the next year's in the OU regression
Advancing x before computing day 1's HDD (day 1 must use x_0 = 0)
Euler step instead of the exact OU transition

title: Geske compound options (call-on-call, put-on-put), compound parity, chooser, MC
frame: DIKETAHUI: close harian; r, D dari instruksi; grid K1 (outer), K2 = m S0 (inner), T1, T2; T_choose untuk chooser; N_mc, seed. DITANYAKAN: S*, harga Geske call-on-call dan put-on-put, paritas compound, chooser, MC. RUMUS: sigma = std(ln return, ddof=1) sqrt(252); S*: BS_inner(S*, K2, T2 - T1) = K1 (brentq pada [1, 5 S0]); rho = sqrt(T1/T2); y1 = [ln(S/S*) + (r - D + s^2/2) T1]/(s sqrt T1), y2 = y1 - s sqrt T1; z1 = [ln(S/K2) + (r - D + s^2/2) T2]/(s sqrt T2), z2 = z1 - s sqrt T2; CoC = S e^{-D T2} M(z1, y1; rho) - K2 e^{-r T2} M(z2, y2; rho) - K1 e^{-r T1} N(y2); PoC = K2 e^{-r T2} M(z2, -y2; -rho) - S e^{-D T2} M(z1, -y1; -rho) + K1 e^{-r T1} N(-y2); PoP = S e^{-D T2} M(-z1, y1; -rho) - K2 e^{-r T2} M(-z2, y2; -rho) + K1 e^{-r T1} N(y2); paritas: CoC - PoC = C_BS(S, K2, T2) - K1 e^{-r T1}; chooser = C_BS(S,K,T) + K e^{-rT} N(-y2') - S e^{-DT} N(-y1'), y1' = [ln(S/K) + (r-D) T + s^2 t/2]/(s sqrt t); MC: S_T1 = S0 exp((r - D - s^2/2) T1 + s sqrt T1 Z), payoff e^{-r T1} max(inner_BS - K1, 0). JAWAB: 1) kalibrasi. 2) loop K1, m: geske_critical_price, compound_option_price, compound_option_mc. 3) paritas dengan put_on_call. 4) chooser_simple_price. 5) summary.
formulas: sigma = std(ln(close_t/close_{t-1}), ddof=1) sqrt(252) ; S0 = last close ; K2 = S0 * m
S* solves BS_inner(S*, K2, T2 - T1; r, D, sigma) = K1 with brentq on [1, 5 S0] (inner call for call-on-call, inner put for put-on-put)

rho = sqrt(T1/T2) ; y1 = (ln(S/S*) + (r - D + sigma^2/2) T1)/(sigma sqrt T1), y2 = y1 - sigma sqrt T1 ; z1 = (ln(S/K2) + (r - D + sigma^2/2) T2)/(sigma sqrt T2), z2 = z1 - sigma sqrt T2 ; M = bivariate normal CDF with correlation rho

call_on_call = S e^{-D T2} M(z1, y1; rho) - K2 e^{-r T2} M(z2, y2; rho) - K1 e^{-r T1} N(y2) ; put_on_call = K2 e^{-r T2} M(z2, -y2; -rho) - S e^{-D T2} M(z1, -y1; -rho) + K1 e^{-r T1} N(-y2) ; put_on_put = S e^{-D T2} M(-z1, y1; -rho) - K2 e^{-r T2} M(-z2, y2; -rho) + K1 e^{-r T1} N(y2)
parity_lhs = cc_price - pc_price ; parity_rhs = C_BS(S0, K2, T2) - K1 e^{-r T1} ; parity_error = |lhs - rhs|
chooser(t, T, K) = C_BS(S, K, T) + K e^{-rT} N(-y2) - S e^{-DT} N(-y1), y1 = (ln(S/K) + (r - D) T + sigma^2 t/2)/(sigma sqrt t), y2 = y1 - sigma sqrt t

MC: S_T1 = S0 exp((r - D - sigma^2/2) T1 + sigma sqrt(T1) Z) ; inner = BS(S_T1, K2, T2 - T1) ; payoff = max(inner - K1, 0) (cc) or max(K1 - inner, 0) (pp) ; mc_price = e^{-r T1} mean ; mc_std_err = std(disc payoff, ddof=1)/sqrt(N)
steps: Load the daily file, sort by date; log returns; n_returns, return_mean, return_std (ddof=1), sigma, S0; write calibration.json with r and D as given

For each K1 and moneyness m (K2 = S0 m): S_star = geske_critical_price(K1, K2, T1, T2, r, sigma, q=D, inner='call'|'put'); price = compound_option_price(S0, K1, K2, T1, T2, r, sigma, q=D, kind='call_on_call'|'put_on_put'); (mc, se) = compound_option_mc(..., kind, n_paths=N_mc, seed=seed)
compound_prices.csv rows: type ('call-on-call' / 'put-on-put'), K1, K2, K2_moneyness, T1, T2, S_star, compound_price, mc_price, mc_std_err

Parity per (K1, K2): pc_price = compound_option_price(kind='put_on_call') with the same S*; bs_call = bs_price(S0, K2, T2, r, sigma, kind='call', q=D); K1_pv = K1 e^{-r T1}; parity_lhs, parity_rhs, parity_error; write parity_check.csv

Chooser for each T_choose: chooser_simple_price(S0, K=S0, T_choose, T_underlying, r, sigma, q=D) plus bs_price call and put at T_underlying; write chooser_prices.csv (T_choose, K, T_underlying, chooser_price, call_price, put_price)

summary.json: sigma, S0, n_compound_prices, max_parity_error, parity_holds (< 0.01), max_mc_error = max|mc - geske|, mc_validates (error within a few standard errors), mean_cc_price, mean_pp_price, chooser prices per T_choose
conventions: Dividend-adjusted drift r - D in the MC so it matches the Geske price carrying D
Same S* used for call-on-call and put-on-call in the parity check (holds to ~1e-13)
np.random.seed(seed) once; one Z vector reused for every contract (common random numbers)
Chooser always >= max(call, put); flags as python bool
pitfalls: Put-on-put S* lies where the inner put equals K1 (above the strike region): outer put exercised when S_T1 > S*
Using put-on-put instead of put-on-call in the compound parity

title: Fit Gaussian/t/Clayton/Gumbel copulas to equity-pair pseudo-obs, pick by AIC
frame: DIKETAHUI: panel harga harian (date, symbol, close) untuk sekumpulan saham S; daftar famili copula F; ambang ekor q. DITANYAKAN: untuk setiap pasangan (i,j) parameter copula per famili, loglik, AIC, BIC, copula terbaik, koefisien tail dependence empiris, tau Kendall. RUMUS: r_t = ln(P_t/P_{t-1}); u_i = rank_i/(n+1); tau = Kendall sample; rho = sin(pi tau/2) (gaussian, t); theta_clayton = 2tau/(1-tau); theta_gumbel = 1/(1-tau); nu_t = argmax loglik dengan rho tetap, nu > 2; AIC = -2LL + 2k; BIC = -2LL + k ln n; lambda_U = P(u_j>q | u_i>q), lambda_L = P(u_j<1-q | u_i<1-q). JAWAB: 1) pivot close per simbol, log-return, dropna. 2) pseudo-obs per kolom. 3) semua pasangan combinations. 4) per pasangan: tau, parameter inversi tau, loglik tiap famili, nu profil untuk t. 5) AIC/BIC, argmin AIC per pasangan. 6) tail dependence empiris di q. 7) ringkasan: modus copula terbaik, mean tau, flag ada tail > ambang.
formulas: r_t = ln(close_t / close_{t-1}), first row dropped, rows with NaN dropped
u_i = rank(x_i, average) / (n + 1)
rho_gaussian = rho_t = sin(pi * tau / 2); theta_clayton = 2 tau / (1 - tau); theta_gumbel = 1 / (1 - tau) (tau <= 0 -> independence parameter)
nu_t = argmax_{nu > 2} LL_t(u; rho fixed, nu) (profile likelihood, continuous nu with bounds (2.01, upper))
AIC = -2 LL + 2 k; BIC = -2 LL + k ln(n); k = 1 for one-parameter copulas, k = 2 for student_t
lambda_U = #(u1 > q and u2 > q) / #(u1 > q); lambda_L = #(u1 < 1-q and u2 < 1-q) / #(u1 < 1-q)
steps: load OHLCV panel, to_datetime(date), sort by date, filter to the listed symbols, pivot close by symbol
log returns = np.log(prices).diff().dropna(); n_returns = number of rows
pseudo-observations with qf_toolkit pseudo_observations(returns.values) (rank/(n+1) per column)
pairs = itertools.combinations(symbols, 2) in the listed order

per pair: tau = empirical_kendall_tau(u); gaussian/clayton/gumbel via copula_param_from_tau and fit_copula(family, u, method='itau'); student_t via fit_copula('student_t', u, method='mle', nu_bounds=(2.01, 100)) which keeps rho from tau and profiles nu
copula_fits rows: stock1, stock2, copula, param1, param2 (NaN for one-parameter copulas, nu for student_t), loglik, aic, bic; copula labels gaussian, student_t, clayton, gumbel
best_copulas: per pair key 'STOCK1-STOCK2' -> copula with minimum aic
tail_dependence rows: stock1, stock2, lambda_upper, lambda_lower, kendall_tau using empirical_tail_dependence(u, q, tail, denominator='first')

data_summary: n_stocks, n_returns, stock_list, n_pairs; summary: n_pairs, most_common_best_copula (Counter mode), mean_kendall_tau (mean over pairs), has_tail_dependence (any lambda > stated threshold)
write CSVs with index=False and JSON with native Python types
conventions: log returns on pivoted closes, dropna once on the full panel so all symbols share dates
pseudo-observations use average ranks divided by (n+1), never n
Kendall tau computed on pseudo-observations (rank-invariant, equals tau on raw returns)
tail dependence conditions on the FIRST variable exceeding the threshold (denominator='first')
param2 written as NaN for single-parameter families; JSON floats cast with float(), bools with bool()
pitfalls: Gumbel requires tau >= 0: fall back to theta = 1 (independence) for negative tau
Student-t rho is the same sin(pi tau/2) inversion as Gaussian; only nu is optimised

title: Sample five copulas calibrated to one Kendall tau; rank correlation and tails
frame: DIKETAHUI: target tau Kendall tau*, famili copula F (gaussian, student_t dengan nu diberikan, clayton, gumbel, frank), jumlah sampel N, seed, ambang q. DITANYAKAN: parameter asli tiap famili, tau dan rho Spearman empiris, lambda_U(q), lambda_L(q), N0 sampel pertama, ringkasan. RUMUS: gaussian/t rho = sin(pi tau*/2); clayton theta = 2tau*/(1-tau*); gumbel theta = 1/(1-tau*); frank: selesaikan tau(theta) = 1 - 4/theta + 4 D1(theta)/theta secara numerik (D1 = fungsi Debye orde 1); lambda_U(q) = P(U2>q | U1>q); lambda_L(q) = P(U2<1-q | U1<1-q). JAWAB: 1) parameter per famili dari tau*. 2) set seed sekali, sampel N pasangan (u1,u2) per famili. 3) tau dan rho empiris. 4) tail dependence empiris pada setiap q. 5) tulis N0 baris pertama per famili dalam urutan famili. 6) ringkasan: mean tau empiris, max |tau_emp - tau*|, famili dengan lambda_U(q1) dan lambda_L(q1) terbesar, flag frank tanpa tail.
formulas: rho = sin(pi tau / 2) for gaussian and student_t (same rho, nu as given)
theta_clayton = 2 tau / (1 - tau); theta_gumbel = 1 / (1 - tau)
frank: tau(theta) = 1 - 4/theta + 4 D1(theta)/theta with D1(x) = (1/x) int_0^x t/(e^t - 1) dt; theta = root of tau(theta) - tau* (brentq)
lambda_U(q) = mean(U2 > q | U1 > q); lambda_L(q) = mean(U2 < 1-q | U1 < 1-q); 0 if the conditioning set is empty
max_tau_deviation = max_f |tau_emp_f - tau*|; mean_kendall_tau_empirical = mean_f tau_emp_f
steps: read parameters from the task (tau*, N, seed, nu, thresholds); no data file needed
per family theta = qf_toolkit copula_param_from_tau(family, tau*) (frank solved numerically inside)
np.random.seed(seed) once; u = copula_sample(family, theta, N, nu=nu for student_t, seed=seed) giving an (N,2) array on [0,1]^2
empirical tau = empirical_kendall_tau(u) (or scipy.stats.kendalltau); empirical Spearman from scipy.stats.spearmanr(u[:,0], u[:,1]) as the task states
parameters.json keyed by lowercase family: native_param, kendall_tau_theoretical (= tau*), kendall_tau_empirical, spearman_rho_empirical
tail_dependence.json per family: lambda_upper_<q>, lambda_lower_<q> for each threshold, conditioning on U1
samples.csv: first N0 rows per family, columns copula,u1,u2, all rows of family 1 first then family 2 etc. in the listed order

summary.json: n_samples, seed, mean_kendall_tau_empirical, max_tau_deviation, copula_with_strongest_upper_tail (argmax lambda_upper at the lower threshold), copula_with_strongest_lower_tail, frank_has_no_tail_dependence (both frank lambdas at the lower threshold below the stated cut)
conventions: family names lowercase exactly as listed: gaussian, student_t, clayton, gumbel, frank
one seed set once before sampling; the same seed passed to every copula_sample call reproduced the pass
lower-tail threshold is 1-q (quantiles 0.05 and 0.01 for q = 0.95, 0.99)
all JSON values cast to float/bool/int; strongest-tail picks use the lower q level (0.95)
pitfalls: Frank has no closed-form tau inversion: solve numerically with the Debye function, do not approximate
Student-t needs nu passed explicitly to the sampler; omitting it silently samples a different copula

title: Backward-adjust a close/volume series for splits and cash dividends
frame: DIKETAHUI: deret harga (date, close, volume) dan daftar aksi korporasi {type, date, ratio | amount}. DITANYAKAN: close_adjusted dan volume_adjusted backward-adjusted, faktor kumulatif harga dan volume, close pertama teradjust, close terakhir asli, total dividen. RUMUS: split a:b -> s = a/b, f_p = 1/s, f_v = s; dividen d -> f_p = (C_ex - d)/C_ex, f_v = 1, dengan C_ex = close hari perdagangan terakhir yang strictly sebelum tanggal aksi; terapkan f ke semua baris dengan date < tanggal aksi; F_p = prod f_p, F_v = prod f_v. JAWAB: 1) sort harga asc, parse tanggal, sort aksi kronologis. 2) salin kolom adjusted. 3) per aksi: idx = baris terakhir dengan date < action_date (skip jika kosong), hitung f, kalikan close_adjusted[:idx] (dan volume untuk split). 4) tabel keluaran dengan date YYYY-MM-DD, close_adjusted round 4, volume_adjusted int. 5) results: n_actions, F_p round 8, F_v round 4, first adjusted close, last unadjusted close, sum dividen.
formulas: split ratio 'a:b' -> s = a/b; price factor f_p = 1/s; volume factor f_v = s
dividend amount d: f_p = (C_ex - d) / C_ex, f_v = 1, C_ex = close of the last trading day strictly before the action date
apply: close_adjusted[date < action_date] *= f_p; volume_adjusted[date < action_date] *= f_v (splits only)
cumulative_price_adjustment_factor = prod_actions f_p; cumulative_volume_adjustment_factor = prod_actions f_v (qf_toolkit cumulative_adjustment_factor)
total_dividends_per_original_share = sum of dividend amounts (pre-adjustment)
steps: load prices CSV, to_datetime(date), sort ascending, reset_index; load actions JSON list and sort by date string ascending
close_adjusted = close.copy(); volume_adjusted = volume.copy()
for each action in chronological order: prior = rows with date < action_date; if empty skip; idx = prior.index[-1]
split: parse 'a:b' with int(a)/int(b); loc[:idx, close_adjusted] *= 1/s; loc[:idx, volume_adjusted] *= s
dividend: C_ex = close at idx; factor = (C_ex - amount)/C_ex; loc[:idx, close_adjusted] *= factor; volume untouched
collect each applied f_p and f_v (dividend f_v = 1) for the cumulative products
output columns date, close_unadjusted, close_adjusted, volume_unadjusted, volume_adjusted; date as YYYY-MM-DD; close_adjusted.round(4); volume_adjusted cast to int

results.json: n_actions_applied (int), cumulative_price_adjustment_factor round 8, cumulative_volume_adjustment_factor round 4, first_date_adjusted_close round 4 (row 0), last_date_unadjusted_close round 4 (last row), total_dividends_per_original_share round 4
conventions: 'before' means strictly before: the row on the action date itself is not adjusted
the ex-date close used in the dividend factor is the close of the last row strictly before the action date (covers weekend dates too)
factors are applied sequentially in chronological order on the already-adjusted series (multiplicative stacking)
the most recent rows stay unadjusted; all rounding happens only at write time
pitfalls: Do not compound a dividend factor with the split-adjusted close; use the unadjusted close on the ex-date reference row
Parse the ratio string, never assume 2:1

title: Pool cohort transition counts into an average matrix, multi-year PD, chi2 Markov test, generator
frame: DIKETAHUI: matriks transisi tahunan (count, pemisah ';'), file default-rate per tahun, matriks referensi historis (%), config {ratings, horizons, alpha}. DITANYAKAN: P_bar rata-rata, PD_i(h), uji homogenitas chi2 per rating, generator Q, ukuran kohort, deviasi vs referensi, default rate per kohort, ringkasan. RUMUS: C^(t)_ij = jumlah count sel halus yang dipetakan ke (i,j), + hidden_i = max(0, true_i - visible_i) di kolom Default; P^(t)_ij = C_ij / sum_k C_ik (baris kosong -> identitas); P_bar_ij = sum_t C^(t)_ij / sum_t sum_k C^(t)_ik; PD_i(h) = (P_bar^h)_{i,D}; chi2 = sum (O-E)^2/E, E = R_t K_j / N, df = (r-1)(k-1); Q = Re(logm(P_bar)), off-diag negatif -> 0, q_ii = -sum_{j!=i} q_ij, baris Default = 0; Delta = P_bar - P_ref (P_ref: drop NR, /100, renormalisasi baris); DR^(t) = sum_i C_{i,D} / sum_i sum_k C_ik. JAWAB: 1) parse+map ratings, 2) count matrices, 3) pool, 4) powers, 5) chi2, 6) logm, 7) deviasi, 8) default rates, 9) tulis.
formulas: P^(t)_ij = C^(t)_ij / sum_k C^(t)_ik; zero row -> identity row; Default row forced to unit vector
P_bar_ij = sum_t C^(t)_ij / sum_t sum_k C^(t)_ik (pooled counts, not mean of yearly P)
PD_i(h) = [P_bar^h]_{i, Default} via np.linalg.matrix_power
chi2 = sum_tj (O_tj - E_tj)^2 / E_tj, E_tj = R_t K_j / N over destination columns with total >= 5; df = (r-1)(k-1); p = chi2.sf; reject if p < alpha
Q = real(scipy.linalg.logm(P_bar)); q_ij<0 (i!=j) -> 0; q_ii = -sum_{j!=i} q_ij; Default row all zeros
Delta_ij = P_bar_ij - P_ref_ij for non-default rows; P_ref = (hist without NR)/100 renormalised per row
DR^(t) = sum_{i non-default} C^(t)_{i,Default} / sum_{i non-default} sum_k C^(t)_ik
steps: read each yearly transition file with sep=';', encoding='latin-1'; strip column names and first-column labels; set first column as index; drop censored columns (NR, Withdrawals); to_numeric with NaN -> 0
map fine ratings: AAA..B to themselves, CCC/CC/C -> CCC, SD/D/R -> Default; skip origin rows that map to Default or are censored; accumulate C[i,j] += value; track visible defaults per origin bucket
read the yearly default-rate file (comma separated), map ratings the same way, sum n_defaults per bucket; hidden = max(0, true - visible); C[i, Default] += hidden
to_stochastic each C (row normalise, empty row -> identity, Default row -> [0..0,1]); C_total = sum of yearly C; P_bar = to_stochastic(C_total)
cumulative PDs for each horizon in config: matrix_power(P_bar, h)[:, Default] for the non-default rows -> columns rating, horizon_<h>

Markov test per non-default origin: table cohorts x 8 destinations of counts; keep columns with total >= 5; if fewer than 2 rows or columns -> stat 0, df 0, p 1, reject False; else Pearson chi2, df, chi2.sf, reject p < alpha
generator: logm, real part, zero Default row, clip negative off-diagonals, reset diagonal to minus row off-diagonal sum, clip Default column >= 0 and recompute diagonal

reference matrix: strip, set index, drop NR, to_numeric/100, keep non-default rows in scale order, renormalise rows, add missing destination columns as 0, order columns by scale; deviation = P_bar[non-default] - P_ref
cohort default rates per year: total issuers (non-default rows), total defaults, rate, per-rating defaults; cohort sizes = row sums of C per year

write CSVs: matrices with first header 'rating', values round 6; markov_test with reject_H0 as bool; counts as int; summary.json with means of 1y/5y PD, IG (top 4) and SG (bottom 3) 1y PD means, rejection count, max off-diagonal and min diagonal of Q, max/mean |deviation| and 'FROM->TO' label of the argmax, peak/lowest cohort year and rate
conventions: withdrawals/NR are censored: dropped as origin and destination, never redistributed
hidden defaults floored at 0 and added to the count matrix before normalisation (they also enlarge cohort size)
chi2 column filter uses the TOTAL across cohorts >= 5, Default destination column included
degenerate contingency table (< 2 usable columns) -> stat 0, p = 1, not rejected
rounding only at write time (6 dp); identities checked on unrounded arrays
pitfalls: reading the semicolon files with the default comma separator or utf-8 breaks the header labels
fixing the diagonal before clipping negative off-diagonals leaves non-zero row sums
forgetting to renormalise the reference rows after dropping NR

title: Multi-factor Gaussian/t copula credit VaR-CVaR, Euler CVaR, Vasicek and Gordy GA
frame: DIKETAHUI: portofolio obligor (PD_i, EAD_i, recovery_i, recovery_stressed_i, factor_sector_i, rho_i), matriks korelasi sektor, config {n_sim, seed, levels, nu, wrong_way_sectors, boost}. DITANYAKAN: VaR/CVaR per copula dan level, skenario wrong-way, kontribusi Euler CVaR 99, statistik loss, konsentrasi, benchmark analitik Vasicek+Gordy, dekomposisi sektor. RUMUS: LGD_i = 1 - rec_i; A_i = sqrt(rho_i) M_{s(i)} + sqrt(1-rho_i) eps_i; gaussian: default jika A_i < Phi^-1(PD_i); t: M, eps dibagi sqrt(W), W ~ chi2(nu)/nu per simulasi, default jika A_i < t_nu^-1(PD_i); L = sum EAD_i LGD_i 1{def}; VaR_a = quantile(L, a); CVaR_a = mean(L | L >= VaR_a); Euler C_i = mean_{L >= VaR_99}(EAD_i LGD_i 1{def_i}); EL = sum PD_i EAD_i LGD_i; Vasicek: h_i(a) = (Phi^-1(PD_i) + sqrt(rho_i) Phi^-1(a))/sqrt(1-rho_i), VaR = sum EAD_i LGD_i Phi(h_i); GA = M sigma^2 / (2 C'); HHI = sum w^2. JAWAB: 1) load+Cholesky, 2) gaussian MC, 3) t MC seed offset, 4) VaR/CVaR, 5) wrong-way rerun same seed, 6) Euler, 7) konsentrasi/sektor, 8) tulis.
formulas: LGD_i = 1 - recovery_i; w_i = EAD_i / M, M = sum EAD; EL = sum_i PD_i EAD_i LGD_i; mean_portfolio_pd = sum w_i PD_i
A_i = sqrt(rho_i) (L Z)_{s(i)} + sqrt(1 - rho_i) eps_i, L = cholesky(sector corr); gaussian default iff A_i < Phi^{-1}(PD_i)
student_t: W ~ chi2(nu)/nu per simulation; A_i = (sqrt(rho_i) M_{s(i)} + sqrt(1-rho_i) eps_i) / sqrt(W); default iff A_i < t_nu^{-1}(PD_i)
VaR_a = np.quantile(L, a) (linear); CVaR_a = mean(L[L >= VaR_a]); Euler C_i = mean over scenarios with L >= VaR_99 of EAD_i LGD_i 1{default_i}, sum_i C_i = CVaR_99
h_i(a) = (Phi^{-1}(PD_i) + sqrt(rho_i) Phi^{-1}(a)) / sqrt(1 - rho_i); VaR_Vasicek(a) = sum_i EAD_i LGD_i Phi(h_i(a))

sigma^2(a) = sum w_i^2 LGD_i^2 Phi(h_i)(1 - Phi(h_i)); C'(a) = sum w_i LGD_i phi(h_i) sqrt(rho_i) / (sqrt(1-rho_i) phi(Phi^{-1}(a))); GA(a) = M sigma^2(a) / (2 C'(a)); VaR_Gordy = VaR_Vasicek + GA (PD_i > 0 only)
wrong-way: rho_i <- min(rho_i + boost, cap just below 1) and recovery_i <- recovery_stressed_i for obligors in the listed sectors; HHI = sum (shares)^2 at obligor and sector level
steps: load portfolio, sector correlation matrix (first column = index, index by sector NAME), config; check symmetry and min eigenvalue >= -tol; L = np.linalg.cholesky
derived arrays: EAD, LGD, weights, sector index of each obligor into the matrix label order, gaussian thresholds norm.ppf(PD), t thresholds t.ppf(PD, nu)

gaussian run: rng = default_rng(seed); factors = rng.standard_normal((n_sim, n_sectors)) @ L.T drawn ONCE; idiosyncratic standard_normal in row chunks of an (n_sim, N) C-order draw; losses per scenario; keep the tail default matrix for Euler
student_t run: rng = default_rng(seed + offset); W = rng.chisquare(nu, n_sim)/nu drawn FIRST, then the same factor and idiosyncratic draws; divide both by sqrt(W); compare with t thresholds
VaR/CVaR per copula and level -> var_cvar_results.csv (copula, confidence_level, VaR, CVaR, 2 dp)
wrong-way: boost rho and stress recovery for the listed sectors, rerun gaussian with the SAME base seed; wrong_way_results.csv rows scenario base/wrong_way

Euler contributions from the gaussian base tail set -> marginal_contributions.csv (obligor_id, issuer, sector = factor_sector, exposure_usd, exposure_weight 6 dp, marginal_cvar_99, pct_contribution) sorted descending
loss_statistics.csv per copula: mean, std, skew, excess kurtosis (4 dp), max, pct_zero_loss in percent, expected_loss_analytical
analytical_benchmark.csv and granularity_adjustment.csv per level: mc_var_gaussian, vasicek_var, analytical_el, mc_mean_loss, el_ratio, GA, gordy_var, gordy_to_mc_ratio

concentration_risk.json: obligor_hhi, sector_hhi, top_5_exposures, top_5_marginal_cvar, sector_weights; sector_risk_decomposition.csv groupby factor_sector with risk_weight_ratio = (pct CVaR)/(pct exposure); summary.json ratios (t/gaussian VaR, wrong-way CVaR increase %, mc_el_ratio, vasicek_to_mc_ratio, marginal_cvar_sum_check, gordy_var, GA)
conventions: losses positive in currency; VaR = numpy linear quantile; CVaR = mean of losses at or above VaR
same correlated-factor generator for both copulas; only the mixing variable and quantile function differ; W drawn per simulation, shared by all obligors
Euler contributions use exactly the CVaR tail scenario set so the sum check equals 1
sector mapping by label, not by position; correlation matrix may contain sectors absent from the portfolio
USD values 2 dp, exposure_weight 6 dp, skew/kurtosis 4 dp; Fisher excess kurtosis
pitfalls: normal quantile thresholds under the t copula break marginal PDs (EL check fails)
scaling only M or only eps by 1/sqrt(W), or drawing W per obligor, kills the tail dependence
forgetting to cap boosted correlations below 1 gives sqrt of a negative number

title: Rolling OLS credit-spread decomposition with Newey-West HAC t-stats and variance shares
frame: DIKETAHUI: deret FRED (observation_date, nilai; '.' = NaN), ada yang bulanan dan harian; rentang analisis; panjang window W; lag HAC m; ambang R2. DITANYAKAN: per window: komponen default/likuiditas/inflasi bulan terakhir, residual, R2, t-stat HAC; persentase varians per faktor; bulan regime-break. RUMUS: Y = BAA - DGS10; X1 = BAA - AAA; X2 = TED; X3 = breakeven; OLS Y = a + b1 X1 + b2 X2 + b3 X3 + e; komponen_k = b_k X_k(t), residual = Y(t) - a - sum komponen; V_HAC = (X'X)^-1 S (X'X)^-1, S = G0 + sum_{j=1..m} (1 - j/(m+1))(G_j + G_j'), G_j = sum_{t>j} e_t e_{t-j} x_t x_{t-j}'; t_k = b_k / sqrt(V_kk); pct_k = Cov(b_k X_k, Y)/Var(Y) x 100; pct_res = (1 - R2) x 100. JAWAB: 1) load, to_numeric coerce, resample bulanan last. 2) align pada indeks bulanan rentang analisis, ffill TED, drop bulan dengan BAA/AAA/DGS10/breakeven NaN. 3) loop window akhir t >= W-1, OLS + HAC. 4) tulis tiga CSV.
formulas: Y_t = BAA_t - DGS10_t; X1 = BAA - AAA; X2 = TEDRATE; X3 = T10YIE (percentage points)
beta = (X'X)^{-1} X'y with X = [1, X1, X2, X3] over the W-month window ending at t; R2 = 1 - SSR/SST
component_k(t) = beta_k X_k(t); residual(t) = Y(t) - alpha - sum_k component_k(t)
S = G0 + sum_{j=1}^{m} (1 - j/(m+1)) (G_j + G_j'); G0 = sum e_t^2 x_t x_t'; G_j = sum_{t=j+1}^{T} e_t e_{t-j} x_t x_{t-j}'; V = (X'X)^{-1} S (X'X)^{-1}; t_k = beta_k / sqrt(V_kk)
pct_k = Cov(beta_k X_k, Y) / Var(Y) * 100 with population moments (ddof=0) over the window; pct_residual = (1 - R2) * 100; the four sum to 100
steps: load each FRED CSV, rename columns to observation_date and the series name, to_datetime, pd.to_numeric(errors='coerce') so '.' becomes NaN
