resample every series to month-end with .resample('ME').last() (last valid observation in the calendar month)
reindex all series on a month-end date_range covering the analysis window; ffill the discontinued series (TED); keep months where BAA, AAA, DGS10 and breakeven are all non-null
convert the index to first-of-month timestamps (to_period('M').to_timestamp()) for the date column
compute Y and the three proxies as arrays; for t from W-1 to N-1 take the slice of W observations ending at t
OLS via XtX inverse; residuals; HAC meat with explicit loops over t and lags j = 1..m, Bartlett weight 1 - j/(m+1); V = XtX_inv S XtX_inv; tstats = beta / sqrt(diag V)

decomposition_results row: date, baa_treasury_spread, default_component, liquidity_component, inflation_component, residual, r_squared, hac_tstat_default, hac_tstat_liquidity, hac_tstat_inflation (round 6)
variance_decomposition row: date, pct_default, pct_liquidity, pct_inflation, pct_residual via covariance shares; regime_breaks rows where r_squared < the stated threshold (date, r_squared)
write the three CSVs with index=False in the exact column order
conventions: monthly alignment = last valid observation per calendar month; monthly series also passed through resample last
dates written as YYYY-MM-DD first day of month
HAC uses the stated fixed lag m with Bartlett weights, no small-sample correction, no prewhitening
t-stats reported for the three factor loadings only, never the intercept
variance shares use ddof=0 moments so factor shares plus (1-R2) sum exactly to 100
pitfalls: treating '.' as 0 instead of NaN
forward-filling the breakeven series: it must be dropped where missing, only the discontinued series is ffilled

title: CreditMetrics one-factor Gaussian copula migration MC: loss VaR/ES, PD by rating
frame: DIKETAHUI: matriks transisi 1 tahun (baris = rating awal, kolom = rating akhir termasuk Default), komposisi portofolio n_k obligasi per rating awal, face F, recovery R, rho, N_sim, seed. DITANYAKAN: distribusi loss portofolio (mean, std, VaR, ES), loss dan PD per rating awal, tingkat upgrade/downgrade/default. RUMUS: cum_k = cumsum(P[k,:]) (urutan kolom seperti matriks), thr_k = Phi^-1(clip(cum_k)); Z_i = sqrt(rho) M + sqrt(1-rho) eps_i; rating baru = searchsorted(thr_k, Z_i); loss_i = (1-R) F 1{Default}; L = sum_i loss_i; VaR_a = quantile(L, a, linear); ES_a = mean(L | L >= VaR_a); PD_k = mean 1{Default} atas pasangan (sim, obligasi) rating k; upgrade = indeks baru < indeks awal, downgrade = indeks baru > awal dan bukan Default. JAWAB: 1) matriks /100, ambil baris rating awal yang dipakai. 2) thresholds. 3) rng default_rng(seed): M (N_sim), eps (N_sim x n_bonds). 4) Z, rating baru, loss. 5) statistik. 6) tulis JSON/CSV.
formulas: P = matrix / 100; cum_k = cumsum(P[k, :]); thr_k = norm.ppf(clip(cum_k, eps, 1 - eps))
Z_i = sqrt(rho) M + sqrt(1 - rho) eps_i, M ~ N(0,1) per simulation, eps_i ~ N(0,1) per bond
new_rating_i = searchsorted(thr_{init(i)}, Z_i) clipped to [0, n_ratings - 1]; default iff new index = Default index
loss_i = (1 - R) F 1{default_i}; L = sum_i loss_i; mean = L.mean(); std = L.std(ddof=1)
VaR_a = np.quantile(L, a, method='linear'); ES_a = mean(L[L >= VaR_a])
upgrade_rate = #(new < init)/total; downgrade_rate = #(init < new < Default)/total; default_rate = #(new == Default)/total; total = N_sim x n_bonds
steps: build the transition matrix array in the stated rating order, divide by 100; select the rows of the initial ratings actually held
bond_init = concatenated initial-rating indices repeated by the portfolio counts (in the listed rating order)
thresholds = norm.ppf of clipped cumulative row sums
rng = np.random.default_rng(seed); M = rng.standard_normal(N_sim) then eps = rng.standard_normal((N_sim, n_bonds)); Z = sqrt(rho) M[:,None] + sqrt(1-rho) eps
per bond column: new_rating = clip(searchsorted(thresholds[init], Z[:, j]), 0, n_ratings-1); default_mask; loss_per_bond = LGD * face where default
portfolio_loss = row sums; mean_loss, std_loss (ddof=1), var_95/var_99/var_999 by linear quantile, es_95/es_99 as mean of losses >= VaR
loss_by_rating.csv rows in the listed order: initial_rating, n_bonds, mean_loss (mean over sims of the summed loss of that group), prob_default (mean of default indicator over sim x bond pairs)
migration_stats.json: upgrade_rate, downgrade_rate, default_rate; summary.json: task, n_bonds, n_simulations, correlation, recovery_rate, mean_loss, var_99, es_99
write JSON with plain floats/ints and CSV with index=False
conventions: losses in millions (face = 1) so loss per defaulted bond = 1 - R
thresholds from the cumulative probabilities in the matrix column order; new rating = searchsorted index (first column = lowest Z bucket)
draw order: systematic factor vector first, then the full idiosyncratic matrix, from one default_rng(seed)
std with ddof=1; VaR by numpy linear quantile; ES as mean at or above VaR
pitfalls: rows for ratings not held in the portfolio are not needed; do not re-normalise rows that already sum to 1
clip cumulative probabilities away from exactly 1 before norm.ppf to avoid inf

title: Cross-sectional 12-2 momentum long/short top-3 bottom-3 monthly backtest
frame: DIKETAHUI: tabel harga bulanan (date + kolom saham dengan urutan tetap) berisi duplikat tanggal dan NaN; panjang formasi 11 bulan (t-12..t-2); jumlah long/short n_L = n_S; faktor anualisasi 12. DITANYAKAN: num_clean_rows, num_signal_months, total_return, annualized_return, annualized_vol, sharpe, max_drawdown, path return portofolio. RUMUS: r_t = P_t/P_{t-1} - 1; sinyal_t = sum_{k=t-12}^{t-2} r_k; urutkan desc dengan tie-break urutan kolom; long = top n_L, short = bottom n_S; sr_t = mean(r_t long) - mean(r_t short); total = prod(1+sr) - 1; ann_ret = (1+total)^(12/n) - 1; ann_vol = std(sr, ddof=1) sqrt(12); sharpe = ann_ret/ann_vol; MDD = max((peak - W)/peak), W = cumprod(1+sr). JAWAB: 1) sort date, drop_duplicates keep last, ffill, dropna. 2) pct_change, buang baris pertama. 3) loop t = 12..n_ret-1. 4) metrik. 5) tulis JSON + CSV (date, signal_return, cumulative_return).
formulas: r_t = price_t / price_{t-1} - 1 (simple), return table starts at the second clean row
signal_t = sum_{k=t-12}^{t-2} r_k (11-month window, rows iloc[t-12:t-1])
signal_return_t = mean(r_t of top n_L) - mean(r_t of bottom n_S) after sorting by (signal desc, column order asc)
total_return = prod(1 + sr) - 1; annualized_return = (1 + total_return)^(12 / n) - 1
annualized_vol = std(sr, ddof=1) * sqrt(12); sharpe = annualized_return / annualized_vol
max_drawdown = max((running_max(W) - W) / running_max(W)), W = cumprod(1 + sr)
steps: read CSV; sort_values('date'); drop_duplicates(subset='date', keep='last'); ffill(); dropna(); num_clean_rows = len
set_index('date'); returns = pct_change().iloc[1:]
for t in range(12, n_ret): formation = returns.iloc[t-12:t-1].sum(); rank by (summed desc, original column position asc)
long = first n_L names, short = last n_S names; signal_return = mean of returns.iloc[t] over long minus over short; record returns.index[t]
num_signal_months = number of valid months; cumulative = cumprod(1 + signal_returns)
metrics: total_return, annualized_return, annualized_vol (ddof=1), sharpe, max_drawdown via running max
results.json with exactly the listed keys (int for counts, float otherwise); portfolio.csv columns date, signal_return, cumulative_return
conventions: cleaning order fixed: sort -> drop duplicates keep last -> ffill -> dropna
ties broken by the original CSV column order, not alphabetically
realised return for month t is the same month-t return used in the universe (no extra lag)
std with ddof=1; annualisation exponent uses the count of signal months
pitfalls: the formation slice is iloc[t-12:t-1] (11 rows); including t-1 adds the skipped month

title: Funding-rate statistics, Euler plug-in OU fit, exact-OU Monte Carlo of basis carry
frame: DIKETAHUI: deret funding rate (symbol, funding_time ms, funding_rate desimal), params {symbol, analysis_start/end, regime_split_date, ou_dt, annualization_periods A, mc_num_paths, mc_horizon_periods H, mc_random_seed, var_confidence c}. DITANYAKAN: statistik deskriptif, autokorelasi, ADF, statistik per rezim, parameter OU, distribusi carry MC. RUMUS: bps = rate x 1e4; ann_mean = mean A; ann_vol = std sqrt(A); OLS df_t = a + b f_{t-1} + e; kappa = -b/dt, mu = -a/b, sigma = std(e, ddof=1)/sqrt(dt); half-life periode = (ln2/kappa)/dt, hari = periode/3; stat_std = sigma/sqrt(2 kappa); transisi eksak f' = mu + (f - mu) e^{-kappa dt} + sigma sqrt((1 - e^{-2 kappa dt})/(2 kappa)) Z; carry = sum H rate simulasi; ann_ret = carry A/H; losses = sort(-ann_ret), VaR = max(losses[ceil(cN)-1], 0), CVaR = mean(losses > VaR). JAWAB: 1) bersihkan, 2) statistik, 3) rezim, 4) OU, 5) MC, 6) tulis.
formulas: datetime = to_datetime(funding_time, unit='ms', utc=True).floor('s'); funding_rate_bps = funding_rate * 10000
annualized_mean = mean * A; annualized_volatility = std(ddof=1) * sqrt(A); autocorr(lag) = Series.autocorr(lag)
OLS on differences: dF_t = a + b F_{t-1} + e; kappa = -b / dt; mu = -a / b; sigma = std(e, ddof=1) / sqrt(dt); R2 of the difference regression
half_life_periods = (ln 2 / kappa) / dt; half_life_days = half_life_periods / 3; stationary_std = sigma / sqrt(2 kappa); NaN if kappa <= 0
exact OU step: f_{t+1} = mu + (f_t - mu) e^{-kappa dt} + sigma sqrt((1 - e^{-2 kappa dt}) / (2 kappa)) Z_t
annual_return = (sum of the H simulated rates) * A / H; per-path average rate = cumulative / H
losses = sort(-annual_return); VaR = max(losses[ceil(c N) - 1], 0); CVaR = mean(losses[losses > VaR]) (VaR if that set is empty)
steps: load params; read funding CSV; UTC datetime floored to seconds; filter symbol; keep [start 00:00, end + 1 day); sort, drop duplicate timestamps keep last
funding_clean.csv columns datetime (format %Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ), symbol, funding_rate, funding_rate_bps

descriptive stats: mean, std ddof=1, pandas skew(), kurt() (unbiased, Fisher), min, max, median, pct_positive = mean(rate > 0) * 100; annualised mean/vol; autocorr at the listed lags; adfuller(maxlag=24, regression='c', autolag='AIC') -> statistic, p-value, is_stationary = p < 0.05

regimes: period1 = datetime < split, period2 = datetime >= split; same stats + autocorr lag 1 + ADF + OU kappa/sigma; mean_ratio_p2_over_p1, autocorr_diff; regime_stats.csv one row per period with start_date/end_date/num_obs
OU fit on the full sample with np.linalg.lstsq on [1, F_{t-1}] -> a, b; derive kappa, mu, sigma, half-lives, stationary std; num_observations_fit = len(diff)

MC: rng = default_rng(seed); Z = rng.standard_normal((N_paths, H)) once; start every path at the last observed rate; loop H steps with the exact transition using column t; accumulate the simulated rates (not f0)
annual returns, mean/std(ddof=1), VaR/CVaR in loss convention, pct_negative = mean(ann < 0) * 100, np.percentile p5/p25/p50/p75/p95; per-path average rate distribution mean/std/p5/p50/p95
write results.json, ou_diagnostics.json, mc_stats.json, solution.json intermediates {key: {value}} with the exact key names
conventions: timestamps truncated (floor) to seconds, never rounded; written with trailing Z
end date inclusive of the whole day (filter < end + 1 day)
plug-in Euler OU (kappa = -b/dt), not the log form; residual std ddof=1
MC uses the exact OU transition; Z matrix drawn once, column t at step t
VaR by index ceil(cN)-1 on ascending losses, clamped at 0; CVaR strictly greater than VaR
pitfalls: adding the initial observed rate into the carry sum changes the horizon to H+1
dt must be in years (1/A) for kappa and the half-life conversions to be consistent

title: EMA-crossover vol-target CTA, GARCH multi-step VaR, rolling stressed VaR, Basel IMA charge
frame: DIKETAHUI: harga harian beberapa aset; params {fast_ema, slow_ema, vol_lookback, vol_target, max_leverage_per_asset, risk_free_annual, n_assets, confidence_level a, holding_period h, basel_multiplier m}; faktor anualisasi AF = 252 (sesuai tugas). DITANYAKAN: capital_charge, stressed_var, var_component, svar_component + intermediates (ann return/vol, sharpe, MDD, calmar, avg |leverage|, parameter GARCH, var). RUMUS: r = ln(P_t/P_{t-1}); EMA alpha = 2/(span+1), seed SMA span pertama; EWMA var alpha = 2/(lb+1), seed r_0^2, vol = sqrt(AF s2); sinyal = +1 jika fast > slow else -1; w = sinyal (vol_target/n)/vol diklip +-max; r_p,t+1 = sum_i w_i,t r_i,t+1; GARCH(1,1) zero mean normal pada r_p mentah; VaR = z_a sqrt(h) sqrt(s2_{T+1}); SVaR = max atas window 250 hari dari VaR GARCH refit; capital = m VaR + m SVaR. JAWAB: 1) returns, 2) EMA/sinyal, 3) EWMA/weights, 4) portofolio + metrik, 5) GARCH + VaR, 6) rolling SVaR, 7) tulis.
formulas: EMA: alpha = 2/(span+1); EMA[span-1] = mean(price[:span]); EMA[t] = alpha price[t] + (1-alpha) EMA[t-1]; NaN before the seed
EWMA: alpha = 2/(lb+1); s2[0] = r[0]^2; s2[t] = alpha r[t]^2 + (1-alpha) s2[t-1]; vol[t] = sqrt(AF s2[t])
signal = +1 if fast > slow else -1 (NaN comparison -> -1); w = clip(signal (vol_target/n_assets)/vol, -L, L); portfolio r_p,t+1 = sum_i w_i,t r_i,t+1

ann_ret = mean(r_p) AF; ann_vol = std(r_p, ddof=1) sqrt(AF); sharpe = (ann_ret - rf)/ann_vol; wealth = exp(cumsum r_p) with 1 prepended; MDD = max((peak - W)/peak); calmar = ann_ret/MDD; avg_abs_leverage = mean(sum_i |w_i|)
GARCH(1,1): arch_model(r_p, mean='Zero', vol='GARCH', p=1, q=1, dist='Normal', rescale=False); persistence = alpha + beta; long_run_variance = omega/(1 - persistence)
VaR = z_a sqrt(h) sqrt(forecast variance one step ahead), z_a = norm.ppf(a)
SVaR = max over windows [e-250, e) of the same GARCH VaR refit on that window; capital_charge = m VaR + m SVaR
steps: read prices, to_datetime, sort, drop duplicate dates, keep asset_ columns, ffill; AF = trading days stated by the task
asset log returns rets = diff(log prices) (shape T x n)

per asset: SMA-seeded EMA fast and slow on prices; signal = np.where(fast > slow, 1, -1); EWMA vol series aligned to price days (vol[0] NaN); weight = clip(signal * (vol_target/n_assets) / vol, -L, L)
lag weights one day: W[:-1] applied to rets; drop rows where any weight is NaN; port = row sums of W_lag * rets; lev = row sums of |W_lag|
performance intermediates: annualized_return, annualized_volatility, sharpe_ratio (excess over rf), max_drawdown on exp(cumsum) wealth, calmar_ratio, avg_abs_leverage
fit GARCH on raw decimal port returns with rescale=False; omega, alpha[1], beta[1], persistence, long_run_variance; one-step variance forecast -> var_99 = z sqrt(h) sqrt(f)
rolling 250-day windows over the full port series, refit GARCH per window, VaR with the same scaling; stressed_var = max finite value
results.json: capital_charge, stressed_var, var_component = m VaR, svar_component = m SVaR; solution.json intermediates {name: {value}}
conventions: weights decided at close t earn the return t -> t+1 (one-day execution lag)
no flat state: NaN EMA comparisons give -1 so warm-up is short; portfolio starts once all weights are defined
GARCH on native decimal returns (rescale=False); omega and long-run variance in daily return^2 units
VaR from the one-step-ahead forecast variance, scaled by sqrt(holding period)
drawdown positive; Sharpe uses the stated risk-free rate
pitfalls: a percent-scaled GARCH fit leaves omega 1e4 times too large unless descaled
windows whose fit fails are skipped, not treated as zero

title: DCC-GARCH(1,1) portfolio VaR/ES with FHS bootstrap and Kupiec/Christoffersen backtests
frame: DIKETAHUI: harga harian n aset, bobot w (jumlah 1), level VaR p, B bootstrap, parameter geometrik, seed. DITANYAKAN: parameter GARCH per aset, (a, b, LL) DCC, korelasi dinamis berpasangan, sigma_p harian/anual, VaR/ES parametrik dan FHS, pelanggaran, uji Kupiec dan Christoffersen. RUMUS: r = ln(P_t/P_{t-1}); GARCH zero-mean normal pada 100 r, sigma_t/100, omega/1e4; uncond_vol = sqrt(omega/(1-a-b)) sqrt(252); z_t = r_t/sigma_t; Qbar = Z'Z/T; Q_t = (1-a-b) Qbar + a z_{t-1} z_{t-1}' + b Q_{t-1}, Q_1 = Qbar; R_t = D_q^-1 Q_t D_q^-1; LL = -1/2 sum[ln|R_t| + z' R^-1 z - z'z]; H_t = D_t R_t D_t; sigma_p = sqrt(w' H_t w); VaR = -z_p sigma_p; ES = sigma_p phi(z_p)/p; FHS: baris residual bootstrap stasioner diskalakan sigma_tj, VaR = -percentile(sims, 1), ES = -mean(sims <= -VaR); LR_uc, LR_ind, LR_cc = LR_uc + LR_ind. JAWAB: 1) returns, 2) GARCH, 3) DCC optim, 4) rekursi H_t, 5) VaR/ES, 6) backtest, 7) tulis.
formulas: r_t = ln(P_t / P_{t-1}) in decimals, first row dropped; GARCH fit on 100 r: omega_dec = omega_pct / 1e4, sigma_dec = sigma_pct / 100, unconditional_vol = sqrt(omega_dec / (1 - alpha - beta)) * sqrt(252)
z_t = r_t / sigma_t; Qbar = Z'Z / T; Q_1 = Qbar; Q_t = (1 - a - b) Qbar + a z_{t-1} z_{t-1}' + b Q_{t-1}; R_t = diag(Q_t)^{-1/2} Q_t diag(Q_t)^{-1/2}
LL(a,b) = -1/2 sum_t [ln|R_t| + z_t' R_t^{-1} z_t - z_t' z_t]; maximise with L-BFGS-B from (a0, b0) as stated, penalty when a + b >= 1
H_t = D_t R_t D_t, D_t = diag(sigma_t); sigma_p,t = sqrt(w' H_t w); annualised = sigma_p sqrt(252)
VaR_p = -z_p sigma_p; ES_p = sigma_p phi(z_p) / p (zero mean); violation = 1{r_p < -VaR}
FHS: sims_t = (Z_boot * sigma_t) @ w; var_fhs = -percentile(sims, 1); es_fhs = -mean(sims[sims <= -var_fhs])
LR_uc = -2[(N-x) ln(1-p) + x ln p - (N-x) ln(1-ph) - x ln ph], ph = x/N; LR_ind = -2[ln L(pi) - ln L(pi01, pi11)] from n00, n01, n10, n11; LR_cc = LR_uc + LR_ind ~ chi2(2)
steps: read prices, set_index(date), log returns dropna, keep the ticker column order given
per asset: arch_model(100*r, mean='Zero', vol='Garch', p=1, q=1, dist='normal').fit(disp='off'); omega/1e4, alpha, beta, persistence, unconditional_vol; cond vol /100; std_resid = r / sigma
garch_params.csv: ticker, omega, alpha, beta, persistence, unconditional_vol

DCC negative log-likelihood with the Qbar recursion; scipy.optimize.minimize(method='L-BFGS-B', x0=(a0, b0), bounds keeping a, b positive and a+b < 1); dcc_params.json dcc_alpha/dcc_beta/dcc_persistence 8 dp, log_likelihood 4 dp
rerun the recursion with the fitted (a, b): per day R_t, H_t, sigma_p; pair correlations R[i,j] for i<j in ticker order -> dynamic_correlations.csv (date + pair columns TICKi_TICKj)
portfolio_return = returns @ w; var_1pct, es_1pct parametric; violation flag

FHS: rng = default_rng(seed); stationary bootstrap of B residual ROWS (random start, geometric block length with the stated p, wrap mod T); per day scale by sigma_t (diagonal), portfolio sims, var_1pct_fhs, es_1pct_fhs
portfolio_var.csv: date, portfolio_return, conditional_vol, annualised_vol, var_1pct, es_1pct, violation, var_1pct_fhs, es_1pct_fhs

backtest_results.json: num_observations, num_violations, violation_rate 6 dp, expected_rate, kupiec_lr_stat, kupiec_p_value (chi2 df 1), reject_h0_kupiec_5pct, christoffersen_lr_ind, christoffersen_lr_cc, christoffersen_p_value (chi2 df 2), reject_h0_cc_5pct
conventions: GARCH fitted on percent returns, every volatility converted back to decimals; omega divided by 1e4
DCC log-likelihood is the correlation part including the -z'z term (this form matched the 4 dp check)
Q_1 initialised at Qbar; R_t for day t uses Q_t built from z_{t-1}
VaR/ES reported as positive decimal losses; violation when the realised return is below -VaR
FHS scales bootstrap residual rows by the per-asset conditional sigma only (no Cholesky of R_t)
pitfalls: 0 ln 0 terms in the Christoffersen likelihood must be set to 0
applying a Cholesky of H_t on top of already-correlated residual rows inflates FHS VaR

title: Discrete delta hedge of a short call with escrowed dividends, asymmetric costs, daily IV
frame: DIKETAHUI: path harga S[0..N] (sudah termasuk drop dividen), path IV iv[t], jadwal dividen (ex_div_day, amount), tabel fee (buy/sell bps), K, r, T = N/252, dt = 1/252, daftar frekuensi rebalancing. DITANYAKAN: harga/delta/S_eff/PV dividen di t0; S akhir dan payoff; per frekuensi n_rebalances, total biaya, total dividen, hedging_pnl. RUMUS: PV_div(t) = sum_{d: ex>t} amt_d e^{-r (ex_d - t) dt}; S_eff = S - PV_div; T_rem = (N - t)/252; d1 = [ln(S_eff/K) + (r + s^2/2) T_rem]/(s sqrt(T_rem)), d2 = d1 - s sqrt(T_rem); C = S_eff N(d1) - K e^{-r T_rem} N(d2); delta = N(d1); biaya = |dShares| S x rate(buy jika dShares>0, sell jika <0). JAWAB: 1) t0: jual call, beli delta saham, bayar biaya buy. 2) tiap hari t=1..N-1: cash *= e^{r dt}; jika t ex-div: cash += shares x amt; jika t % f == 0: rebalance ke delta baru dengan biaya arah. 3) hari N: bunga, likuidasi saham dengan fee sell, bayar payoff max(S_N - K, 0). 4) pnl = cash akhir.
formulas: PV_divs(t) = sum_{ex_d > t} amount_d exp(-r (ex_d - t) dt); S_eff(t) = S[t] - PV_divs(t); T_rem(t) = (N - t) / 252
d1 = (ln(S_eff/K) + (r + sigma^2/2) T_rem) / (sigma sqrt(T_rem)); d2 = d1 - sigma sqrt(T_rem); C = S_eff N(d1) - K e^{-r T_rem} N(d2); delta = N(d1) with sigma = iv[t]
transaction cost = |dShares| S[t] rate, rate = buy_bps/1e4 if dShares > 0 else sell_bps/1e4
daily: cash <- cash e^{r dt}; ex-div day: cash += shares_prev_close amount; rebalance day (t % f == 0, 0 < t < N): cash -= dShares S[t] + cost
terminal: cash <- cash e^{r dt}; cash += shares S[N] - cost_sell; cash -= max(S[N] - K, 0); hedging_pnl = cash
steps: read stock path, IV path, dividends, fee schedule (map trade_type lower -> rate_bps/1e4)
pricing_at(t, S, sigma) returns price, delta, S_eff, pv_divs using remaining dividends only (ex_div_day > t)
t0 block: price, delta, S_eff, pv_divs at day 0 with iv[0]; terminal block: final_stock = S[N], call_payoff = max(S[N] - K, 0)
per frequency f: cash = price - delta S[0] - buy cost; shares = delta; total_tc starts with the initial cost
loop t = 1..N-1: accrue interest; credit dividend on the carried position if t is an ex-div day; if t % f == 0 compute new delta with iv[t], trade dShares with directional cost, count a rebalance
day N: accrue interest (and any dividend on day N), liquidate shares at the sell rate (buy rate if short), subtract payoff; hedging_pnl = cash

results.json: t0 {price, delta, S_eff, pv_divs}, terminal {final_stock, call_payoff}, simulations list in the stated frequency order with freq_days, n_rebalances (int), total_transaction_cost, total_dividends_received, hedging_pnl
conventions: delta is N(d1) of the escrowed model with respect to observed S (no extra dividend discount)
dividends credited on the ex-day at start of day on the position carried from the previous close, before any rebalance
no rebalance on the expiry day; n_rebalances counts days 0 < t < N with t % f == 0 only
interest accrues daily at e^{r dt} including the final day; costs applied to initial purchase, every rebalance and liquidation
pitfalls: using the current day's dividend in PV_divs once t equals the ex-day (it must drop out when ex_d <= t)

title: Cash/asset-or-nothing digitals, gap calls and reflection-principle barrier digitals
frame: DIKETAHUI: deret harga harian (close), r, D, grid T dan moneyness m = K/S0, rasio barrier H/S0, trigger gap. DITANYAKAN: S0, sigma, harga cash/asset digital call-put, BS call/put, gap call, knock-out/knock-in cash digital dengan barrier, error paritas, ringkasan ATM. RUMUS: S0 = close terakhir; sigma = std(ln(P_t/P_{t-1}), ddof=1) sqrt(252); d1 = [ln(S0/K) + (r - D + s^2/2)T]/(s sqrt T), d2 = d1 - s sqrt T; cash_call = e^{-rT} N(d2), cash_put = e^{-rT} N(-d2); asset_call = S0 e^{-DT} N(d1), asset_put = S0 e^{-DT} N(-d1); bs_call = asset_call - K cash_call, bs_put = K cash_put - asset_put; gap_call = S0 e^{-DT} N(d1(K2)) - K1 e^{-rT} N(d2(K2)); DO cash call = e^{-rT}[N(d2) - (H/S0)^{2 alpha} N(d2_H)], UO cash put = e^{-rT}[N(-d2) - (H/S0)^{2 alpha} N(-d2_H)], alpha = 2(r-D)/s^2 - 1, d2_H = [ln(H^2/(S0 K)) + (r - D - s^2/2)T]/(s sqrt T); knock-in = vanilla - knock-out. JAWAB: 1) kalibrasi, 2) grid digital, 3) gap, 4) barrier, 5) identitas dan ringkasan.
formulas: S0 = last close; log_ret = ln(close_t / close_{t-1}); sigma = std(log_ret, ddof=1) * sqrt(252); n_returns = count of non-NaN log returns
d1 = (ln(S0/K) + (r - D + sigma^2/2) T) / (sigma sqrt T); d2 = d1 - sigma sqrt T
cash_call = e^{-rT} N(d2); cash_put = e^{-rT} N(-d2); asset_call = S0 e^{-DT} N(d1); asset_put = S0 e^{-DT} N(-d1); bs_call = asset_call - K cash_call; bs_put = K cash_put - asset_put
gap_call(K1, K2) = S0 e^{-DT} N(d1(K2)) - K1 e^{-rT} N(d2(K2))
alpha = 2 (r - D) / sigma^2 - 1; d2_H = (ln(H^2 / (S0 K)) + (r - D - sigma^2/2) T) / (sigma sqrt T)
DO_cash_call = e^{-rT} [N(d2) - (H/S0)^{2 alpha} N(d2_H)]; UO_cash_put = e^{-rT} [N(-d2) - (H/S0)^{2 alpha} N(-d2_H)]; knock_in = vanilla - knock_out; parity_error = KO + KI - vanilla
steps: load daily CSV; S0 = close.iloc[-1]; sigma from log returns with ddof=1 annualised by 252; calibration.json {S0, sigma, r, D, n_returns}

digital grid: for T in T_grid, for m in m_grid: K = m S0; d1, d2; cash/asset call/put; bs_call, bs_put -> digital_prices.csv columns T, moneyness, K, cash_call, cash_put, asset_call, asset_put, bs_call, bs_put
gap grid: K1 = S0; for T, trigger m: K2 = m S0; gap_call via d1(K2), d2(K2) -> gap_prices.csv columns T, trigger_moneyness, K2, K1, gap_call

barrier grid: H_down = ratio_down S0 for down_out_cash_call, H_up = ratio_up S0 for up_out_cash_put; all T then all m for the down type first, then the up type -> barrier_digital_prices.csv columns T, moneyness, K, barrier_type, H, knockout_price, knockin_price, vanilla_price, parity_error
identities: max |cash_call + cash_put - e^{-rT}|, max |asset_call + asset_put - S0 e^{-DT}|, max BS decomposition error, max |parity_error|

summary.json: counts, the four max errors, ATM (m = 1, T = 0.5) cash call/put, asset call, gap call (trigger 1), DO cash call, UO cash put, cash_call_increases_with_S (cash call monotone decreasing in m at T = 0.5), do_leq_vanilla (all DO <= vanilla)
conventions: continuous dividend yield D enters d1/d2 and the asset-or-nothing discount e^{-DT}
knock-in prices come from parity, not a separate formula
row order: outer loop T, inner loop moneyness; barrier file lists the down type block before the up type block
all values float64; JSON written with float()/bool()/int() casts
pitfalls: the exponent on H/S0 is 2 alpha with alpha = 2(r-D)/sigma^2 - 1, not alpha itself

title: Dependent double sort corner portfolio with turnover-based transaction cost
frame: DIKETAHUI: panel (identifier, date, sinyal_1, sinyal_2, ret_lead1m); biaya c per unit turnover satu arah; skema kuintil 5x5 dependen (sinyal_1 dahulu). DITANYAKAN: deret net_return bulanan berlabel bulan formasi t. RUMUS: eligible = ketiga kolom non-null; kuintil berbasis peringkat: urut stabil (sinyal asc, identifier asc), posisi r dari n -> q = min(5, (5r)//n + 1); bucket_1 = q_1 == 1 (beta terendah), corner = dalam bucket_1 kuintil sinyal_2 == 5; w_i = 1/k; gross = mean ret_lead1m corner; turnover = 1 untuk portofolio emitted pertama, selanjutnya sum |w_t - w_prev| atas gabungan identifier dengan w_prev = portofolio EMITTED terakhir; net = gross - c x turnover. JAWAB: 1) load kolom yang diperlukan, cast identifier int, parse date. 2) loop tanggal asc: eligible, skip jika < 5 atau bucket/corner kosong. 3) hitung bobot, gross, turnover, net. 4) tulis CSV date (YYYY-MM-DD), net_return sorted asc.
formulas: quintile(r, n) = min(5, (5 r) // n + 1) for zero-based rank r after a stable sort by (signal asc, identifier asc)
low_beta = rows with beta quintile 1; corner = rows of low_beta with momentum quintile 5 (re-ranked within the bucket)
w_i = 1 / k for the k corner names; gross_t = mean(ret_lead1m over the corner)
turnover_t = 1 if first emitted portfolio else sum_i |w_t,i - w_prev,i| over the union of identifiers (missing = 0)
net_return_t = gross_t - c * turnover_t, c = stated cost rate (basis points / 1e4)
steps: read the parquet with only identifier, date, signal_1, signal_2, ret_lead1m columns (look for both the stated file name and the shipped name); identifier astype int64; date to_datetime
iterate unique dates ascending; g = rows of that date dropna on the three columns; skip if fewer than 5
sort g by (signal_1, identifier) with kind='mergesort'; keep quintile 1 by the integer formula; skip if empty
sort the bucket by (signal_2, identifier) mergesort; keep quintile 5 by the same formula on the bucket size; skip if empty
weights Series 1/k indexed by identifier; gross = corner ret_lead1m mean
turnover from the previous EMITTED weights (skipped months do not reset); net = gross - c * turnover; append {date: t formatted YYYY-MM-DD, net_return}
write strategy_returns.csv with columns date, net_return, index=False, sorted by date
conventions: rank-based integer quintiles, not pandas qcut or interpolated quantiles
ties broken by identifier ascending with a stable sort
rows labelled by the formation month, realised return taken from the same row's forward return (no later rows read)
first emitted turnover fixed at 1; later turnover between consecutive emitted vectors only
pitfalls: identifier may be stored as float in the parquet; cast before union/tie-breaking
a month skipped for an empty corner must not create a turnover datum

title: Dupire local vol from SVI-smoothed implied variance with flat-vol and forward-variance checks
frame: DIKETAHUI: kuotasi opsi (date, expiry, type, strike, price, volume), harga harian underlying, r, D, ambang volume, rentang IV valid, kriteria pemilihan expiry, grid moneyness. DITANYAKAN: S0, IV per (K,T), parameter SVI per expiry + RMSE, sigma_loc pada grid, uji flat-vol, forward variance, ringkasan. RUMUS: T = hari kalender/365; put -> call: C = P + S0 e^{-DT} - K e^{-rT}; IV via Newton dengan vega (safeguard bisection); k = ln(K/F), F = S0 e^{(r-D)T}, w = iv^2 T; SVI w(k) = a + b[rho(k-m) + sqrt((k-m)^2 + s^2)], w_k = b[rho + (k-m)/sqrt((k-m)^2+s^2)], w_kk = b s^2/((k-m)^2+s^2)^{3/2}; sigma_loc^2 = w_T / [1 - (k/w) w_k + 1/4(-1/4 - 1/w + k^2/w^2) w_k^2 + 1/2 w_kk], w_T beda maju antar slice SVI pada k tetap; flat test dengan rumus harga call: sigma^2 = [C_T + (r-D) K C_K + D C]/(1/2 K^2 C_KK) beda hingga. JAWAB: 1) filter+agregasi kuotasi, 2) IV, 3) pilih expiry, 4) fit SVI, 5) Dupire grid, 6) diagnostik, 7) tulis.
formulas: T = (expiry - valuation date).days / 365; F = S0 e^{(r-D)T}; k = ln(K/F); w = iv^2 T

put to call: C = P + S0 e^{-DT} - K e^{-rT}; BS call with yield D; vega = S0 e^{-DT} phi(d1) sqrt T; Newton sigma <- sigma - (C_model - C)/vega with bisection fallback, initial guess sqrt(2 pi / T) C / S0 clipped to the valid IV range

SVI raw: w(k) = a + b [rho (k - m) + sqrt((k - m)^2 + s^2)]; w_k = b [rho + (k - m)/sqrt((k-m)^2 + s^2)]; w_kk = b s^2 / ((k - m)^2 + s^2)^{3/2}; objective mean (w_svi - w_obs)^2; rmse in vol units = sqrt(mean (sqrt(w_svi/T) - iv)^2)
Dupire (total variance form): sigma_loc^2 = w_T / [1 - (k/w) w_k + (1/4)(-1/4 - 1/w + k^2/w^2) w_k^2 + (1/2) w_kk]; w_T = (w_{next}(k) - w(k)) / (T_next - T), backward difference on the last slice
flat test (call-price form, finite differences): sigma_loc^2 = (C_T + (r - D) K C_K + D C) / (0.5 K^2 C_KK) with forward step in T and central steps in K on BS prices at constant sigma
forward variance_i = (w_ATM(T_{i+1}) - w_ATM(T_i)) / (T_{i+1} - T_i) at k = 0; NaN for the last expiry
steps: valuation date = options file date; S0 = daily close on or before that date; keep volume > threshold; OTM only (calls K > S0, puts K < S0)
aggregate intraday prints per (expiry, type, strike) by volume-weighted average price -> mid_price; T in years; n_options_filtered = rows after aggregation
call price from parity for puts; implied_vol per row by Newton with vega and bracket safeguard; reject prices outside no-arbitrage bounds; keep IV within the stated range
expiry selection: restrict moneyness to a 0.7-1.3 band, require >= 15 strikes, T within the stated liquid range, take the top-5 by strike count and force-include the expiry closest to 0.5y; sort by T

SVI per expiry: L-BFGS-B on mean squared total-variance error with bounds a (1e-6, max w), b (1e-4, 2), rho (-1+eps, 1-eps), m (-1, 1), s (1e-3, 2), small multi-start over rho0 and s0; svi_params.csv expiry, T, a, b, rho, m, sigma, rmse

local vol grid: 13 strikes with K/S0 in [0.90, 1.10] per expiry; local_vol = sqrt(sigma_loc^2) (NaN if non-positive); implied_vol = sqrt(w/T); local_vol_surface.csv K, T, moneyness, local_vol, implied_vol; ATM values at K = F
forward_variance.csv: T, total_variance (w at k = 0), forward_variance, local_vol_atm, implied_vol_atm; forward_var_positive = share of interior positives >= 0.9
flat_vol_test.csv: K_ratio, T, local_vol, implied_vol (constant sigma), error = |local - sigma| on K/S0 in [0.9, 1.1] and the stated maturities

implied_vol_surface.csv K, T, expiry (YYYY-MM-DD), implied_vol, option_type, mid_price; calibration.json S0, r, D, n_expiries, n_options_filtered, expiry_dates; summary.json n_grid_points, local_vol_all_positive, max_flat_vol_error, avg_svi_rmse, local_vol_atm_T050, implied_vol_atm_T050 (expiry nearest 0.5y), forward_var_positive
conventions: log-moneyness measured against the forward F, so the drift terms drop out of the Dupire formula
time derivative of total variance by forward difference to the next SVI slice at fixed k (backward on the last slice)
one quote per contract via volume-weighted aggregation before implied vol
grid kept near the money to avoid wing instability; RMSE reported in vol units
pitfalls: taking S0 from the last row of a daily file that runs past the valuation date
fitting SVI to implied vol instead of total variance breaks the analytic derivative formulas

title: Earnings surprise, SUE, YoY growth, beat/miss and company aggregates
frame: DIKETAHUI: per company-quarter actual_eps A, consensus_estimate C, std_estimate s, prior_year_eps P; beat/miss band b (as stated, in %). DITANYAKAN: per-quarter surprise_dollars, surprise_pct, sue, yoy_growth, classification; per-company summary avg_surprise_pct, avg_sue, beat_rate, avg_yoy_growth. RUMUS: surprise_dollars = A - C; surprise_pct = (A - C)/|C| * 100; sue = (A - C)/s, sue = 0 if s = 0; yoy_growth = (A - P)/|P| * 100; class = beat if surprise_pct > b, miss if < -b, else meet. JAWAB: 1) load JSON list of companies and their quarters, keep input order; 2) compute the four metrics and the class per quarter from UNROUNDED values; 3) summary = arithmetic means of the per-quarter metrics, beat_rate = n_beat / n_quarters; 4) round every float to the stated decimals; 5) write {ticker: {quarters: [...], summary: {...}}} with keys exactly as named.
formulas: surprise_dollars = actual_eps - consensus_estimate
surprise_pct = (actual_eps - consensus_estimate) / abs(consensus_estimate) * 100
sue = (actual_eps - consensus_estimate) / std_estimate ; sue = 0 when std_estimate = 0
yoy_growth = (actual_eps - prior_year_eps) / abs(prior_year_eps) * 100
beat_rate = count(classification == beat) / n_quarters
avg_x = mean over quarters of unrounded x
steps: load the earnings JSON; iterate companies in file order, quarters in file order
per quarter compute surprise_dollars, surprise_pct, sue (zero-guard on std_estimate), yoy_growth
classify with the stated band: strict > band -> beat, strict < -band -> miss, else meet; count beats
per company: avg_surprise_pct, avg_sue, avg_yoy_growth as plain means of the unrounded quarterly values; beat_rate = beats / number of quarters
round all floats to the stated decimal places only at output; keep period strings as given
create the output directory; write results.json keyed by ticker with quarters list and summary dict
conventions: aggregate from unrounded quarterly values, round only when writing
classification thresholds are strict inequalities; the equal case is meet
divide by abs() of the denominator so sign follows the numerator
zero denominators -> metric 0.0 (instruction states this for sue; the passed program applied the same guard elsewhere)
write plain Python floats/ints, not numpy types
pitfalls: rounding each quarter before averaging changes the 4th decimal of the summary

title: Lagged-correlation lead-lag pairs with Fisher gate, OOS and residual validation
frame: DIKETAHUI: daily prices of M assets, max_lag K, num_top_pairs, in_sample_end, out_of_sample_start. DITANYAKAN: significant in-sample lead-lag pairs, OOS validation and persistence, market-model betas, residual lead-lag, subperiod stability, checkpoint scalars. RUMUS: r = ln(P_t/P_{t-1}); corr_k = corrcoef(A[0:n-k], B[k:n]) for k>0, corrcoef(A[|k|:n], B[0:n-|k|]) for k<0; c_ab = max_{k=1..K} corr_k, c_ba = max_{k=-K..-1}; asym = c_ab - c_ba; leader = A iff asym >= 0; dz = |atanh c_ab - atanh c_ba|, SE = sqrt(2/(n_obs-3)), significant iff dz > z_crit(5% two-sided) SE; e_i = r_i - (alpha_i + beta_i r_mkt) fitted in-sample. JAWAB: 1) sort, log returns, split on return dates; 2) all pairs via combinations in column order; 3) sort |asym| desc; top = significant head(num_top_pairs); 4) OOS rank and same_sign per top pair; 5) residualise with the in-sample fit; repeat; 6) subperiods by calendar year; 7) write.
formulas: r_t = ln(P_t / P_{t-1}); split masks on return dates: is = date <= in_sample_end, oos = date >= out_of_sample_start
corr_at_lag_k = np.corrcoef(A[t], B[t+k]); slices k>0: A[0:n-k], B[k:n]; k<0: A[|k|:n], B[0:n-|k|]
asymmetry = max_{k=1..K} corr_k - max_{k=-K..-1} corr_k; leader = etf_a iff asymmetry >= 0
significant iff |atanh(c_ab) - atanh(c_ba)| > z_crit * sqrt(2/(n_obs-3)), corr clipped to ±(1 - 1e-6), n_obs = return days of the period
market model r_i = alpha + beta r_SPY + e via lstsq with ones column, in-sample only; r2 = 1 - SSR/SST
annualized return = sum(log returns) / ((last_date - first_date).days / 365.25) on the full return series
sign_consistency_rate = same_sign_count / n_top; avg_rank_shift = mean |rank_is - rank_oos|; avg_abs_asymmetry_ratio = mean |asym_oos|/|asym_is|
steps: read prices, sort by date; etf columns in file order; num_trading_days = rows, num_return_days = rows - 1; log returns with return dates; split masks
per pair from itertools.combinations: lag dict over -K..K, corr_lag0, corr_a_leads_b, corr_b_leads_a, asymmetry, leader, lagger, significance flag
in-sample table of all pairs sorted by abs(asymmetry) desc -> lead_lag_results.csv (etf_a, etf_b, corr_lag0, corr_a_leads_b, corr_b_leads_a, asymmetry, leader, lagger, lag_-K..lag_K)
top_lead_lag_pairs = significant rows head(num_top_pairs); num_significant_pairs = count significant

OOS table on OOS returns; oos_rank = 1-based position by abs(asymmetry); per top pair: ranks, leaders, asymmetries, same_sign = leaders equal; persistence summary incl. num_pairs_still_top10 = count(oos_rank <= num_top_pairs)
market model per non-market ETF in-sample; alpha, beta, r_squared; residuals for in-sample, OOS and each calendar year with the same coefficients
residual lead-lag on non-market pairs: table (residual_lead_lag_results.csv), significant top list, OOS validation, persistence, subperiod validation per year with both-years flag
signal_assessment: raw_persists_oos = rate > 0.5; residual_improves_persistence = residual same_sign_count >= raw
write results.json; solution.json intermediates {name: {value}} copying scalars without re-rounding
conventions: round correlation-based outputs to 6 decimals; counts int; same_sign JSON booleans
split by RETURN date; first return date is the in-sample start
pairs in itertools.combinations column order; keys A__B
annualised return = realised compound log return per calendar year, not mean * factor
pitfalls: OOS rank is over ALL pairs; the top list is filtered by significance first
never refit the market model on OOS or subperiod data

title: ETF top-N holdings overlap, redemption scenario sell pressure, bridge and rankings
frame: DIKETAHUI: per fund f holdings (ticker, weight %, shares), product data (TNA, NAV, close, shares outstanding SO, volume V, net cash, premium/discount), scenarios with pct_f, top-N. DITANYAKAN: snapshot, universe, scenario sells, summary, bridge, buckets, rankings, JSON. RUMUS: w = weight/100; holding$ = TNA_f w; implied price = holding$/shares; reconciled = sum holding$/sum shares; sell_sh_f = pct_f shares_f, sell$_f = pct_f holding$_f; HHI = sum share^2; turnover = V/SO; cash_bps = cash/TNA 1e4; redeemed sh = pct_f SO, nav$ = sh NAV, mkt$ = sh close; capture = topN sell$/nav$; pd_bps = (mkt$ - nav$)/nav$ 1e4. formulas: weight_dec = weight_pct/100; holding_dollars_f = TNA_f * weight_dec; implied_price_f = holding_dollars_f / shares_held_f; reconciled_price = combined dollars / combined shares
share_turnover = volume / shares_outstanding; cash_buffer_bps = net_cash / TNA * 1e4; topN_hhi = sum w^2 of raw decimal weights
sell_shares_f = pct_f * shares_held_f; sell_dollars_f = pct_f * holding_dollars_f; pct_combined_holdings = combined sell shares / combined shares
constituent_hhi = sum (sell_i / total)^2; overlap_share_of_total = overlap sell dollars / total
redeemed_fund_shares = pct_f * SO_f; nav dollars = * NAV; market dollars = * close; pct of volume = shares / V_f; capture = topN sell dollars_f / nav dollars; pd_transfer_bps = (mkt - nav)/nav * 1e4
money string with K/M/B suffix -> value * 1e3/1e6/1e9; percent string -> /100
steps: read holdings xlsx header=None; header row where first cell is 'Name'; drop ticker '-', futures, non-positive weight/shares; weight /100
read product sheet; header row containing 'Ticker'; parse money/percent strings; as_of_date -> YYYY-MM-DD
top N per fund (weight desc, ticker asc); snapshot row per fund; sort by ticker

universe = union; per fund flags, shares, weight, implied price (blank if absent), dollars (0 if absent); overlap_flag, sums, overlap_weight_min = min(w) if overlap else 0; sort overlap desc, dollars desc, ticker
per scenario in file order: sells per fund and combined, pct of holdings/dollars; sort dollars desc, ticker asc
scenario_summary: totals by category, overlap share, HHI, top ticker, top overlap ticker, integer counts >= each threshold
bridge per fund (scenario order, ticker asc); decomposition buckets overlap, spy_only, xlk_only with largest ticker
rankings: rank by dollars; rank by pct sorted pct desc, dollars desc, ticker; category; is_top_overlap_name
summary.json: metric_winners argmax tickers, largest constituent, largest overlap_weight_min ticker, fund_bridge_extremes, scenario_winners keyed by scenario
conventions: weights/ratios as decimals; only *_bps scaled
dollar amounts as plain numbers
exposures outside a fund top-N are zero; implied price blank
scenario file order everywhere; HHI on raw weights

cells above the header may be NaN: str() before regex

title: Market-model event study: AR, CAR, CAAR, Corrado rank and Kolari-Pynnonen BMP
frame: DIKETAHUI: stock and market prices, events; estimation length L0, gap g, half-width w, min obs m. DITANYAKAN: alpha, beta, R2, n_obs; AR_t; CAR full/pre/event/post; CAAR; Corrado z (window, day 0); KP rho_bar, adjusted BMP t. RUMUS: r = ln(P_t/P_{t-1}); inner-merge on date; p0 = event position; est = [p0-(L0+g-1), p0-g]; lstsq r = a + b rm; AR_t = r_t - (a + b rm_t); CAAR_t = mean_i AR_it; Corrado U = rank(pooled e, AR)/(T+1) - 0.5, Ubar_t cross-event mean, S = sqrt(sum Ubar_t^2 / D), D = L0+g+w, z0 = Ubar_0/S, zw = sum_win Ubar/(sqrt(2w+1) S); SAR = AR/(s sqrt C), s^2 = SSR/(L-2), C = 1 + 1/L + (rm_t - rm_bar)^2/sum(rm_est - rm_bar)^2; BMP t = mean z/(sd(z,ddof=1)/sqrt N); t_KP = t_BMP sqrt((1-rho)/(1+(N-1)rho)). JAWAB: 1) returns, merge; 2) per event validity, OLS, AR, CAR; 3) CAAR; 4) tests; 5) write.
formulas: r_t = ln(P_t/P_{t-1}), first row dropped; inner merge stock and market on date
estimation = merged positions [p0-(L0+g-1), p0-g]; event window = [p0-w, p0+w]; valid iff >= m estimation obs and all window days exist
lstsq(X=[1, rm], y, rcond=None); r2 = 1 - SSR/SST; AR_t = r_t - (alpha + beta rm_t); car_full = sum AR; car_pre = sum AR[-w..-1]; car_event = AR[0]; car_post = sum AR[1..w]

Corrado: K = average rank of [est residuals, event ARs]; U = K/(T+1) - 0.5; Ubar_t = mean over events; S(U) = sqrt(sum_t Ubar_t^2 / D), D = full span L0+g+w (gap days count); z_day0 = Ubar_0/S; z_window = sum_window Ubar_t/(sqrt(2w+1) S)
Patell SAR_it = AR_it/(s_i sqrt(1 + 1/L_i + (rm_t - rm_bar)^2/sum(rm_est - rm_bar)^2)), s_i^2 = SSR_i/(L_i-2); CSAR_i = sum_t SAR_it/sqrt(2w+1)
BMP t = mean(z)/(std(z, ddof=1)/sqrt(N)); rho_bar = mean pairwise corr of estimation residuals on common dates (>= 10 overlaps); t_KP = t_BMP sqrt((1-rho_bar)/(1+(N-1)rho_bar))
steps: read CSVs with parsed dates, sort; log returns for market and each stock (dropna first)
per event: inner-merge; p0 = index of event_date; skip if window outside range or estimation obs < m; lstsq fit, residuals, R2, AR
append params (ticker, event_date, alpha, beta, r_squared, n_obs), AR rows (relative_day, date, ar) and CAR row; write the three CSVs with the stated float format
CAAR per relative day; caar_summary.json: num_events, caar_by_day keyed by day string, caar_full, caar_pre, caar_post
Corrado: pooled ranks per event, estimation right-aligned to day -g, event part on -w..w, nanmean per day, S over the full span, z stats
Patell SAR per event; day-0 vector and window CSAR; BMP t each
rho_bar; KP factor; statistical_tests.json: corrado_z_full, corrado_z_day0, kp_rho_bar, kp_t_full, kp_t_day0
conventions: relative days = positions in the merged trading-day index
dates YYYY-MM-DD; floats rounded as stated
skipped events excluded everywhere; no padding
std ddof=1 in BMP; s_i^2 uses L-2
KP uses the full factor with the (1 - rho_bar) numerator
pitfalls: S(U) over only populated days shrinks Corrado z by a few percent
window and day-0 stats off by the same ratio -> shared scale term is wrong

title: POT-GPD, Hill, GARCH-EVT VaR/ES with rolling backtest and coverage tests
frame: DIKETAHUI: closes; threshold_quantile q_u, confidence_levels p, backtest_window W, backtest_level, garch_evt_threshold_quantile q_g. DITANYAKAN: var/es per level for historical, normal, evt, garch_evt; violations, Kupiec/Christoffersen/CC stats and p-values; intermediates. RUMUS: L = -ln(P_t/P_{t-1}); u = quantile(L, q_u, lower); y = L[L>u] - u; (xi, sigma) = genpareto.fit(y, floc=0); Hill xi_H = mean(ln L_(1..k)) - ln L_(k+1), k = floor sqrt N; hist VaR = lower quantile, ES = mean(L >= VaR); normal VaR = mu + sd z_p, ES = mu + sd phi(z_p)/(1-p); evt VaR = u + sigma/xi [(N/N_u (1-p))^(-xi) - 1], ES = VaR/(1-xi) + (sigma - xi u)/(1-xi); GARCH on 100 r, z = r/sigma_t, POT on -z at q_g, VaR = sigma_T VaR_z. JAWAB: 1) full-sample fits; 2) four methods per level; 3) roll W, refit per window, violation L_t > VaR; 4) LR tests, 0 ln 0 = 0, p = chi2.sf; 5) write.
formulas: loss L_t = -ln(P_t/P_{t-1}); every quantile np.quantile(x, q, method='lower'); std ddof=1
POT: u = quantile(L, q_u); y = L[L > u] - u; xi, loc, sigma = scipy.stats.genpareto.fit(y, floc=0)
Hill: k = floor(sqrt(N)); L sorted desc; xi_H = mean(ln L[0:k]) - ln L[k]
VaR_evt(p) = u + sigma/xi ((N/N_u (1-p))^(-xi) - 1); ES_evt = VaR/(1-xi) + (sigma - xi u)/(1-xi)
Historical VaR = lower quantile, ES = mean(L >= VaR); Normal VaR = mu + sd z_p, ES = mu + sd pdf(z_p)/(1-p)

GARCH-EVT: arch_model(100 r, mean='Zero', vol='GARCH', p=1, q=1, dist='Normal').fit(disp='off'); sigma_t = cond_vol/100; omega/1e4; z = r/sigma_t; POT on -z at q_g; VaR = scale * VaR_z, scale = last cond vol (full sample) or sqrt(1-step forecast variance)/100 (backtest)

Kupiec LR_uc = -2[x ln a + (T-x) ln(1-a) - x ln pi - (T-x) ln(1-pi)], a = 1-level, pi = x/T; Christoffersen LR_ind = -2[l(pi) - l(pi01, pi11)] from n00,n01,n10,n11; LR_cc = LR_uc + LR_ind; p = chi2.sf (1 df; cc 2 df)
steps: read prices sorted by date; r, L = -r, N
full-sample POT at q_u: u, excesses, genpareto.fit(floc=0), N_u; Hill with k = floor(sqrt(N))
GARCH(1,1) zero-mean on 100 r; cond vol /100; standardised losses; POT at q_g; sigma_T = last cond vol
per level: historical, normal, evt, garch_evt VaR/ES; keys var_{lvl}_{method}, es_{lvl}_{method}, lvl = digits after the decimal point
rolling t = W..N-1 on L[t-W:t], r[t-W:t]: historical quantile, normal, POT refit, GARCH refit with 1-step forecast; violation = L_t > VaR; T = N - W
per method: violations, Kupiec LR/p, Christoffersen LR/p, CC LR/p; backtest_num_days = T

write results.json; solution.json intermediates (num_returns, mean/std log return, threshold_value, num_exceedances, mean_excess, gpd_shape_xi, gpd_scale_sigma, hill_xi, garch omega/alpha/beta/persistence/last_vol in decimal units)
conventions: VaR/ES positive loss magnitudes
lower quantile everywhere; exceedances and violations strict >; historical ES uses >=
level key: repr(level).split('.')[1]
GARCH intermediates in decimal units after undoing x100
0 ln 0 = 0; p-values are chi2 survival functions
pitfalls: genpareto.fit returns (shape, loc, scale)
rolling GARCH refits take minutes; keep the loop lean

title: RiskMetrics EWMA covariance, parametric VaR and Euler risk decomposition
frame: DIKETAHUI: daily simple returns R (T x n) for assets in the params order, decay lambda, confidence level c, weights w, annualization factor A, estimation_window_days E (all from params). DITANYAKAN: portfolio_daily_vol, var at level c, annualized_vol; covariance elements, portfolio variance, marginal, component and pct risk per asset. RUMUS: use the last E rows; Sigma_0 = r_0 r_0^T; Sigma_t = lambda Sigma_{t-1} + (1 - lambda) r_t r_t^T (outer product, no demeaning); var_p = w^T Sigma w; sigma_p = sqrt(var_p); VaR = z_c sigma_p with z_c = norm.ppf(c); marginal = Sigma w / sigma_p; component = w * marginal; pct = component / sigma_p; ann vol = sigma_p sqrt(A). JAWAB: 1) read params and ALL of them; 2) slice window; 3) recursion; 4) portfolio quantities; 5) decomposition; 6) write both JSONs.
formulas: Sigma_0 = outer(r_0, r_0); Sigma_t = lambda * Sigma_{t-1} + (1 - lambda) * outer(r_t, r_t) over the last estimation_window_days returns
portfolio_variance = w @ Sigma @ w; portfolio_daily_vol = sqrt(portfolio_variance)
var_parametric = scipy.stats.norm.ppf(confidence_level) * portfolio_daily_vol
annualized_vol = portfolio_daily_vol * sqrt(annualization_factor)
marginal_risk = (Sigma @ w) / portfolio_daily_vol; component_risk = w * marginal_risk; pct_risk_contribution = component_risk / portfolio_daily_vol (sums to 1)
steps: load params: lambda, confidence_level, weights, annualization_factor, assets (ordered) and estimation_window_days; load returns and select columns in the assets order
take the most recent estimation_window_days rows (all rows if fewer)
initialise Sigma with the outer product of the first window return; iterate the EWMA recursion over the remaining rows using the raw returns (no mean subtraction)
extract the requested covariance entries by 0-based index (ewma_cov_i_j)
portfolio variance/vol, z from norm.ppf, VaR, annualised vol
marginal, component and percentage contributions keyed by asset name
write results.json and solution.json intermediates as plain floats
conventions: no demeaning before the EWMA recursion
rank-1 update is the outer product r r^T, not the elementwise square
z-score from scipy.stats.norm.ppf, not a hard-coded constant
every params.json key is used; an ignored parameter (e.g. estimation window) is itself a bug
component contributions sum to portfolio vol; percentages sum to 1
pitfalls: seeding Sigma with the sample covariance or zeros instead of the first outer product changes the result

title: FF3 OLS with Newey-West HAC, GRS joint alpha test, VIF, rolling betas and charts
frame: DIKETAHUI: prices for N stocks, decimal factors F = [Mkt-RF, SMB, HML], RF, periods per year A, rolling window Wr, K = 3. DITANYAKAN: per stock alpha, betas, R2, adj R2, OLS and HAC t/p, DW, IR, Treynor, annual excess, rolling beta stats; ranking; GRS; VIF; files, charts. RUMUS: y = pct_change - RF on common dates; X = [1, F]; b = lstsq; SE = sqrt(diag(SSR/(n-K-1) (X'X)^-1)); L = floor(4 (n/100)^(2/9)); S = X' diag(e^2) X + sum_j w_j (G_j + G_j'), G_j = sum_t e_t e_{t-j} x_t x_{t-j}', w_j = 1 - j/(L+1); V = (X'X)^-1 S (X'X)^-1; p = 2(1 - t.cdf(|t|, n-K-1)); DW = sum diff(e)^2/sum e^2; IR = alpha_ann/(std(e, ddof=1) sqrt A); GRS = (T-N-K)/N a' Sig^-1 a/(1 + mu' Om^-1 mu), Sig = E'E/T, Om = Ft'Ft/T; VIF = 1/(1 - R2_aux). JAWAB: 1) align; 2) OLS per stock; 3) HAC; 4) metrics; 5) GRS, VIF; 6) rolling lstsq; 7) write, plot.

title: Compound Poisson aggregate loss by FFT characteristic-function inversion vs Monte Carlo

VaR_a = first grid x with cumsum(g) >= a; ES_a = sum_{x_k > VaR} x_k g_k / sum_{x_k > VaR} g_k

title: Running max/min and first passage of drifted Brownian motion with MC check
frame: DIKETAHUI: closes; r, D given; barrier ratios H/S0, L/S0; horizons T; FPT grid; N_paths; dt = 1/252; seed. DITANYAKAN: S0, sigma, mu_rn; P(max S >= H), P(min S <= L) analytical vs MC; FPT CDFs; E[tau_H]; joint P(S_T <= S0, max <= H); monotonicity flags. RUMUS: sigma = std(diff ln P, ddof=1) sqrt 252; mu = r - D - sigma^2/2; b = ln(H/S0) > 0: P(max X < b) = N((b - mu T)/(s rt)) - exp(2 mu b/s^2) N((-b - mu T)/(s rt)), rt = sigma sqrt T; a = ln(L/S0) < 0: P(min X > a) = N(-(a - mu T)/rt) - exp(2 mu a/s^2) N((a + mu T)/rt); P(tau_H <= t) = 1 - P(max X < b); E[tau_H] = b/mu (mu > 0); joint P(X_T <= x, M_T <= b) = N((x - mu T)/rt) - exp(2 mu b/s^2) N((x - 2b - mu T)/rt). JAWAB: 1) calibrate; 2) analytical tables; 3) simulate log paths with np.random.seed, prefix S0; 4) MC on the first round(T/dt) steps; 5) FPT = first hit index dt else inf; 6) summary; 7) write.

P(min X > a) = Phi(-(a - mu T)/(sigma sqrt T)) - exp(2 mu a/sigma^2) Phi((a + mu T)/(sigma sqrt T)), a < 0; P(min S <= L) = 1 - that, a = ln(L/S0)
P(tau_H <= t) = P(max_{s<=t} X_s >= b); P(tau_L <= t) = P(min <= a); E[tau_H] = b/mu for mu > 0
joint P(X_T <= x, M_T <= b) = Phi((x - mu T)/(sigma sqrt T)) - exp(2 mu b/sigma^2) Phi((x - 2b - mu T)/(sigma sqrt T)), x = 0 for S_T <= S0

title: Lexicon tone surprise, TF-IDF novelty, yield event panel, OLS/HAC, influence diagnostics

title: Log-OU with Poisson jumps: AR(1) calibration, jump detection, moments, MC, forwards
frame: DIKETAHUI: rate series (percent), dt = 1/252, jump z threshold z*, horizons tau, N_paths, seed. DITANYAKAN: calibration (kappa, theta, sigma, lambda, mu_J, sigma_J, n_jumps, x0, S0, stationary mean/var, data stats), moments vs MC, forwards with/without jumps, summary. RUMUS: rate = pct/100 > 0; X = ln rate; OLS X_{t+1} = a + b X_t + eps; kappa = -ln b/dt; theta = a/(1-b); sigma^2 = Var(eps, ddof=1) 2 kappa/(1 - b^2); z = eps/std eps; jump iff |z| > z*; lambda = n_j/(n_changes dt); mu_J, sigma_J = mean, std(ddof=1) of flagged eps; e = exp(-kappa tau); E[X] = theta + (x0 - theta) e + lambda mu_J (1-e)/kappa; Var[X] = (sigma^2 + lambda (mu_J^2 + sigma_J^2))(1 - e^2)/(2 kappa); stationary theta + lambda mu_J/kappa, (sigma^2 + lambda E J^2)/(2 kappa); E[S] = exp(m + v/2), Var[S] = (e^v - 1) exp(2m + v); F = exp(m + v/2), OU forward with lambda = 0. JAWAB: 1) clean, log; 2) AR(1); 3) jumps; 4) moments; 5) Euler MC; 6) forwards; 7) summary.
formulas: AR(1) X_{t+1} = a + b X_t + eps (lstsq or ar1_fit); kappa = -ln(b)/dt; theta = a/(1-b); sigma = sqrt(var(eps, ddof=1) 2 kappa/(1 - b^2)) (ou_from_ar1)
z = eps/std(eps, ddof=1); jump iff |z| > z*; lambda = n_jumps/(n_changes dt); mu_J = mean(eps[jump]); sigma_J = std(eps[jump], ddof=1) (0 if < 2)
E[X_tau|x0] = theta + (x0 - theta) e^{-kappa tau} + lambda mu_J (1 - e^{-kappa tau})/kappa
Var[X_tau|x0] = (sigma^2 + lambda (mu_J^2 + sigma_J^2))(1 - e^{-2 kappa tau})/(2 kappa); stationary mean = theta + lambda mu_J/kappa; var = (sigma^2 + lambda (mu_J^2 + sigma_J^2))/(2 kappa)
E[S] = exp(m + v/2); Var[S] = (exp v - 1) exp(2m + v); F_jd = exp(m + v/2); F_ou = same with lambda = 0 in m and v
Euler: x += kappa (theta - x) dt + sigma sqrt(dt) Z + n_j mu_J + sqrt(n_j) sigma_J Z', n_j ~ Poisson(lambda dt)
half_life = ln2/kappa; feller = 2 kappa theta/sigma^2; jump_impact = |F_jd(1) - F_ou(1)|/F_ou(1)
steps: read rates; to_numeric(errors='coerce'), dropna, /100, keep > 0; X = log; n_obs, n_changes = n_obs - 1; mean/std (ddof=1) of rate and log rate
AR(1) of X[1:] on X[:-1] with intercept; invert to kappa, theta, sigma
residuals from the same fit; standardise; flag; lambda, mu_J, sigma_J, n_jumps; x0 = X[-1], S0 = exp(x0); stationary moments
analytical E_X, Var_X per horizon; E_S, Var_S lognormal
np.random.seed(seed); per horizon N_paths with round(tau/dt) Euler steps incl. jumps; E_X_mc mean, Var_X_mc var(ddof=1)
conditional_moments.csv: tau, E_X, Var_X, E_S, Var_S, E_X_mc, Var_X_mc; forward_curve.csv: tau, forward_rate_jd, forward_rate_ou

calibration.json and summary.json (kappa, theta, sigma, lambda_annual, half_life_years, stationary_vol_X, feller_ratio, max rel errors, jump_impact_on_forward at tau = 1, mean_reversion_confirmed = kappa > 0 and half-life < 20, jumps_detected = n_jumps > 0)
conventions: sigma from the exact OU conditional-variance inversion, not sqrt(var(eps)/dt)
jump residuals from the original fit; no refit after flagging
OU forward sets lambda = 0 in both drift and variance
std ddof=1 throughout; booleans as JSON booleans
pitfalls: theta is negative for log-rates so the Feller ratio is negative; report as is

title: Clean dirty daily returns with audit counts, then historical equal-weight VaR
frame: DIKETAHUI: raw daily simple-return file (date + N asset columns; dirty: header spaces, mixed date formats, non-trading dates, duplicate dates, outliers, NaN) and an authoritative trading-calendar file; equal weights 1/N rebalanced daily; confidence levels c as stated; outlier threshold x as stated. DITANYAKAN: per-step removal counts, cleaned row count, daily historical VaR at each c, worst day return and date. RUMUS: r_p,t = (1/N) sum_i r_i,t; VaR_c = -Q_{1-c}(r_p) with Q the linear-interpolated empirical quantile (numpy percentile, method linear, argument on the 0-100 scale); worst = min_t r_p,t. JAWAB: 1) count raw rows, strip headers 2) parse each date element-wise with explicit formats to YYYY-MM-DD 3) drop dates not in calendar (count) 4) drop duplicate dates keep last in file order (count) 5) drop rows with any |r| > x, NaN never an outlier (count) 6) drop rows with any NaN (count) 7) sort by date 8) portfolio row mean, VaR, worst day 9) write JSON with int counts and float VaR; counts must reconcile.
formulas: r_p,t = (1/N) * sum_i r_i,t  (daily rebalanced equal weights, simple returns, no log conversion)
VaR_c = -np.percentile(r_p, 100*(1-c), method='linear')  (positive loss, daily, no annualisation)
worst_day_return = min_t r_p,t ; worst_day_date = date at argmin (first occurrence)
n_rows_after_cleaning = n_rows_raw - n_non_trading - n_duplicates - n_outliers - n_missing

steps: load raw CSV and calendar CSV; strip whitespace from column names; n_rows_raw = row count of the raw file before any drop
parse the date column element-wise with explicit formats (ISO, MM/DD/YYYY, DD-Mon-YY) to zero-padded YYYY-MM-DD strings; assert zero unparsed
convert calendar dates to the same string form; keep rows whose date is in the calendar set; record n_non_trading_days_removed
drop_duplicates(subset=date, keep='last') in original file order (do not sort first); record n_duplicates_removed

title: Hull-White 1F: caplet calibration, Jamshidian swaptions, trinomial tree, Bermudans
frame: DIKETAHUI: discount-factor pillars P(0,T_i); caplet strike K_c, accrual d, expiries T2 with market prices; swaption specs (T0, tenor, d); tree steps per year and horizon; optimiser bounds and start as stated. DITANYAKAN: (a, sigma), RMSE in bps, ATM rates, Jamshidian prices, tree European and Bermudan prices, DV01, exercise boundary, consistency flags. RUMUS: B=(1-e^{-a(T-t)})/a; lnA = ln(P_T/P_t) + B f(0,t) - sigma^2 (1-e^{-2at}) B^2/(4a); P_HW = A e^{-B r}; ZBP from sigma_p and h; caplet = (1+K d) ZBP(T1,T2,1/(1+K d)); K_swap = (P_T0 - P_Tn)/sum d P_Ti; Jamshidian: solve sum c_i P_HW(T0,Ti,r*) = 1, price = sum c_i ZBP(0,T0,Ti,P_HW(T0,Ti,r*)); tree dx = sigma sqrt(3 dt), jmax = ceil(0.184/(a dt)), alpha_m from Arrow-Debreu. JAWAB: 1) curve log-linear in DF, right-hand forward 2) calibrate L-BFGS-B on SSE 3) ATM rates 4) Jamshidian 5) tree + AD check 6) backward induction, exercise = max(1 - sum_{Ti>t_k} c_i P_HW, 0) 7) DV01 by one-bp curve bump 8) write files.
formulas: sigma_p = sigma sqrt((1-e^{-2aT})/(2a)) B(T,S) ; h = ln(P(0,S)/(P(0,T) X))/sigma_p + sigma_p/2 ; ZBP = X P(0,T) N(-h+sigma_p) - P(0,S) N(-h)
caplet(T1,T2) = (1 + K_c d) ZBP(0,T1,T2, 1/(1+K_c d)) ; RMSE_bps = sqrt(mean((model-market)^2)) * 1e4
K_swap = (P(0,T0) - P(0,Tn)) / sum_i d P(0,T_i) ; c_i = K d, c_n = 1 + K d
Jamshidian: r* solves sum c_i P_HW(T0,Ti,r*) = 1 (brentq); payer = sum c_i ZBP(0,T0,Ti,X_i = P_HW(T0,Ti,r*))

tree: dt = 1/steps, dx = sigma sqrt(3 dt), jmax = max(1, ceil(0.184/(a dt))), M = -a dt; pu = 1/6 + (j^2M^2 + jM)/2, pm = 2/3 - j^2M^2, pd = 1/6 + (j^2M^2 - jM)/2; top/bottom nodes use the mirrored 7/6, -1/3 branches
alpha_m = [ln sum_j Q_m(j) e^{-j dx dt} - ln P(0,(m+1)dt)]/dt ; Q_{m+1}(k) = sum_j Q_m(j) p(j->k) e^{-(alpha_m + j dx) dt} ; check sum_j Q_n(j) = P(0,t_n)
exercise(t_k, j) = max(1 - sum_{Ti > t_k} c_i P_HW(t_k,Ti, alpha_{n_k} + j dx), 0) ; V = max(exercise, e^{-r dt}(pu V_u + pm V_m + pd V_d)) at exercise steps
steps: load market_data.json; build curve from DF pillars: ln P linear in t (piecewise-flat forwards) anchored at P(0,0)=1, flat-forward extrapolation; f(0,t) by right-hand finite difference

calibrate (a, sigma): minimise sum of squared caplet errors with scipy minimize L-BFGS-B, stated bounds and start; rmse_bps; write calibration.json (a, sigma, rmse_bps, caplets[expiry, market_price, model_price, diff_bps])
yield_curve.csv: maturity, discount_factor, zero_rate = -lnP/T, forward_rate at each pillar
for each swaption: payment dates T0 + k d; atm_rate; Jamshidian analytical price and r_star
build trinomial tree (Tree class): geometry, branch probabilities, Arrow-Debreu alphas; tree_diagnostics.csv with zcb_tree = sum Q at pillar step, zcb_market, abs_diff

European on tree = single exercise at T0; Bermudan = exercise at every coupon date T0 + k d except the last payment; backward induction with per-step alpha and strictly-after payments; boundary j_star = smallest j with exercise > continuation and > 0, r_star = alpha + j_star dx
DV01: bump every zero rate by one bp, rebuild curve and tree with the same (a, sigma) and strike, (bumped - base) * 1e4

write swaption_prices.json (expiry, tenor, atm_rate, r_star, analytical_price, analytical_bps, tree_price, tree_bps, tree_analytical_diff_bps, dv01_bps_per_bp, payment_dates), bermudan_prices.json (european_tree_bps, bermudan_bps, premium_bps, premium_pct, exercise_boundary[date, j_star, r_star]), calibration_fit.png (market vs model bps, Agg backend), summary.json flags incl. all_checks_passed
conventions: discount factors interpolated log-linearly (piecewise-flat instantaneous forwards), P(0,0)=1, flat-forward extrapolation beyond the last pillar
instantaneous forward at a pillar uses the right-hand difference, never a central one
coupons fixed at the original ATM strike; exercise value sums only payments strictly after t_k; each exercise step uses its own alpha_{n_k}

OUTPUT_DIR env var with the default the task states; floats cast to Python float

title: Closed-form implied-vol approximations vs Newton-Raphson on a BS price grid
frame: DIKETAHUI: S0, r, dividend yield D, grids of sigma_true, T, moneyness m (K = m S0); European calls. DITANYAKAN: BS price per grid point, implied vol by each approximation (ATM-only methods NaN off-ATM), Newton benchmark, errors, RMSE per method, max/mean abs errors, convergence flag. RUMUS: S~ = S0 e^{-DT}, K~ = K e^{-rT}, C = S~ N(d1) - K~ N(d2); Brenner-Subrahmanyam sigma = sqrt(2 pi/T) C/S~; Li ATM: alpha = sqrt(2 pi) C/S~, z = cos(arccos(3 alpha/sqrt(32))/3), sigma = [2 sqrt2 z - sqrt(8 z^2 - 6 alpha/(sqrt2 z))]/sqrt T; Li non-ATM two-regime with eta = K~/S~, c = C/S~; Corrado-Miller-Hallerbach quadratic; Newton sigma_{n+1} = sigma_n - (C(sigma_n) - V)/vega. JAWAB: 1) loop grid, compute V_mkt 2) apply each method, NaN where not applicable 3) vectorised Newton on all points 4) error = sigma_approx - sigma_true 5) sort (sigma_true, T, moneyness) 6) write CSV at 10 dp and summary.json.
formulas: S~ = S0 e^{-D T} ; K~ = K e^{-r T} ; d1 = [ln(S~/K~) + sigma^2 T/2]/(sigma sqrt T) ; C = S~ N(d1) - K~ N(d1 - sigma sqrt T) ; vega = S~ phi(d1) sqrt T
Brenner-Subrahmanyam (ATM only): sigma = sqrt(2 pi / T) * C / S~

Li ATM: alpha = sqrt(2 pi) C/S~ ; arg = 3 alpha/sqrt(32), NaN if |arg|>1 ; z = cos(arccos(arg)/3) ; disc = 8 z^2 - 6 alpha/(sqrt2 z) (clip to 0 if within 1e-10 of zero, else NaN) ; sigma = (2 sqrt2 z - sqrt(disc))/sqrt T

Li non-ATM: eta = K~/S~, c = C/S~, alpha = sqrt(2 pi)/(1+eta) (2c + eta - 1), rho = |eta - 1|/c^2 ; rho <= 1.4 -> Li cubic with this alpha ; else sigma = [alpha + sqrt(alpha^2 - 4 (eta-1)^2/(1+eta))]/(2 sqrt T), same discriminant clip rule
Corrado-Miller-Hallerbach: a = 2C + K~ - S~ ; disc = a^2 - 1.85 (S~+K~)(K~-S~)^2/(pi sqrt(K~ S~)) floored at 0 ; sigma = sqrt(2 pi)/(2 (S~+K~)) (a + sqrt(disc))/sqrt T
Newton: sigma_{n+1} = sigma_n - (C(sigma_n) - V)/vega(sigma_n) from the stated start; converged when all(|sigma_{n+1} - sigma_n| < tol) within max iterations
error = sigma_approx - sigma_true ; RMSE = sqrt(mean(error^2)) over non-NaN points only
steps: for each (sigma_true, T, m): K = m S0, S~, K~, bs_price = BS call with dividend yield (qf_toolkit bs_price(S, K, T, r, sigma, kind='call', q=D) is equivalent)
sigma_bs_approx and sigma_li_atm only where moneyness is 1 (np.isclose), NaN otherwise
sigma_li_nonatm and sigma_cmh on every point with the discriminant rules
sigma_newton: vectorised Newton over all points at once from the stated initial guess; track a single converged flag = all(|step| < tol) reached
error_<method> = sigma_<method> - sigma_true for bs, li_atm, li_nonatm, cmh, newton

sort by (sigma_true, T, moneyness) ascending; write approximations.csv with columns sigma_true,T,K,moneyness,bs_price,sigma_bs_approx,sigma_li_atm,sigma_li_nonatm,sigma_cmh,sigma_newton,error_bs,error_li_atm,error_li_nonatm,error_cmh,error_newton using float_format %.10f

summary.json: n_points, n_atm_points, rmse_bs_atm, rmse_li_atm, rmse_li_nonatm, rmse_cmh, rmse_newton (RMSE over non-NaN), max_abs_error_li_nonatm, max_abs_error_cmh (nanmax), mean_abs_error_cmh (nanmean), all_newton_converged (bool)
conventions: forward-discounted inputs S~ and K~ in every approximation; dividend yield enters through S~
NaN for non-applicable methods and out-of-domain points; RMSE excludes NaN
numeric CSV columns at 10 decimal places; rows sorted (sigma_true, T, moneyness)
Newton convergence is a global criterion over all points, not per point
OUTPUT_DIR env var with the default the task states
pitfalls: Li non-ATM has several published forms; the two-regime version above with NaN beyond the clip tolerance is the one that passed
clipping every negative discriminant to zero (instead of NaN beyond tolerance) changes rmse_li_nonatm

title: Black caplet/floorlet pricing: cap, floor, swap value, put-call parity
frame: DIKETAHUI: forward rates f_i, flat Black vol, strike K, notional, period length delta, discount factors df_i to each payment time. DITANYAKAN: caplet_i, floorlet_i, cap, floor, swap value, parity error. RUMUS: fixing T_i = (i-1) delta; d1 = [ln(f_i/K) + vol^2 T_i/2]/(vol sqrt T_i), d2 = d1 - vol sqrt T_i; caplet_i = N delta df_i (f_i N(d1) - K N(d2)); floorlet_i = N delta df_i (K N(-d2) - f_i N(-d1)); first period (T_1 = 0): intrinsic N delta df_1 max(f_1 - K, 0) and max(K - f_1, 0); cap = sum caplets; floor = sum floorlets; swap = N delta sum df_i (f_i - K); parity = cap - floor - swap. JAWAB: 1) load params 2) fixing times 3) loop periods with the T=0 special case 4) sums, swap, parity 5) round as stated and write results.json.
formulas: T_i = (i-1) * delta  (fixing time, not payment time); T_1 = 0
d1_i = (ln(f_i/K) + 0.5 vol^2 T_i)/(vol sqrt(T_i)) ; d2_i = d1_i - vol sqrt(T_i)
caplet_i = N * delta * df_i * (f_i N(d1_i) - K N(d2_i)) ; caplet_1 = N delta df_1 max(f_1 - K, 0)
floorlet_i = N * delta * df_i * (K N(-d2_i) - f_i N(-d1_i)) ; floorlet_1 = N delta df_1 max(K - f_1, 0)
cap = sum_i caplet_i ; floor = sum_i floorlet_i ; swap = N delta sum_i df_i (f_i - K) ; parity_error = cap - floor - swap
steps: load params.json: forward_rates, vol, strike, notional, period_length, discount_factors (same length)
fixing_times = arange(n) * period_length
per period: qf_toolkit black_caplet(F, K, T, sigma, df, accrual, notional, kind='caplet'|'floorlet') or the explicit Black formula; guard T = 0 with the intrinsic value
cap_price = sum(caplets); floor_price = sum(floorlets); swap_value = notional * period_length * sum(df * (f - K)); put_call_parity_error = cap - floor - swap
create the output directory; write results.json with cap_price, floor_price, swap_value rounded to 2 dp, caplets/floorlets lists rounded to 4 dp, put_call_parity_error rounded to 6 dp
conventions: df_i discounts the payment at i*delta while the vol is scaled by the fixing time (i-1)*delta
scipy.stats.norm.cdf for N(); numpy floats cast to Python float before rounding
rounding exactly as the task states per field

title: Walk-forward intraday volume-share profiles, R2 model selection, order schedule
frame: DIKETAHUI: 1-minute OHLCV with bar-start datetime; order.json (datetime, quantity Q); session open/close, bar length, bars per day T, estimation window W days, EWMA half-life H, winsor percentiles, model priority order as stated. DITANYAKAN: excluded days, average daily R2 per model, best model, integer schedule over remaining bars. RUMUS: s_{d,b} = V_{d,b}/sum_j V_{d,j}; mean, median, EWMA w_L = exp(-ln2 L/H) with L=0 the most recent day, winsorized mean with per-bar clipping; normalise sum_b shat_b = 1; R2_d = 1 - sum_b (s - shat)^2 / sum_b (s - sbar)^2 (denominator 0 -> 1 if allclose else 0); score = mean_d R2_d; q_raw = Q w_b, floor, residual units to largest fractional remainders, ties to earlier bar. JAWAB: 1) sort, RTH filter, resample to session bars 2) complete days = exactly T bars 3) walk-forward from day W on 4) pick max score with priority tie-break 5) window = W complete days before order_day, restrict profile to bars strictly after order time, renormalise, allocate 6) write files.
formulas: s_{d,b} = V_{d,b} / sum_{j=1..T} V_{d,j}
mean profile = mean_d s_{d,b} ; median profile = median_d s_{d,b} ; each then divided by its sum
EWMA profile: w_L = exp(-ln(2) L/H), L = 0 for the most recent window day; shat_b = sum_L w_L s_{L,b} / sum_L w_L
winsorized profile: clip s_{d,b} per bar b to [p_lo, p_hi] percentiles over the window, then mean, then normalise
R2_d = 1 - sum_b (s_{d,b} - shat_{d,b})^2 / sum_b (s_{d,b} - sbar_d)^2 ; if denominator = 0: 1.0 if allclose(shat, s) else 0.0
score_model = mean over test days of R2_d ; best = argmax, ties by the stated priority order
schedule: w_b = shat_b / sum_{b in rem} shat_b ; q_raw = Q w_b ; q = floor(q_raw) ; add 1 to the (Q - sum q) bars with largest q_raw - q (stable argsort, earlier bar wins ties)
steps: read CSV, parse datetime, sort ascending; keep rows with time between session open and close inclusive
resample to the stated bar length with label='left', closed='left': Open first, High max, Low min, Close last, Volume sum; drop empty bars
keep bars whose start is within [session open, last session bar start]; date = bar date; complete days have exactly T bars; excluded days are the rest
shares per complete day = Volume / daily total (length T)
test days = complete days from index W onward; for each, window = previous W complete days; build the four profiles (normalised) and R2 against realised shares
avg_r2 per model; best model by max with priority order historical_mean_profile, historical_median_profile, ewma_profile, winsorized_mean_profile
order_day = normalised order datetime; window = the W complete days immediately before order_day; rebuild the best model profile from that window, clip >= 0, normalise
full-day bar grid = T bars from session open on order_day; remaining = bars strictly after the order datetime; renormalise shares; integer allocation by floor plus largest-remainder

write excluded_days.csv (date YYYY-MM-DD ascending, header only if none), model_performance.csv (model_name, avg_r2, num_test_days in priority order), best_model.json (best_model, best_avg_r2, num_test_days), final_schedule.csv (datetime, scheduled_quantity, predicted_bar_share, cumulative_scheduled_quantity ascending)
conventions: bar datetime is the bar open time (left label, left closed)
EWMA lag 0 is the most recent day: weights reversed when applied to a chronologically ordered window
profiles renormalised to sum 1 after estimation and again after restriction to remaining bars
schedule sums exactly to quantity; only bars strictly after the order timestamp
num_test_days identical across models
pitfalls: including the order bar itself (not strictly after) in the remaining set
