title: IPCA by alternating least squares with eigen-rotation, R2, Sharpe and GRS
frame: DIKETAHUI: long panels of excess returns and L characteristics (date, ticker), params (K factors, characteristic order, ALS max iter, tol, ridge, init seed, annualisation factor AF). DITANYAKAN: Gamma (L x K), F (T x K), total and mean cross-sectional R2, annualised factor Sharpe, GRS statistic and p-value, intermediates. RUMUS: r_{i,t} = z'_{i,t-1} Gamma f_t + e; Gamma|F: [sum_t Z_t'Z_t kron f_t f_t' + ridge I] vec(Gamma) = sum_t Z_t'r_t kron f_t; F|Gamma: f_t = (Gamma'Z_t'Z_t Gamma + ridge I)^{-1} Gamma'Z_t'r_t; identification each sweep Gamma'Gamma = I (Cholesky) then eigvecs of F'F/T descending; final eigh(F'F/T) rotation, flip so mean(F_k) >= 0; R2_total = 1 - sum e^2/sum r^2; Sharpe_k = mean/std(ddof=1) sqrt(AF); GRS with alphas from r_i on [1, F]. JAWAB: 1) pivot wide, count NaN, fill 0 2) lag Z one period 3) seeded normal init of F 4) ALS until max|dGamma|,|dF| < tol 5) rotate and sign-fix 6) fit, R2, Sharpe, alphas, GRS 7) write JSON.
formulas: Gamma | F : A = sum_t kron(Z_t'Z_t, f_t f_t') ; b = sum_t kron(Z_t'r_t, f_t) ; vec(Gamma) = solve(A + ridge I, b) reshaped (L, K) row-major
F | Gamma : f_t = solve(Gamma' Z_t'Z_t Gamma + ridge I, Gamma' Z_t' r_t)
per-sweep identification: R1 = chol(Gamma'Gamma)' ; Gamma <- Gamma R1^{-1} ; F <- F R1' ; rotate Gamma by eigenvectors of F'F/T sorted descending
final rotation: (ev, V) = eigh(F'F/T) descending ; F <- F V ; Gamma <- Gamma V ; flip column k of both if mean(F_k) < 0 ; var_ratio_k = ev_k / sum ev
fit = Z_lag Gamma f_t ; e = r - fit ; total_r2 = 1 - sum e^2 / sum r^2 ; cs_r2 = mean_t (1 - sum_i e^2 / sum_i r^2)
sharpe_k = mean(F_k) / std(F_k, ddof=1) * sqrt(AF)
alpha from OLS of each stock on [1, F] ; Sigma = res'res/(T-K-1) ; Omega = cov(F, ddof=1) ; GRS = (T/N) (T-N-K)/(T-K-1) alpha'Sigma^{-1}alpha / (1 + mu'Omega^{-1}mu) ; p = 1 - F_cdf(GRS; N, T-N-K)
steps: load params.json (n_factors, characteristic_names, annualization_factor, ridge, init_seed, als_max_iter, als_tol), returns.csv, characteristics.csv; drop duplicate (date, ticker) keeping last
pivot returns to wide (dates ascending x tickers sorted); nan_count = total NaN; fill NaN with 0; mean_return_matrix = grand mean of the filled matrix
per characteristic pivot to the same index/columns; fill missing with the row (date) median then 0; stack to (T, N, L) in the canonical order
lag: R_l = R[1:], Z_l = Z[:-1]; T_eff = T-1
F init = default_rng(init_seed).standard_normal((T_eff, K)); precompute ZZ_t = Z_t'Z_t and ZR_t = Z_t'r_t
ALS loop up to als_max_iter: Gamma step, per-sweep identification, F step; converged when max(|dGamma|, |dF|) < als_tol; record iterations
final eigen-rotation and sign flip; fit, residuals, total_r2, cs_r2, Sharpe
time-series regressions on [1, F] via lstsq: alphas, residual covariance, GRS and p-value

write results.json (total_r_squared, mean_cs_r_squared, grs_statistic, grs_p_value, factor{k}_sharpe_annual) and solution.json intermediates (nan_count, als_converged, als_iterations, gamma_frobenius_norm, gamma_largest_sv, factor_var_ratio_1..3, factor_corr_12/13/23, mean_alpha, mean_abs_alpha, total_r_squared, max_factor_return_abs, std_factor1..3 ddof=1, gamma_abs_mean, mean_return_matrix, max_abs_alpha) each as {value: ...}
conventions: Gamma'Gamma = I imposed every sweep (KPS identification), then factors uncorrelated and ordered by variance via F'F/T
reported scale is the eigendecomposition-of-F'F/T scale: F'F/T = diag(ev); scale-sensitive diagnostics use exactly this F and Gamma
std with ddof=1 everywhere; variance ratios from the eigenvalues
characteristics at t-1 pair with returns at t; raw NaN returns counted then set to 0
pitfalls: without per-sweep normalisation ALS drifts in scale and the final Sharpe, variance ratios and Gamma norms depend on the random init
R2, GRS and alphas are rotation-invariant and cannot diagnose a wrong rotation

title: Multi-asset Kelly fractions with a parametric VaR cap and Monte-Carlo bankroll
frame: DIKETAHUI: daily simple returns for n assets (possibly dirty), params: initial capital W0, paths, days, rf_annual, seed, confidence c, max_var_daily, estimation_window_days; trading days per year A as stated. DITANYAKAN: valid observation count, Kelly fractions, VaR of full Kelly, scale factor, terminal wealth medians/means, Sharpe and median max drawdown per scheme. RUMUS: rf_d = rf_annual/A; mu = mean(R); ex = mu - rf_d; Sigma = cov(ddof=1); f* = Sigma^{-1} ex; VaR(w) = z_c sqrt(w'Sigma w) - w'mu; s = min(1, max_var/VaR(f*)); f_var = s f*; schemes full f*, half f*/2, var s f*, equal 1/n; wealth = W0 cumprod(1 + draws w); Sharpe = mean/std(ddof=1) sqrt(A) on pooled daily portfolio returns; MDD = max (peak - W)/peak with W0 prefixed, median across paths. JAWAB: 1) clean 2) window tail 3) moments 4) Kelly and VaR scaling 5) one seeded multivariate normal draw set shared by all schemes 6) metrics 7) write JSON.
formulas: rf_daily = risk_free_annual / A (simple division) ; mean_excess = mean(R) - rf_daily ; Sigma = cov(R, ddof=1)
f_full = Sigma^{-1} (mu - rf_daily) ; total_kelly_leverage = sum |f_full|
VaR(w) = z_c sqrt(w' Sigma w) - w' mu with z_c = Phi^{-1}(c), positive loss ; var_scale_factor = min(1, max_var_daily / VaR(f_full))
f_var = var_scale_factor * f_full ; f_half = f_full / 2 ; f_equal = 1/n each
draws ~ MVN(mu, Sigma) size (paths, days) from default_rng(seed) ; r_p = draws @ w ; wealth = W0 cumprod(1 + r_p, axis=1)
sharpe = mean(r_p flat) / std(r_p flat, ddof=1) * sqrt(A) (no rf subtraction) ; mdd_path = max((peak - W)/peak) over [W0, wealth] ; p50_drawdown = median over paths
steps: load params.json and returns.csv; asset columns = those starting with asset_
clean: parse dates, sort, drop duplicate dates keep last, coerce to numeric, replace inf with NaN, drop rows with any NaN in asset columns; num_valid_observations = rows after cleaning
estimation sample = last estimation_window_days valid rows when set, else all
mu, mean_excess, Sigma (ddof=1); f_full = solve(Sigma, mean_excess)
z = norm.ppf(confidence_level); portfolio_var_full = VaR(f_full); var_scale_factor; f_var
rng = default_rng(seed); one draws array reused for every scheme; per scheme: terminal wealth median/mean, pooled Sharpe, median max drawdown (positive)

write results.json (num_valid_observations, median_terminal_wealth_full, median_terminal_wealth_var, sharpe_full, sharpe_var, p50_drawdown_full, p50_drawdown_var) and solution.json intermediates (mean_excess_0..2, cov_00, cov_01, cov_12, kelly_fraction_0..2, total_kelly_leverage, portfolio_var_full, var_scale_factor, mean_terminal_wealth_full) as {value: float}
conventions: VaR uses the raw mean (not excess) and z of the stated confidence; homogeneous degree 1 so linear scaling hits the limit exactly
one common draw set for all schemes; geometric compounding; drawdown reported positive
Sharpe annualised with sqrt(A), ddof=1, no risk-free subtraction, pooled across paths and days
leverage allowed; fractions may exceed 1 in magnitude
pitfalls: scaling when VaR already below the limit (factor must be capped at 1)

title: Weighted multi-level OFI, rolling z-score PCA, rolling OLS forecast with IC
frame: DIKETAHUI: 1-minute LOB flow file with per level i and side (bids/asks): limit, cancel, market notional flows and distance, plus midpoint; window W as stated; number of levels L. DITANYAKAN: forward mid log return, weighted OFI per level, rolling PC1 and predicted return at given indices, Spearman and Pearson IC. RUMUS: flow_side,i = limit - cancel - market; w = 1/(1+|distance|); wofi_i = w_bid flow_bid,i - w_ask flow_ask,i; fwd_t = ln(mid_{t+1}/mid_t); per step t >= W: train rows [t-W, t-1], z = (x - mean)/std(ddof=0) (std 0 -> 1), PC1 = first singular direction, sign fixed so corr(PC1_train, wofi_0_train) >= 0, OLS y = b0 + b1 PC1, PC1_t = z_t . v (same sign), pred_t = b0 + b1 PC1_t. JAWAB: 1) sort, keep every row 2) features and target 3) loop t, skip if any NaN target in training 4) store pc1[t], pred[t] 5) IC on rows with both defined 6) write results.json with index keys.
formulas: true_flow_side,i = limit_notional_i - cancel_notional_i - market_notional_i  (per side)
weighted_ofi_i = true_flow_bids,i / (1 + |bids_distance_i|) - true_flow_asks,i / (1 + |asks_distance_i|)
midpoint_return_fwd_t = ln(midpoint_{t+1} / midpoint_t) ; last row NaN
z = (x - mean_train) / std_train with std ddof=0 and zero std replaced by 1 ; U S Vh = svd(Z_train) ; pc1_train = U[:,0] S[0] ; v = Vh[0]
sign: if corr(pc1_train, weighted_ofi_0_train) < 0 then pc1_train = -pc1_train and pc1_t = -(z_t . v)
OLS y_train = b0 + b1 pc1_train ; pred_t = b0 + b1 pc1_t
spearman_ic = spearmanr(pred, fwd) ; pearson_ic = corrcoef(pred, fwd) over rows where both are finite
steps: load the CSV, sort by the time/index column, reset index; keep all rows (row count preserved)
midpoint array; forward log return with NaN appended for the last row
for each level i in 0..L-1 build bid and ask true flows and the weighted OFI; stack to an (n, L) matrix
loop t from W to n-1: training block rows t-W..t-1; z-score with training mean and population std; SVD; PC1 scores; sign check against raw level-0 OFI in the block
skip t (leave NaN) if any training target is NaN; else qf_toolkit ols(y=y_train, X=pc1_train[:,None], add_const=True) -> beta [intercept, slope]
z-score the test row with the training moments, project on v, apply the same sign, pc1_full[t] and predicted_return[t] = beta0 + beta1 pc1_t

results: midpoint_return_fwd_index{k} and weighted_ofi_{d}_index{k} for the stated early indices and depths; rolling_pc1_index{k} and predicted_return_index{k} for the stated later indices; spearman_ic and pearson_ic over valid rows; all values as Python float
write results.json
conventions: training window is the W rows strictly before t; the test row never enters training moments, PCA or OLS
population std (ddof=0) for the z-score; log returns for the target
sign decision made once per window and applied to both training scores and the test projection
no rows dropped up front so index-based output keys line up with the file
pitfalls: re-testing the correlation on the already flipped series leaves the test observation unflipped
schema differs across copies of this task (flow columns vs price/volume snapshots): read the header first; with snapshots true flow = size_t - size_{t-1}

title: Inverse-quoted option snapshot to call surface, Dupire local vol, LV MC barrier
frame: DIKETAHUI: raw BTC-quoted option snapshot (bid/ask in BTC, strikes USD, ms timestamps), metadata (snapshot_ts, spot proxy), task_rules (max relative spread, target expiries/strikes, local_var_floor, local_vol_cap, interpolator), barrier contract (strike K, barrier H, maturity expiry, steps per day, paths, seed). DITANYAKAN: cleaned quotes, paired nodes with forwards and total variance, repaired target call surface, Dupire local vol grid, LV MC barrier and vanilla with SE, hit probability, summary flags. RUMUS: ttm = (exp_ts - snap_ts)/(ms per year) ACT/365; F = K/(1 - (c - p)) at the min|c-p| strike per expiry (r = q = 0); prem_usd = prem_btc F; synthetic call = P_usd + F - K if K < F else C_usd; total_variance = iv^2 T; repair = clamp >= (F-K)^+, running min, convex envelope; sigma_loc^2 = 2 dC/dT /(K^2 d2C/dK2) with np.gradient(edge_order=2); X += -sigma^2 dt/2 + sigma sqrt(dt) Z, antithetic, knocked out if S <= H at daily closes. JAWAB: 1) validate, crossed, wide, dedupe 2) pair, forward, nodes 3) PCHIP in strike per expiry on target grid, repair 4) Dupire with floor/cap 5) LV MC 6) write.
formulas: ttm_years = (expiration_ts - snapshot_ts) / (1000 * 86400 * 365)  (ACT/365 from exact ms timestamps)
forward per expiry: F = K / (1 - (c_btc - p_btc)) using the pair with minimal |c_btc - p_btc| ; call_mid_usd = c_btc F ; put_mid_usd = p_btc F

synthetic_call_usd = put_mid_usd + F - K and otm_side = put_parity if K < F ; else call_mid_usd and call_direct ; log_moneyness = ln(K/F) ; total_variance = iv^2 T with iv from Black call inversion (brentq)
repair per expiry row: C = max(C, (F-K)^+) ; C = minimum.accumulate(C) ; C = lower convex envelope(K, C) ; repeat until diff(C) <= 0 and slopes non-decreasing
dC_dT = np.gradient(C[:, j], ttms, edge_order=2) ; dC_dK = np.gradient(C[i, :], K, edge_order=2) ; d2C_dK2 = np.gradient(np.gradient(C[i, :], K, edge_order=2), K, edge_order=2)
sigma_loc^2 = 2 dC_dT / (K^2 d2C_dK2) ; non-finite or below local_var_floor -> floor ; local_vol = min(sqrt(sigma_loc^2), local_vol_cap)

LV MC: X <- X - 0.5 sigma(t,S)^2 dt + sigma(t,S) sqrt(dt) Z with Z = [z, -z] ; dt = T/(n_days * n_steps_per_day) ; alive &= exp(X) > H at the end of each day ; price = mean(pair-averaged payoff), SE = std(pair averages, ddof=1)/sqrt(n_pairs)
knockout_discount_vs_vanilla_pct = (vanilla_mc - barrier_mc) / vanilla_mc * 100 ; survival = 1 - hit
steps: load snapshot, metadata, rules, contract; n_raw_rows; split instrument_name into (asset, expiry, strike, C/P) and keep rows consistent with strike/option_type columns

drop invalid markets (missing/non-positive quotes, expired); crossed_rows_removed = bid > ask; mid = (bid+ask)/2; wide_spread_rows_removed = (ask-bid)/mid > max_relative_spread; duplicates_removed = keep latest creation_timestamp per instrument_name

write cleaned_quotes.csv (instrument_name, expiry, option_type, strike, bid_price_btc, ask_price_btc, mid_price_btc, mark_iv_pct, underlying_price_usd, open_interest, volume_usd, creation_timestamp) sorted by expiry, strike, type; n_clean_rows

pair calls and puts on (expiry, strike); unmatched_rows_removed = n_clean - 2 * n_pairs; forward per expiry; USD premiums, otm_side, synthetic call, log moneyness, total variance; write surface_nodes.csv sorted (ttm_years, strike)

for each target expiry: PchipInterpolator(strike, synthetic_call_usd) on the target strikes, then repair_row; write call_surface.csv (expiry, ttm_years, strike, call_price_usd) sorted by maturity then strike
Dupire derivatives with np.gradient edge_order=2; floor/cap; write local_vol_surface.csv (expiry, ttm_years, strike, dC_dT, dC_dK, d2C_dK2, local_vol)

LV MC from S0 = spot proxy, zero drift, sigma(t, S) linear in strike (flat outside) and linear in maturity between expiry rows (flat outside); antithetic pairs; daily-close barrier check; vanilla at the same strike from the same paths

barrier_results.json: spot_proxy_usd, maturity_expiry, strike, barrier, n_steps_per_day, variance_reduction=antithetic, barrier_monitoring_mode=daily_close_only, forward_at_maturity, surface_vanilla_call_usd, localvol_mc_vanilla_call_usd/_se, down_and_out_call_usd/_se, barrier_hit_probability, survival_probability, knockout_discount_vs_vanilla_pct

summary.json: n_raw_rows, n_clean_rows, n_paired_nodes, n_surface_nodes, n_localvol_nodes, duplicates_removed, crossed_rows_removed, wide_spread_rows_removed, unmatched_rows_removed, call_surface_monotone_in_strike, call_surface_convex_in_strike, local_vol_positive, barrier_leq_vanilla, barrier_nonnegative, vanilla_mc_close_to_surface, all_checks_passed
conventions: inverse options: r = q = 0, DF = 1, premiums converted BTC -> USD by the expiry forward; one forward per expiry used everywhere
cleaning order: validate metadata -> invalid/crossed -> wide spread -> dedupe latest; one-sided clean rows stay in cleaned_quotes but not in the surface
local-vol lookup linear in maturity between expiry rows, flat before the first and after the last; MC starts at the spot proxy
OUTPUT_DIR default is the one the task states (not /app/output); deterministic seed from the contract
vanilla_mc_close_to_surface uses a loose relative band since a coarse Dupire grid does not reprice the surface exactly
pitfalls: piecewise-constant (next/previous expiry) time lookup moves the MC vanilla by several percent and fails plausibility
a too-tight self-check tolerance turns all_checks_passed False and fails the summary test

title: Lookback options: historical-vol calibration, closed forms, GBM Monte Carlo check
frame: DIKETAHUI: daily price file (close column), r and dividend yield q as stated, trading days per year A, maturity grid, moneyness grid, paths N, seed. DITANYAKAN: n_returns, mean, std, sigma, S0; fixed-strike lookback call prices (closed form and MC with SE) per (T, K = m S0); floating-strike call and put per T; summary maxima and validation flag. RUMUS: x_t = ln(P_t/P_{t-1}); sigma = std(x, ddof=1) sqrt(A); b = r - q; fixed call K > M: S e^{-qT}N(d1) - K e^{-rT}N(d2) + S e^{-rT} sigma^2/(2b)[e^{bT}N(d1) - (S/K)^{-2b/sigma^2} N(d1 - 2b sqrt T/sigma)]; K <= M: e^{-rT}(M-K) + same with K -> M; floating call/put (GSG) with a1 = (b + sigma^2/2) sqrt T/sigma, a2 = a1 - sigma sqrt T; GBM S_{t+dt} = S_t exp((b - sigma^2/2)dt + sigma sqrt(dt) Z); payoff max(M_T - K, 0), S_T - m_T, M_T - S_T; MC price = e^{-rT} mean(payoff), SE = e^{-rT} std(payoff, ddof=1)/sqrt N. JAWAB: 1) calibrate 2) closed forms 3) seeded GBM once per maturity grid, running max/min including S0 4) payoffs 5) summaries 6) write files.
formulas: log_returns = ln(close_t / close_{t-1}) ; n_returns = len ; return_std = std(ddof=1) ; sigma = return_std * sqrt(A) ; S0 = last close

fixed-strike call, K > M (M = S0 at inception), b = r - q: C = S e^{-qT} N(d1) - K e^{-rT} N(d2) + S e^{-rT} sigma^2/(2b) [e^{bT} N(d1) - (S/K)^{-2b/sigma^2} N(d1 - 2b sqrt(T)/sigma)], d1 = [ln(S/K) + (b + sigma^2/2)T]/(sigma sqrt T), d2 = d1 - sigma sqrt T
fixed-strike call, K <= M: C = e^{-rT}(M - K) + S e^{-qT} N(e1) - M e^{-rT} N(e2) + S e^{-rT} sigma^2/(2b) [e^{bT} N(e1) - (S/M)^{-2b/sigma^2} N(e1 - 2b sqrt(T)/sigma)] with e1, e2 = d1, d2 at K = M
floating-strike call (m = S): C = S e^{-qT} N(a1) - S e^{-rT} N(a2) + S e^{-rT} sigma^2/(2b) [N(-a1 + 2b sqrt(T)/sigma) - e^{bT} N(-a1)], a1 = (b + sigma^2/2) sqrt(T)/sigma, a2 = a1 - sigma sqrt T
floating-strike put (M = S): P = S e^{-rT} N(-a2) - S e^{-qT} N(-a1) + S e^{-rT} sigma^2/(2b) [-N(a1 - 2b sqrt(T)/sigma) + e^{bT} N(a1)]
GBM: S_{t+dt} = S_t exp((r - q - sigma^2/2) dt + sigma sqrt(dt) Z), dt = 1/A ; M_t = max(M_{t-1}, S_t), m_t = min(m_{t-1}, S_t) starting at S0
mc_price = e^{-rT} mean(payoff) ; mc_std_err = e^{-rT} std(payoff, ddof=1) / sqrt(N) ; mc_validates = all |cf - mc| < 2 mc_std_err
steps: load the daily CSV (check the actual close column name), sort by date; log returns; calibration.json (n_returns, return_mean, return_std, sigma, S0, r, D)
closed-form fixed-strike calls on the (T, moneyness) grid via qf_toolkit lookback_fixed_price(S, K, T, r, sigma, kind='call', q=D, s_max=None) (s_max None = fresh issue, M = S0)
closed-form floating call and put per T via qf_toolkit lookback_floating_price(S, T, r, sigma, kind='call'|'put', q=D, s_min=None / s_max=None)

seed the generator once (np.random.seed(seed) with randn as in the passed program); simulate N GBM paths on a daily grid to the longest maturity, tracking running max and min including S0; read S_T, M_T, m_T at step int(T*A) for each maturity
payoffs max(M_T - K, 0), S_T - m_T, M_T - S_T; discounted mean and SE per row

fixed_strike_lookback.csv columns T,K,moneyness,cf_price,mc_price,mc_std_err (maturity-major, moneyness ascending); floating_strike_lookback.csv columns T,type,cf_price,mc_price,mc_std_err (calls block then puts block)

summary.json: sigma, S0, n_fixed_strike, n_floating_strike, max_mc_error_fixed, max_mc_error_floating, mc_validates (bool as computed), atm_fixed_T025/T050/T100 (moneyness 1 rows), float_call_T050, float_put_T050
conventions: log returns, ddof=1, annualised with sqrt(A); S0 = last close; K = S0 * m unrounded
running extrema include S0 (fresh issue: M = m = S0); risk-neutral drift r - q; discount at r
common random numbers: one simulation reused for every strike of a maturity
mc_validates reported honestly as computed (continuous closed forms sit above a daily-monitored MC)
pitfalls: using one fixed-strike branch for every strike: in-the-money strikes (K < S0) need the M-branch with the intrinsic term
floating-strike put written with e^{-qT} where e^{-rT} belongs gives prices decreasing in T

title: MC Greeks for European and Asian options: finite difference, pathwise, likelihood ratio
frame: DIKETAHUI: S0, K, r, q, sigma, T, paths N, seed, M Asian monitoring dates, bump sizes hS, hV, hT, hR, spot and vol grids, path-count set. DITANYAKAN: MC prices with SE and BS references, Greeks by fd/pathwise/lr with SE (null where unavailable), parity differences, delta variance comparison, BS surfaces, convergence table, flags. RUMUS: S_T = S0 exp((r-q-sigma^2/2)T + sigma sqrt T Z); FD central: delta (V+ - V-)/2h, gamma (V+ - 2V + V-)/h^2, vega /(2hV), rho /(2hR), theta -(V(T-h) - V(T))/h; pathwise call delta e^{-rT} 1{S_T>K} S_T/S0, vega e^{-rT} 1{} S_T (sqrt T Z - sigma T); LR weights on discounted payoff: delta Z/(S0 sigma sqrt T), gamma (Z^2 - 1 - Z sigma sqrt T)/(S0 sigma sqrt T)^2, vega (Z^2-1)/sigma - Z sqrt T, rho Z sqrt T/sigma - T. JAWAB: 1) RandomState(seed), European Z then Asian Z 2) prices 3) FD with CRN 4) pathwise 5) LR 6) parity, variances 7) BS grids 8) convergence over N 9) write.
formulas: S_T = S0 exp((r - q - sigma^2/2) T + sigma sqrt(T) Z) ; Asian S_{t_j} = S0 exp(cumsum((r-q-sigma^2/2) dt + sigma sqrt(dt) Z_j)), dt = T/M ; payoff on the arithmetic mean

FD (same Z for every bump): delta = (V(S+h) - V(S-h))/(2h) ; gamma = (V(S+h) - 2V + V(S-h))/h^2 ; vega = (V(sigma+hV) - V(sigma-hV))/(2hV) ; theta = -(V(T-hT) - V(T))/hT ; rho = (V(r+hR) - V(r-hR))/(2hR) ; SE from per-path differences

pathwise European (put: sign flip, indicator S_T < K): delta = e^{-rT} 1{S_T>K} S_T/S0 ; vega = e^{-rT} 1{} S_T (sqrt(T) Z - sigma T) ; theta = -r pay + e^{-rT} 1{} S_T (r - q - sigma^2/2 + sigma Z/(2 sqrt T)) ; rho = -T pay + e^{-rT} 1{} S_T T ; gamma = null
pathwise Asian: delta = e^{-rT} 1{A>K} A/S0 ; vega = e^{-rT} 1{A>K} mean_j S_j (W_j - sigma t_j) ; gamma, theta, rho = null

LR European (weights times discounted payoff): delta Z/(S0 sigma sqrt T) ; gamma (Z^2 - 1 - Z sigma sqrt T)/(S0 sigma sqrt T)^2 ; vega (Z^2 - 1)/sigma - Z sqrt T ; rho Z sqrt(T)/sigma - T ; theta = null
LR Asian: delta and gamma from the first increment score with dt in place of T ; vega = sum_j ((Z_j^2 - 1)/sigma - Z_j sqrt dt) ; rho = sum_j Z_j sqrt(dt)/sigma - T
SE = std(per-path estimator, ddof=1)/sqrt(N) ; parity: delta_call - delta_put = e^{-qT}, gamma diff = 0, rho diff = K T e^{-rT}
BS theta for error reporting = dV/dT in the same sign convention as the FD rule
steps: rs = np.random.RandomState(seed) at module start; ZE = rs.standard_normal(N) for European, then ZA = rs.standard_normal((N, M)) for Asian
discounted payoff engines eu_disc_payoff(S, sigma, T, r, kind, Z) and as_disc_payoff(...) reusing the same Z; mstat(x) = (mean, std(ddof=1)/sqrt(len))
prices.json: per option mc_price, mc_se, and bs_price for Europeans (BS with continuous dividend yield)
fd_greeks per option with common random numbers; pathwise and LR estimators as above; greeks.json nested [option][greek][method] = {value, se}, Python None for unavailable pairs

consistency.json: bs_errors (|fd - BS| per Greek and price, call and put), put_call_parity (delta_diff, gamma_diff, rho_diff from fd), variance_ratio (pw_variance, lr_variance, pw_se, lr_se of the European call delta estimators), asian_vs_european (price_call, price_put, delta_call booleans)

BS closed-form delta and vega on the spot x vol grid: delta_surface.csv (S0, sigma, delta_call_eu, delta_put_eu), vega_surface.csv (S0, sigma, vega_call_eu, vega_put_eu); 3D plot of call delta to delta_surface.png (Agg)
convergence.csv (N, method, greek, value, se): European call delta by fd, pathwise, lr on the first n draws for each n in the stated set
summary.json flags: mc_prices_match_bs, greeks_within_tolerance, put_call_parity_delta/gamma/rho, pathwise_variance_lower, delta_surface_monotone, vega_positive, convergence_ok, all_checks_passed
conventions: one RandomState(seed); European terminal draws consumed before the Asian increments
FD formulas applied literally: vega and rho per unit of the parameter, theta = -(V(T-h) - V(T))/h; BS references use the same convention
common random numbers for every bump so parity gamma difference is exact
unavailable Greeks written as JSON null via Python None, never NaN or 0
OUTPUT_DIR env var with the default the task states
pitfalls: rescaling vega/rho to per-1% or flipping theta to a calendar-decay sign breaks the BS comparison flags

title: Merton jump-diffusion: MLE calibration on log returns, series pricing, IV smile
frame: DIKETAHUI: daily close prices; dt = 1/A; truncation N_max; parameter bounds; r; maturity and moneyness grids; smile threshold. DITANYAKAN: return moments, MLE (sigma, lambda, mu_J, sigma_J), log-likelihood, S0, Merton and BS prices, Merton-implied vols, summary. RUMUS: x = diff(ln close); mu = mean(x)/dt fixed; kbar = e^{mu_J + sigma_J^2/2} - 1; p(x) = sum_{n=0}^{N_max} Pois(n; lambda dt) phi(x; (mu - sigma^2/2 - lambda kbar) dt + n mu_J, sigma^2 dt + n sigma_J^2) via log-sum-exp; maximise sum ln p with L-BFGS-B from several starts; C = sum_n e^{-lambda tau}(lambda tau)^n/n! C_BS(S0, K, r_n, sigma_n, tau), sigma_n^2 = sigma^2 + n sigma_J^2/tau, r_n = r - lambda kbar + n ln(1+kbar)/tau; sigma_total = sqrt(sigma^2 + lambda(mu_J^2 + sigma_J^2)); IV by Newton from sigma_total. JAWAB: 1) returns and moments 2) vectorised NLL, restarts, keep best 3) grid prices 4) BS at sigma_total 5) invert 6) sort T then K, write.
formulas: x_i = ln(close_i / close_{i-1}) ; dt = 1/A ; mu = mean(x)/dt (physical drift, not optimised) ; std ddof=1 ; skew and excess kurtosis via pandas skew()/kurt()
kbar = exp(mu_J + sigma_J^2/2) - 1 ; mean_n = (mu - sigma^2/2 - lambda kbar) dt + n mu_J ; var_n = sigma^2 dt + n sigma_J^2
ln p(x) = logsumexp_{n=0..N_max} [ -lambda dt + n ln(lambda dt) - lgamma(n+1) - ln(2 pi var_n)/2 - (x - mean_n)^2/(2 var_n) ] ; NLL = -sum_i ln p(x_i)
minimize(NLL, x0, method='L-BFGS-B', bounds) over a set of fixed plus seeded random starts (at least the stated count); keep the lowest NLL; log_likelihood = -NLL

Merton call: C = sum_{n=0}^{N_series} e^{-lambda tau} (lambda tau)^n / n! * C_BS(S0, K, r_n, sigma_n, tau) ; sigma_n = sqrt(sigma^2 + n sigma_J^2/tau) ; r_n = r - lambda kbar + n ln(1 + kbar)/tau ; N_series >= 3 lambda max(T) plus margin
sigma_total = sqrt(sigma^2 + lambda (mu_J^2 + sigma_J^2)) ; bs_price = C_BS(S0, K, r, sigma_total, tau)
merton_implied_vol: Newton sigma <- sigma - (C_BS(sigma) - C_merton)/vega from sigma_total, vega = S0 sqrt(tau) phi(d1), stop at |diff| < tol
max_iv_spread = max_T [max_K iv - min_K iv] ; smile_present = any spread > threshold ; mean_price_ratio = mean(merton_price / bs_price)
steps: read the CSV, close column as float; log returns; n_returns, return_mean, return_std (ddof=1), return_skewness, return_excess_kurtosis; S0 = last close
vectorised NLL over (N_max+1) x n_obs with log-sum-exp; L-BFGS-B with the stated bounds from several starts; keep best
for each T and moneyness m: K = S0 m; Merton series price; BS price at sigma_total; Merton-implied vol by Newton from sigma_total
DataFrame sorted by T then K; write merton_prices.csv with columns T, K, moneyness, merton_price, bs_price, merton_implied_vol
calibration.json: n_returns, return_mean, return_std, return_skewness, return_excess_kurtosis, sigma, lambda, mu_J, sigma_J, log_likelihood, S0
summary.json: sigma_total, n_maturities, n_strikes, n_prices, smile_present, atm_merton_price_T025/T050/T100 (moneyness 1 rows), max_iv_spread, mean_price_ratio_merton_over_bs
conventions: risk-neutral jump parameters equal the physical ones (Merton assumption); drift r as stated
log-sum-exp for the mixture density; sigma, lambda, sigma_J strictly positive inside the optimiser
pandas skew()/kurt() (bias-corrected, excess) for the return moments
IV round-trips the Merton price through C_BS to tight tolerance
pitfalls: too small N_series truncates the Poisson tail for large lambda tau
a single start can land in a local optimum; keep the best of several

title: EMA crossover long-only backtest with next-open execution and performance metrics
frame: DIKETAHUI: daily OHLCV with adj_close and adj_open; fast/slow EMA spans, initial capital C0, trading days per year A as stated. DITANYAKAN: trade list, daily cumulative return, metrics. RUMUS: EMA_t = alpha p_t + (1-alpha) EMA_{t-1}, alpha = 2/(span+1) (ewm adjust=False); state = 1 if EMA_fast > EMA_slow else 0 (0 while slow EMA undefined); BUY when state goes 0 -> 1 on day i, executed at adj_open of day i+1, shares = floor(cash/open); SELL when 1 -> 0, executed at next adj_open, all shares; forced close at last adj_close; V_t = cash + shares adj_close_t; r_t = pct_change(V), r_1 = 0; cum = cumprod(1 + r); ann_ret = mean(r) A; ann_vol = std(r, ddof=1) sqrt A; sharpe = ann_ret/ann_vol; mdd = max((runmax - cum)/runmax); calmar = ann_ret/mdd; num_trades = #BUY; win_rate = share of SELL pnl > 0; total_pnl = sum SELL pnl. JAWAB: 1) EMAs on adj_close 2) signal 3) ledger with lag 1 at open 4) metrics 5) write CSV/JSON/HTML.
formulas: EMA = series.ewm(span=span, adjust=False).mean() ; signal_t = 1{EMA_fast,t > EMA_slow,t}, set 0 where EMA_slow is NaN

entry: signal_{i-1} = 0 and signal_i = 1 -> BUY at adj_open_{i+1}, shares = floor(cash / adj_open_{i+1}) ; exit: signal_{i-1} = 1 and signal_i = 0 while long -> SELL all at adj_open_{i+1} ; forced SELL at last adj_close if still long
V_t = cash + shares_t adj_close_t ; daily_return_t = V_t/V_{t-1} - 1, first = 0 ; cumulative_return = cumprod(1 + daily_return) starting at 1

total_return = (final_capital - C0)/C0 ; annualized_return = mean(daily_return) A ; annualized_volatility = std(daily_return, ddof=1) sqrt(A) ; sharpe_ratio = annualized_return / annualized_volatility
max_drawdown = max((running_max(cum) - cum)/running_max(cum)) ; calmar_ratio = annualized_return / max_drawdown
num_trades = count of BUY rows ; pnl per round trip = (sell_price - buy_price) shares ; win_rate = fraction of SELL rows with pnl > 0 ; total_pnl = sum of SELL pnl
steps: load the price CSV, parse date, set as sorted index
ema_fast and ema_slow on adj_close with ewm(span, adjust=False); signal = (fast > slow) as int, zero where slow is NaN
qf_toolkit trade_ledger(prices=adj_close, signal=signal, initial_capital=C0, exec_lag=1, exec_price='open', whole_shares=True, cost_bps=0, open_prices=adj_open) -> trades, daily_portfolio, metrics
trades.csv columns ticker,type,signal_date,exec_date,price,shares,pnl; pnl blank (NaN) on BUY rows; dates YYYY-MM-DD; forced close also typed SELL
daily_portfolio.csv columns date,cumulative_return starting at 1.0

results.json {TICKER: {total_return, final_capital (2 dp), annualized_return, annualized_volatility, sharpe_ratio, max_drawdown, calmar_ratio, num_trades (int), win_rate, total_pnl (2 dp), num_trading_days}}
Plotly figure: cumulative return line plus a dashed horizontal line at 1.0, title, x 'Date', y 'Cumulative Return'; fig.to_html(include_plotlyjs='cdn') written to cumulative_returns.html
conventions: signals from adj_close EMAs, execution at the next day's adj_open, valuation at adj_close
whole shares only, one position at a time, no shorting, no costs
ratios as raw floats, money rounded to 2 dp, risk-free rate zero
num_trading_days = number of rows in the daily portfolio file
pitfalls: detecting the cross and executing on the same day
treating the forced close as a different type than SELL

title: MTM cross-currency basis swap: quote cleaning, OIS/LIBOR curves, FX basis, PV, risk
frame: DIKETAHUI: mixed quote book (OIS deposits/swaps, 3M LIBOR deposit/FRAs with optional quote_adjustment_bps, FX spot and forward points in pips), historical LIBOR fixings, trade schedule (reset, fixing, payment, accrual dates), trade.json (valuation and spot dates, USD notional N_usd, inception spot, contract spread s, day counts USD ACT/360, GBP ACT/365F, interpolation conventions); holder receives GBP, pays USD, USD collateral. DITANYAKAN: cleaned quotes, OIS curves, FX forward nodes and implied basis, cashflow schedule with USD PVs, leg/trade PV, par basis, accrued, PV01s, FX delta, stress PnL, reconciliation flags. RUMUS: DF(end) = 1/(1 + r tau(spot,end)) per OIS quote; g = -ln DF linear in time; Q(end) = Q(start)/(1 + (F + adj) tau), fwd = (Q_s/Q_e - 1)/tau; F_node = S + pts/1e4, ln F linear; F_cip = S DFgbp(T)/DFusd(T); b = ln(F_cip/F_mkt)/tau_360; N_i = N_usd/F(reset_i); PV = sum flows F(pay) DF_usd; par = s - PV/annuity. JAWAB: 1) dedupe latest per key, normalise 2) curves 3) FX nodes, basis 4) schedule 5) PV, par, accrued 6) bumps 7) stresses 8) write.
formulas: cleaning: latest quote_time per key (curve, instrument_type, tenor, start_date, end_date, ccy_or_pair) ; rate_pct/100 -> rate_decimal ; pips/1e4 -> fx_forward_increment ; spot -> fx_rate ; FRA quote_adjustment_bps/1e4 added only when building the projection curve

OIS: anchored at the spot date DF(spot) = 1 ; every OIS quote (deposit or swap) DF(end) = 1/(1 + r tau(spot, end)) with tau in the currency day count ; interpolation linear in -ln DF over calendar days, flat-rate extrapolation
LIBOR projection: Q(spot) = 1 ; Q(end) = Q(start)/(1 + (F + adj) tau) chained through deposit and FRAs ; forward(s,e) = (Q(s)/Q(e) - 1)/tau(s,e)

FX: F_node = S + points ; ln F linear in time between spot (at spot date) and nodes ; broken-date forwards from this interpolation ; F_cip(T) = S (DFgbp(T)/DFgbp(spot))/(DFusd(T)/DFusd(spot)) ; basis b = ln(F_cip/F_mkt)/tau_ACT360(spot,T) ; basis_bps = b 1e4
notionals: N_0 = N_usd / inception_spot ; N_i = N_usd / F(reset_i) for future resets ; mtm_reset cashflow (GBP, receive side) = N_new - N_old at the reset date

coupons: rate = historical fixing if fixing_date <= valuation date else projected forward ; GBP coupon = N_i (L_gbp + s) tau_365 ; USD coupon = -N_usd L_usd tau_360 ; final principal +N_last GBP, -N_usd USD ; exclude payment dates before valuation
pv_usd = signed_cashflow * F(payment) * DF_usd(payment) for GBP, signed * DF_usd for USD ; trade_pv = usd_leg_pv + gbp_leg_pv ; par_basis_bps = (s - trade_pv / sum_{GBP coupons} N tau F DF) 1e4

stressed FX nodes with basis held fixed: F = F_cip(stressed curves) exp(-b tau) then re-interpolate ; PnL = stressed PV - base PV ; roll-down uses forward DFs DF(T)/DF(roll) from frozen curves and rolled spot = base forward to the roll date
steps: load trade.json, market_quotes.csv, libor_fixings.csv, trade_schedule.csv; year fraction = days/360 (USD) or days/365 (GBP)

sort quotes by quote_time, drop_duplicates(key, keep='last'); normalise units; write cleaned_quotes.csv (quote_time, curve, instrument_type, tenor, start_date, end_date, ccy_or_pair, normalized_unit, normalized_quote) sorted by curve, instrument_type, end_date, tenor; num_clean_quotes

build USD and GBP OIS curves (LogLinear in -ln DF) and write usd_curve.csv / gbp_curve.csv (curve_type, tenor, pillar_date, year_frac, discount_factor, zero_rate, forward_rate); build USD and GBP LIBOR projection pseudo-DF curves with FRA adjustments

FX: spot, forward nodes sorted by tenor months; implied basis per node; basis_curve.csv (tenor, maturity_date, year_frac, spot_fx, quoted_forward_fx, cip_forward_no_basis, basis_bps) and fx_forward_curve.csv (tenor, maturity_date, spot_fx, forward_fx, forward_points in pips, implied_basis_bps)

value(): loop schedule periods: notional path, mtm_reset rows, coupon rows (fixed vs projected, spread on GBP only, coupon_rate all-in), final principal rows; drop payment dates before valuation; fx_forward, discount_factor_usd, pv_usd; sort by payment_date then event order

results.json: trade_pv_usd, usd_leg_pv_usd, gbp_leg_pv_usd, par_basis_bps, next_reset_notional_gbp, next_coupon_rate_usd/gbp (current fixed rates), accrued_usd (negative), accrued_gbp_usd (positive, at spot), pv01_usd_ois, pv01_gbp_ois, pv01_usd_libor3m, pv01_gbp_libor3m (one-bp parallel bumps, OIS bumps with basis held fixed), fx_delta_usd_per_1pct (spot and nodes x1.01), num_clean_quotes, num_future_resets

stress_results.csv (scenario, trade_pv_usd, pnl_usd) in the stated order: usd_ois_up_5bp, gbp_ois_up_5bp, basis_widen_2bp (subtract), gbp_leg_basis_widen_2bp (GBP leg only), spot_up_1pct, spot_realized_1d_up_1pct (spot only, re-interpolate), curve_twist (+ short, - long around 1Y), roll_down_to_<date>

reconciliation.json (cleaned_quote_count, max_forward_node_abs_error_pips, max_basis_node_abs_error_bps, first_broken_date_forward, final_payment_forward, usd_curve_reprices_inputs, gbp_curve_reprices_inputs, fx_forward_nodes_reprice, basis_curve_matches_fx_forwards, all_reconciliation_checks_passed), solution.json intermediates (usd_df_18m, gbp_df_2y, usd_fra_9x12, gbp_fra_15x18, gbp_fra_18x21_effective, fx_forward_18m, implied_basis_1y_bps, derived_initial_gbp_notional, broken_date_fx_<first payment>, current_usd_coupon, current_gbp_coupon, next_reset_notional_gbp, final_reset_notional_gbp, usd_leg_pv_usd, gbp_leg_pv_usd, trade_pv_usd, par_basis_bps), summary.json booleans in the stated order
conventions: OIS curves anchored at the spot date (DF = 1), every OIS quote treated as a single-period simple-rate instrument; multi-period annual bootstrap misses the oracle
interpolation linear in -ln DF (and ln F for FX) over calendar days; basis tau is ACT/360 from spot
mtm_reset = N_new - N_old on the receive-GBP side (positive when the notional rises); this sign makes FX delta about -1% of the USD notional
within one payment date the row order is GBP coupon, GBP mtm_reset, USD coupon, GBP principal, USD principal (checked positionally)
spread added to GBP coupons only; coupon_rate reported all-in; FRA adjustment never baked into cleaned_quotes
OUTPUT_DIR default is the one the task states

discounting from valuation date to spot date or bootstrapping swaps with annual coupons breaks the curve reconciliation at 1e-4

title: Committee z-score alpha fused with AIC process filter and L/S backtest
frame: DIKETAHUI: panel (asof_date, ticker) = cross join tanggal rebalance x universe; fitur per modalitas; forward return; params (bobot agen, penalty, window W, min history, jump_threshold_sigma, conviction scale, min_trade_signal, top/bottom N, cost bps, modal). DITANYAKAN: 4 skor agen, committee_alpha, proses terpilih per AIC, final_signal, bobot L/S, return, metrik. RUMUS: z = clip((x-mean)/std_ddof0, -3, 3) per tanggal setelah inf->NaN->median; agen = mean(sign_i z_i); committee = sum w_a agen_a; mult = max(0, 1 - penalty std_ddof0(agen)); alpha = committee mult; AIC = 2k + 2 NLL; final = alpha sign(E[r]) conviction. JAWAB: 1) panel, assert baris; 2) fitur audit trailing tanpa look-ahead; 3) normalisasi, agen, komite; 4) fit 4 proses pada W return trailing (asof < t), AIC terkecil, tie alfabetis; 5) ranking, L/S gross 0.5 per sisi; 6) return, turnover, cost, equity; 7) tulis.
formulas: z = clip((x - mean)/std(ddof=0), -3, 3) after inf->NaN->median fill (all-NaN -> 0); std 0 -> 0; transform before z, sign after
committee_score = sum w_a agent_a; agreement_multiplier = max(0, 1 - penalty*std_ddof0(agents)); committee_alpha = score*multiplier
Gaussian NLL = sum(0.5 ln(2 pi s^2) + (x-m)^2/(2 s^2)); AIC = 2k + 2 NLL; martingale m=0; all std ddof=0
OU: OLS r_t = c + phi r_{t-1}; theta = -ln phi; mu = c/(1-phi); half_life = ln2/theta*holding_days; NLL = cond NLL(r[1:]) + NLL(r[0]; mu, sigma/sqrt(1-phi^2))
Merton: mask = |r-mu| > thr*sigma; lam = mean(mask); density = (1-lam) N(m_d, s_d) + lam N(m_d + j_mean, sqrt(s_d^2 + j_std^2)), lam clipped into (0,1)
process_conviction = 2/(1 + exp(-gap/scale)) - 1, gap = second best AIC - best; 1 if one finite AIC; 0 if insufficient history
final = committee_alpha*sign*conviction (0 if sign 0); turnover = 0.5 sum|w_t - w_{t-1}|; cost = turnover*bps/1e4
steps: Cross join rebalance dates x universe; left-join modalities on (asof_date, ticker), COT on (asof_date, cot_bucket), forward returns; assert row count
Audit features per row from rows dated <= asof: bulletin severity sum/count, days_since_last_bulletin, reference mismatch count/abs sum, stale field count
Per asof_date normalise components; agent = mean of signed z; committee_score, committee_dispersion, agreement_multiplier, committee_alpha
Per row: trailing forward returns with asof < current, last W; below min history -> params null, selected_process insufficient_history, conviction 0
Fit martingale, gbm, ou, merton; NLL, AIC; selected_process = min AIC (ties alphabetical); process_expected_return per winner; process_sign
Per date rank final desc, ticker asc; eligible |final| >= min_trade_signal; top-N positive long, bottom-N negative short, equal weights 0.5 per side; rest neutral
gross_return, turnover vs previous book (first vs zero), transaction_cost, net_return, equity_curve; write all CSVs, results.json, solution.json
conventions: bulletin window strict 0 <= days < 365; days_since_last_bulletin capped at the window and no-bulletin issuers get the cap
stale = newest observation across both vintages older than threshold; non-numeric disagreement adds 1.0; NaN vs NaN agree
k if absent from params: martingale 1, gbm 2, ou 3, merton 5; phi clipped into (eps, 1-eps) with intercept re-fit
annualise by 12; vol/Sharpe ddof=0; max_drawdown negative incl. initial-capital point; dates YYYY-MM-DD
pitfalls: plain sigmoid conviction failed; 2*sigmoid - 1 passed
window <= 365 failed; strict < 365 passed

title: OHLC range vol estimators: CC, Parkinson, GK, RS, YZ with rolling efficiency
frame: DIKETAHUI: deret harian O, H, L, C (n_days), AF yang disebut, jendela W, daftar horizon. DITANYAKAN: varians 5 estimator full-sample dan rolling, vol anualisasi, efisiensi vs CC, term structure, ringkasan. RUMUS: CC = mean(r^2), r = ln(C_t/C_{t-1}); P = sum(ln(H/L)^2)/(4 n ln2); GK = mean(0.5 ln(H/L)^2 - (2 ln2 - 1) ln(C/O)^2); RS = mean(ln(H/C) ln(H/O) + ln(L/C) ln(L/O)); YZ = var_o + k var_c + (1-k) RS, k = 0.34/(1.34 + (n+1)/(n-1)); vol = sqrt(var AF); eff_e = var_ddof1(deret varians rolling CC)/var_ddof1(deret e). JAWAB: 1) muat, cek H >= max(O,C), L <= min(O,C); 2) full-sample n = n_days; 3) rolling: n_days - W jendela; 4) efisiensi; 5) term structure = sqrt(mean(var rolling) AF) untuk CC dan YZ; 6) tulis.
formulas: CC var = mean(r^2), r = ln(C_i/C_{i-1}), no demeaning
Parkinson var = sum(ln(H/L)^2)/(4 n ln2)
GK var = mean(0.5 ln(H/L)^2 - (2 ln2 - 1) ln(C/O)^2)
RS var = mean(ln(H/C) ln(H/O) + ln(L/C) ln(L/O))
YZ var = var_o + k var_c + (1-k) RS; u = ln(O_t/C_{t-1}); c = ln(C_t/C_{t-1}); var_o = mean((u-ubar)^2); var_c = mean((c-cbar)^2); k = 0.34/(1.34 + (n+1)/(n-1))
vol = sqrt(var*AF); efficiency_e = var(CC rolling variance series, ddof=1)/var(e rolling variance series, ddof=1); CC = 1
steps: Load OHLCV; n_days; log returns diff(ln c); n_returns = n_days - 1; S0 = last close; ohlc_valid check -> calibration.json
Full-sample variances with n = n_days; vol = sqrt(var*AF) -> full_sample_vol.json keys cc_vol, parkinson_vol, garman_klass_vol, rogers_satchell_vol, yang_zhang_vol
Rolling: n_rolling = n_days - W; window i = days i..i+W-1 (W prices, W-1 returns); range terms via cumulative sums; k from W
Rolling vol series; per estimator mean_vol, std_vol (ddof=1), min_vol, max_vol, efficiency -> rolling_vol_stats.csv rows close_to_close, parkinson, garman_klass, rogers_satchell, yang_zhang
Term structure per stated window: cc_vol, yz_vol = sqrt(mean rolling var * AF) -> vol_term_structure.csv (window, cc_vol, yz_vol)
summary.json: n_rolling_windows, mean rolling vols, efficiencies, range_estimators_lower_variance, yz_most_efficient, vol_mean_range = [min, max] of full-sample vols
conventions: CC not demeaned; YZ overnight and close components demeaned
rolling YZ deviations about the full-sample mean, divided by W-1; RS term divided by W
efficiency compares rolling VARIANCE series (not vol), ddof=1
CSV estimator labels spelled-out snake_case; JSON keys abbreviated
pitfalls: mixing cc vs close_to_close vocabularies

title: Put-call parity forward bounds from bid/ask quotes with borrow audit
frame: DIKETAHUI: kuotasi opsi (quote_id, expiry_ts, strike, option_type, bid, ask, quote_age_sec), spot S dan quote_ts, carry (r, q, b_ref), aturan (max_quote_age_sec, violation_threshold). DITANYAKAN: pembersihan, pasangan call/put per (expiry, strike), batas forward sintetis, implied borrow, pelanggaran. RUMUS: T = detik(expiry - quote_ts)/(365*86400); DF = exp(-rT); F_bid = K + (C_bid - P_ask)/DF; F_ask = K + (C_ask - P_bid)/DF; F_mid = (F_bid + F_ask)/2; F_th = S exp((r - q - b_ref) T); b_impl = r - q - ln(F_mid/S)/T; V = max(F_bid - F_th, F_th - F_ask, 0). JAWAB: 1) flag one_sided (bid<=0 atau ask<=0), crossed (bid>=ask), stale (age > max) dengan presedensi; 2) clean = tanpa flag; inner join call x put; missing pair = beda simetris kunci; 3) sort expiry, strike; 4) hitung rumus; tipe forward_too_high/low jika V > thr; 5) CSV 6 desimal tetap, JSON bulat 6 desimal, id expiry|strike.
formulas: T = (expiry_ts - quote_ts).total_seconds()/(365*86400) (ACT/365 on seconds)
DF = exp(-rT); F_bid = K + (C_bid - P_ask)/DF; F_ask = K + (C_ask - P_bid)/DF; F_mid = (F_bid + F_ask)/2
F_th = S exp((r - q - b_ref) T); implied_borrow = r - q - ln(F_mid/S)/T
violation_amount = max(F_bid - F_th, F_th - F_ask, 0); forward_too_high if F_th < F_bid and V > thr; forward_too_low if F_th > F_ask and V > thr; else none
results: medians of F_mid and implied_borrow over matched pairs; worst_abs_violation = max V; parity_break_count = count(V > thr)
steps: Load spot.json, carry_inputs.json, audit_rules.json, option_quotes.csv
Flags on raw rows; counts with precedence one_sided, then crossed & ~one_sided, then stale & ~both
clean = no flag; split calls/puts; inner merge on (expiry_ts, strike); excluded_missing_pair_count = symmetric difference of clean call and put keys
time_to_expiry_years; sort by expiry_ts then numeric strike
Vectorised DF, synthetic_forward_bid/ask/mid, theoretical_forward, implied_borrow_rate, violation_amount, violation_type
parity_audit.csv all numerics (incl. strike) fixed 6 decimals; violations.csv = rows with V > threshold, same order
solution.json: exclusion_counts, matched_pair_ids (expiry|strike 6dp), checkpoint_forwards (id -> F_mid), worst_violation_pair (argmax V, first on ties)
results.json keys in stated order; quote_ts echoed with Z; numerics rounded 6 dp; ints as Python int
conventions: clean before pairing; each excluded row in exactly one bucket
bid bound = call BID and put ASK; ask bound = call ASK and put BID; divide by DF
borrow lowers the theoretical forward like a dividend; continuous compounding
strict > on the threshold; timestamps kept as original ISO strings
pitfalls: counting a zero-bid row in several buckets
date-only differences or 365.25 for T

title: OU with Poisson jumps via AR(1) on levels, 3-sigma jump split, moments, MC
frame: DIKETAHUI: deret level harian S_t (NaN dibuang), dt = 1/AF, daftar tau, jumlah path dan langkah MC, seed yang disebut. DITANYAKAN: kappa, theta, sigma_ou, lambda, mu_J, sigma_J, n_jumps, momen kondisional OU dan lompatan, momen stasioner, validasi MC, half-life. RUMUS: S_{t+1} = a + b S_t + e; kappa = -ln(b)/dt; theta = a/(1-b); sigma_ou = sd(e) sqrt(2 kappa/(1-b^2)); lompatan jika |e| > 3 sd(e); lambda = n_jump/(n dt); E_T = theta + (S0-theta) e^{-k tau}; Var_T = sigma^2 (1-e^{-2k tau})/(2k); E_jump = lambda mu_J (1-e^{-k tau})/k; Var_jump = lambda (mu_J^2+sigma_J^2)(1-e^{-2k tau})/(2k); stasioner: theta + lambda mu_J/k, (sigma^2 + lambda(mu_J^2+sigma_J^2))/(2k). JAWAB: 1) bersihkan, statistik ddof=1; 2) ar1_fit pada level, ou_from_ar1; 3) residual, deteksi lompatan, re-estimasi sigma dari residual non-lompatan; 4) momen per tau; 5) MC Euler berseed; 6) stasioner, half-life, tulis.
formulas: AR(1) on levels: kappa = -ln(b)/dt; theta = a/(1-b); sigma_ou = sd(e, ddof=1) sqrt(2 kappa/(1 - b^2))
jump if |e_t| > 3 sd(e, ddof=1); lambda = n_jumps/(n dt); mu_J = mean(jump e); sigma_J = sd(jump e, ddof=1) (0 if none); sigma_ou re-estimated from non-jump e
E[S_T] = theta + (S0 - theta) exp(-kappa tau); Var_ou = sigma_ou^2 (1 - exp(-2 kappa tau))/(2 kappa)
E_jump = lambda mu_J (1 - exp(-kappa tau))/kappa; Var_jump = lambda (mu_J^2 + sigma_J^2)(1 - exp(-2 kappa tau))/(2 kappa)
stationary: theta; sigma_ou^2/(2 kappa); theta + lambda mu_J/kappa; (sigma_ou^2 + lambda(mu_J^2 + sigma_J^2))/(2 kappa)
Euler: S += kappa(theta - S) dt + sigma_ou sqrt(dt) Z + Poisson(lambda dt) * Normal(mu_J, sigma_J); half_life_days = ln2/kappa * AF
steps: Take the stated column, dropna; S0 = last level; levels S_t = all but last; changes = diff; n_observations = len(changes); mean/std levels and changes (ddof=1)
qf_toolkit.ar1_fit(levels, add_const=True) -> a, phi, sigma_e; qf_toolkit.ou_from_ar1(a, phi, sigma_e, dt) -> kappa, theta, sigma
residuals = S_{t+1} - (a + b S_t); 3-sigma mask; n_jumps, lambda_jump, mu_J, sigma_J; sigma_ou from non-jump residuals; calibration.json
Per tau: E_ST_ou, Var_ST_ou, E_ST_jump, Var_ST_jump (jump contributions)
Seed RNG; Euler paths; mc_mean, mc_var (ddof=1) at step round(tau/dt); conditional_moments.csv columns tau, E_ST_ou, Var_ST_ou, E_ST_jump, Var_ST_jump, mc_mean, mc_var
stationary_distribution.json (empirical_mean, empirical_var ddof=1 of levels); summary.json with half_life_days, max_mc_mean_error, max_mc_var_error_pct, mc_validates
conventions: regress levels S_{t+1} on S_t, not changes; residual std ddof=1
E_ST_jump/Var_ST_jump hold jump CONTRIBUTIONS; MC compared with OU + jump totals
mc error = max |mc_mean - total mean| and max |mc_var - total var|/total var*100; mc_validates = both under the chosen tolerances
pitfalls: residual sd must be scaled by sqrt(2 kappa/(1 - b^2)) to get sigma_ou

title: PCA factor loadings and lstsq factor-neutral dollar-neutral hedge
frame: DIKETAHUI: tickers, monthly_returns per ticker, n_factors, target_weights w. DITANYAKAN: rasio varians dijelaskan, loadings PC, eksposur w, bobot lindung h, bobot netral, eksposur netral, Sharpe netral dan target. RUMUS: R (T x N) kolom per ticker; PCA(n_components=n_factors).fit(R); L = components_; exposure = L w; A = vstack(L, 1^T); b = append(-L w, 0); h = lstsq(A, b); w_n = w + h; Sharpe = mean(R w)/std(R w, ddof=1) sqrt(12). JAWAB: 1) susun R urutan tickers; 2) fit PCA pada R langsung; 3) exposure; 4) lstsq sistem teraugmentasi; 5) Sharpe netral dan target; 6) tulis JSON kunci PC1..PCk dan ticker, pembulatan sesuai tugas.
formulas: R[:, i] = monthly_returns[tickers[i]]; PCA(n_components=n_factors).fit(R); loadings = components_
target exposures = components_ @ w
A = vstack([components_, ones(1,N)]); b = append(-components_ @ w, 0); h = lstsq(A, b, rcond=None)[0]; w_neutral = w + h
Sharpe = mean(R @ w)/std(R @ w, ddof=1) * sqrt(12)
neutral exposures = components_ @ w_neutral
steps: Load params.json: tickers, monthly_returns, n_factors, target_weights (dict by ticker or list in ticker order)
R = column_stack in ticker order
Fit sklearn PCA; keep components_, explained_variance_ratio_
Target exposures, augmented lstsq hedge h, w_neutral
Sharpe for R @ w_neutral and R @ w

results.json: pca_explained_variance_ratio (4 dp), factor_loadings {PC1: {ticker: v}}, target_factor_exposures, hedge_weights, neutral_weights, neutral_factor_exposures (6 dp), portfolio_sharpe_neutral, portfolio_sharpe_target (4 dp)
conventions: sklearn PCA on the return matrix; no manual eigen-decomposition
std ddof=1; sqrt(12) for monthly data
keys PC1..PCk and ticker strings; floats as Python float

title: Polars 0.x to 1.x pipeline migration preserving every step output
frame: DIKETAHUI: pipeline_old(polars, INPUT_FILE, OUTPUT_DIR) pada API 0.x yang menulis step_k.csv; CSV pilot (timestamp, Open, High, Low, Close, Volume, ticker). DITANYAKAN: pipeline_new pada API 1.x dengan keluaran identik tanpa warning deprecation/inefficient map. RUMUS: pemetaan API lama -> baru (formulas); tiap step: baca, with_columns, select kolom eksplisit, write_csv OUTPUT_DIR/step_k.csv. JAWAB: 1) daftar tiap step dan kolom keluarannya; 2) ganti pemanggilan usang dengan padanan 1.x; 3) ganti apply/map_elements dengan ekspresi vektor; 4) pertahankan lazy (scan_csv ... collect) dan eager; 5) tulis dengan select kolom dan urutan sama; 6) jalankan pada pilot tanpa warning.
formulas: groupby -> group_by; groupby_dynamic(by=) -> group_by_dynamic(group_by=); pl.count() -> pl.len(); with_row_count -> with_row_index
melt(id_vars, value_vars) -> unpivot(index, on); pivot(columns=) -> pivot(on=, index=, values=); join how=outer -> full; join_nulls -> nulls_equal
str.strip -> str.strip_chars; str.ljust/rjust -> str.pad_end/pad_start(length, fill_char); str.strptime -> str.to_datetime(format)
map_dict -> replace_strict(mapping, default=); take -> gather; take_every -> gather_every; cumsum -> cum_sum; is_first -> is_first_distinct; is_not -> not_
suffix/prefix/keep_name -> name.suffix/prefix/keep; dtypes= -> schema_overrides=; lazy names via collect_schema().names(); pl.Utf8 -> pl.String
row-wise apply on booleans -> pl.any_horizontal; arithmetic apply -> column expressions
steps: Read the old function; enumerate every step, transformation and the exact output columns
Rewrite each deprecated call with its 1.x equivalent keeping argument semantics
Replace map_elements/apply with vectorised expressions (no inefficient-map or missing-return-dtype warnings)
Keep lazy steps lazy and eager steps eager; schema_overrides for typed scans
Write each step with an explicit select of the original columns in order; emit the version file if the old code did
Run on the pilot CSV with warnings as errors; compare file set and headers
conventions: signature pipeline_new(polars, INPUT_FILE, OUTPUT_DIR) using the passed module
no hard-coded results; every value from a transformation of INPUT_FILE
explicit select before write_csv for deterministic column order
pitfalls: full join renames the right key to key_right

title: Cross-venue binary-contract locked-edge backtest with cash allocation
frame: DIKETAHUI: market_pairs (review_status, close ts dua venue, resolution_ts, outcome), price_snapshots (pair_id, venue, status, canon_yes_price, canon_no_price, source_sequence), fees (bps per venue, min_edge_bps, max_contracts, capital_base, AF, funding_rate). DITANYAKAN: snapshot bersih dan sinkron, kandidat per ts, trade, ekuitas harian, metrik. RUMUS: cost_A = p_k_yes + p_p_no; cost_B = p_p_yes + p_k_no; fee = bps/1e4 harga leg; gross = 1 - cost; net = gross - fee_yes - fee_no; entry = cost + fee; qty = min(max, floor(cash/entry)); pnl = qty edge; equity = cash - kumulatif funding + sum qty terbuka; funding = reserved rate/AF. JAWAB: 1) approved; dedup max source_sequence; active; harga di (0,1); ts < cutoff = min(close_k, close_p, resolution); 2) sinkron = tepat 1 KALSHI + 1 POLYMARKET per (pair, ts); 3) per ts: lepas resolusi <= ts, evaluasi pair belum trade, urut (net desc, entry asc, pair asc), alokasi; 4) ekuitas harian dari trade pertama sampai resolusi terakhir; 5) metrik; tulis.
formulas: A: gross_cost = p_k_yes + p_p_no (kalshi fee on yes, poly on no); B: gross_cost = p_p_yes + p_k_no; fee_leg = venue_bps/1e4 * leg_price
gross_locked_edge = 1 - gross_cost; net_locked_edge = gross - fee_yes - fee_no; entry_cost_per_unit = gross_cost + total_fee
qty = min(max_contracts, floor(cash/entry)); open if net >= min_edge_bps/1e4 and qty >= 1; gross_pnl = qty*gross_edge; net_pnl = qty*net_edge
equity_t = cash - cumulative_funding + sum(open qty); daily_funding = reserved_entry_capital*funding_rate/AF; daily_pnl = diff(equity), first 0; cumulative_return = equity/capital_base
daily_return = pct_change(equity); ann_return = mean*AF; ann_vol = std(ddof=1)*sqrt(AF); sharpe = ret/vol; max_drawdown = max((peak-eq)/peak); capacity_utilization = mean(reserved/capital_base)
steps: Parse UTC; approved pairs; num_rejected_pairs = distinct pairs dropped; cutoff per pair = min(both close ts, resolution ts)
Snapshots of approved pairs; count (pair, venue, ts) groups with >1 row; keep max source_sequence; drop status != active (count); drop missing or non-(0,1) prices (count); drop ts >= cutoff (count)
Synchronized = (pair, ts) with exactly one KALSHI and one POLYMARKET row; p_k_yes, p_k_no, p_p_yes, p_p_no sorted by ts, pair_id
Direction metrics; best = higher net edge; ties on rounded values -> lexicographically smaller direction string; count ties

Per timestamp: release resolutions <= ts; evaluate never-traded pairs; below threshold -> BELOW_THRESHOLD/BELOW_MIN_EDGE with cash before = after = group-start cash; executables sorted (net desc, entry asc, pair asc); qty < 1 -> UNAFFORDABLE/INSUFFICIENT_CASH else OPENED/ALLOCATED_BY_EDGE_RANK
Trade log: fee_yes, fee_no, gross_cost, gross_pnl, net_pnl scaled by qty; entry cost and edges per unit; ISO Z timestamps; outcome upper-case
Daily loop from first trade date to last trade resolution: process groups, release, reserved = sum open entry costs, funding accumulated separately; equity row
results.json, solution.json: num_candidate_signals = opened + unaffordable; below-threshold and tie counts over evaluated candidates; total_funding_cost = last cumulative funding
conventions: funding never leaves the allocation cash; it enters only equity
compare and sort net edges rounded to about 10 dp so float noise does not reorder ties
never re-apply polarity; bid/ask unused; one trade per pair ever; cutoff only blocks openings
pitfalls: funding inside trading cash changes quantities and cash_before
last-bit differences reorder the allocation queue

title: Intraday RV signature, Bandi-Russell noise, corrected RV, bipower variation
frame: DIKETAHUI: mid intraday (timestamp, mid_price) beberapa hari, baris luar jam reguler, timestamp duplikat, menit hilang; frekuensi f yang disebut; AF. DITANYAKAN: RV_f, n_f per hari, varians noise per hari dan rata-ratanya, RV terkoreksi grid 5 menit, vol anualisasi, BV, ringkasan. RUMUS: offset = h*60 + m - menit_buka; subset: offset % f == 0; r = diff(ln p); RV_f = sum r^2; n_f = len(r); w2 = RV_1/(2 n_1); RV_5_corr = RV_5 - 2 n_5 w2_grand; ann_vol = sqrt(max(RV_5_corr,0) AF); BV = (pi/2) sum |r_i||r_{i-1}|; grand_ann_vol = sqrt(mean(RV_5_corr) AF). JAWAB: 1) parse; median per timestamp duplikat; filter RTH inklusif; sort; group tanggal; 2) RV_f, n_f; 3) noise per hari lalu rata-rata; 4) koreksi dengan rata-rata, jangan clip nilai tersimpan; 5) BV skala harian; 6) tulis JSON urut tanggal.
formulas: offset = hour*60 + minute - open_minute; keep offset % f == 0 (subset, no resampling)
r = diff(ln p_sub); RV_f = sum(r^2); n_f = len(r)
Bandi-Russell: w2 = RV_1min/(2 n_1min) per day; grand_mean_noise_var = mean over days
RV_5min_corrected = RV_5min - 2 n_5min grand_mean_noise_var (unclipped); RV_5min_ann_vol = sqrt(max(corrected,0) AF)
BV_5min = (pi/2) sum_{i>=2} |r_i||r_{i-1}|, daily scale, no n/(n-1) factor
grand_ann_vol = sqrt(mean_RV_5min_corrected * AF) with the raw mean
steps: Read CSV; to_datetime; groupby timestamp median of mid_price
Filter time-of-day in [open, close] inclusive (full time incl. seconds); sort; date = timestamp.date
Per date and f: subset prices, log returns, RV_f, n_f
noise_var_est per day; BV_5min from 5-minute returns
Grand mean noise; per day RV_5min_corrected and RV_5min_ann_vol
results.json: days chronological with date, RV_f/n_f, noise_var_est, BV_5min, RV_5min_corrected, RV_5min_ann_vol; summary num_days, grand_mean_noise_var, mean_RV_5min_corrected, grand_ann_vol
conventions: median dedup before the RTH filter; never forward-fill
correction uses the grand-mean noise, not the day's own
clip at zero only inside sqrt; stored values and their mean stay raw
RV and BV daily scale; only ann_vol fields annualised
pitfalls: adding a small-sample factor to BV

title: EMA trend CTA with EWMA vol sizing and GARCH composite-vol regimes
frame: DIKETAHUI: harga harian N aset; params fast_ema, slow_ema, vol_lookback, vol_target, max_leverage_per_asset L, risk_free_annual, n_assets, regime lo/hi pct, scale_low_vol, scale_high_vol; AF. DITANYAKAN: Sharpe statis vs dinamis, fraksi rezim, rata-rata vol komposit, metrik antara. RUMUS: r = diff(ln P); EMA: alpha = 2/(span+1), seed SMA di span-1; signal = sign(EMA_fast - EMA_slow); EWMA s2_0 = r_0^2, s2_t = a r_t^2 + (1-a) s2_{t-1}, vol = sqrt(AF s2); GARCH(1,1) per aset -> sigma harian desimal; comp = sqrt(mean_i sigma_i^2) sqrt(AF); ambang = percentile(comp, lo/hi); w = clip(signal (vol_target/n_assets scale)/vol, +-L), NaN -> 0; x_t = sum w_{t-1} r_t. JAWAB: 1) log return; 2) EMA, signal, EWMA vol; 3) GARCH, komposit, rezim low/mid/high; 4) jalankan statis (scale 1) dan dinamis; 5) metrik; 6) tulis.
formulas: EMA: alpha = 2/(span+1); EMA[span-1] = mean(P[:span]); EMA[t] = alpha P[t] + (1-alpha) EMA[t-1]; NaN before; signal = sign(fast - slow)
EWMA: a = 2/(lookback+1); s2[0] = r[0]^2; s2[t] = a r[t]^2 + (1-a) s2[t-1]; vol = sqrt(AF s2)
composite_t = sqrt(mean_i sigma_i,t^2) sqrt(AF); thresholds = np.percentile(composite, lo_pct/hi_pct); low if <= lo, high if >= hi, else mid
w_i,t = clip(signal*(vol_target/n_assets*scale_t)/ewma_vol, -L, L), NaN -> 0; scale = scale_low/1/scale_high by regime
x_t = sum_i w_i,t-1 r_i,t; ann_log = mean AF; ann_return = exp(ann_log) - 1; ann_vol = std(ddof=0) sqrt(AF); sharpe = (ann_log - rf)/ann_vol
wealth = exp(cumsum x); mdd = min(wealth/cummax - 1); calmar = ann_return/|mdd|; persistence = alpha + beta; long_run_var = omega/(1 - alpha - beta) daily decimal
steps: Load params and prices (parse dates, sort); log returns dropping first row; align series on return dates
Per asset: SMA-seeded EMAs on prices, signal restricted to return dates; EWMA annualised vol
Per asset: arch_model(r*100, mean=Constant, vol=GARCH, p=1, q=1, dist=normal).fit(disp=off); conditional_volatility/100; omega/1e4 for long-run variance; persistence
composite, percentile thresholds, regime labels, scale series
run(scale): weights, shift(1) at the portfolio-return step, metrics (ret, vol, sharpe, mdd, calmar)
results.json: dynamic_sharpe_ratio, sharpe_improvement = dynamic - static, regime_frac_high, composite_vol_mean; solution.json intermediates
conventions: RMS of variances, not mean of vols; target per asset = vol_target/n_assets
no extra lag on the regime; one shift of weights only
GARCH on returns x100 with constant mean, rescaled back
std ddof=0; improvement = difference
pitfalls: np.sign NaN in warm-up must become weight 0 after the division

title: Absorption-ratio regimes with regime-scaled inverse-vol parity and CVaR
frame: DIKETAHUI: return harian N saham dengan NaN tersebar; params rolling_window W, top_k k, ambang crisis dan risk-off, risk_budget per rezim, cvar_confidence, cvar_window, estimation_window_days; AF. DITANYAKAN: observasi valid, metrik strategi, VaR/CVaR historis, ringkasan rezim dan eigen. RUMUS: C_t = corrcoef(R[t-W+1..t]); ev desc; AR = sum(ev[:k])/sum(ev); MP = (1 + sqrt(N/W))^2; crisis jika AR > c, risk-off jika AR > ro, else risk-on; w = (1/sigma_i)/sum(1/sigma) budget[rezim], sigma = std jendela ddof=1; port_t = sum w_{t-1} r_t; ann = mean AF; vol = std ddof=1 sqrt(AF); MDD positif pada cumprod(1+r); q = quantile(tail, 1-conf); VaR = -q; CVaR = -mean(tail <= q). JAWAB: 1) sort, drop duplikat tanggal, numeric, drop baris NaN/inf -> n_valid; tail estimation_window_days; 2) rolling AR, eigen terbesar, rezim; 3) rebalance hari dagang terakhir tiap bulan dengan rezim; 4) backtest mulai hari setelah rebalance pertama; 5) metrik, VaR/CVaR dari cvar_window terakhir; tulis.
formulas: C_t = np.corrcoef(R[t-W+1:t+1], rowvar=False); eigvalsh descending; absorption_ratio = sum(top k)/sum(all)
mp_threshold = (1 + sqrt(N/W))^2 (diagnostic)
regime: crisis if AR > crisis_thr; risk-off if AR > risk_off_thr; else risk-on (strict >)
weights at rebalance t: inv = 1/std(R[t-W+1:t+1], ddof=1); w = inv/sum(inv)*risk_budget[regime_t]; applied from t+1
ann_return = mean(port)*AF; ann_vol = std(ddof=1)*sqrt(AF); sharpe = ret/vol; max_drawdown = max((peak-wealth)/peak), wealth = [1, cumprod(1+port)]
tail = last cvar_window returns; q = quantile(tail, 1 - confidence); var = -q; cvar = -mean(tail[tail <= q]); win_rate = mean(port > 0)
steps: Read returns; parse/sort dates; drop duplicate dates; numeric; inf -> NaN; dropna rows -> num_valid_observations
Keep the last estimation_window_days rows if set; R (T x N)
From t = W-1: rolling correlation, eigenvalues, absorption ratio, largest eigenvalue, regime; regime counts; mean/std(ddof=1) of AR
Rebalance = last trading day of each calendar month with a regime; inverse-vol weights scaled by risk_budget[regime]; record weights
Portfolio returns from the day after the first rebalance with the last set weights

Metrics, VaR/CVaR; results.json; solution.json intermediates (num_regime_observations, mp_threshold, mean/std_absorption_ratio, mean_largest_eigenvalue, regime counts, num_rebalances, mean_weight_stock_01, portfolio_var_99, cvar, win_rate)
conventions: NaN rows dropped, not zero-filled; n_valid counted before the window cut
windows inclusive of t; weights applied next day; backtest starts after the first rebalance
uninvested remainder earns zero; VaR, CVaR, MDD positive; mean_weight_stock_01 over rebalances
pitfalls: starting the backtest earlier than the first rebalance breaks the result

title: Fama-MacBeth residual vs raw momentum with NW t-stats and OOS quintile spreads
frame: DIKETAHUI: panel saham-bulan (identifier, date, target, kontrol, regresor momentum per model A/B/C), lag NW L, minimum observasi per bulan, indeks mulai OOS. DITANYAKAN: koefisien FM bulanan, rata-rata slope dan t NW model C, prediksi OOS expanding, kuintil Q1/Q5, IC, verdict. RUMUS: z = (x-mean)/std_ddof0 per bulan (std 0 -> 0); OLS y = a + z b; t_NW = mean(b_t)/sqrt(S/T), S = g0 + 2 sum_{l<=L} (1 - l/(L+1)) g_l, g_l = (1/T) sum e_t e_{t-l}; b_bar = mean koefisien bulan valid sebelumnya; pred = [1, z] b_bar; kuintil = rank*5 // n, lexsort (pred, identifier); spread = mean(y|Q5) - mean(y|Q1); IC = Spearman(pred, y). JAWAB: 1) parquet, n_input_rows, dedup, bulan terurut; 2) per model dan bulan: dropna, skip jika < minimum, z; 3) jika indeks >= start dan ada histori: prediksi, kuintil, spread, IC; 4) OLS, simpan; 5) rata-rata dan t NW; 6) verdict; tulis.
formulas: z per month = (x - mean)/std(ddof=0); std 0 -> 0; target raw
OLS with intercept via lstsq per valid month (n >= min obs after dropna of target and the model's regressors)
NW: e = b_t - mean; S = e.e/T + 2 sum_{l=1..L} (1 - l/(L+1)) (e[l:].e[:-l])/T; t = mean/sqrt(S/T)
OOS month index >= start: b_bar = mean of coefficient vectors from valid months strictly before; pred = [1, Z] b_bar
quintile = (rank*5)//n, rank from lexsort((identifier, pred)); spread = mean(y[Q5]) - mean(y[Q1]); IC = Pearson of ranks (NaN if constant)
residual_beats_raw = IC(B) > IC(A) and spread(B) > spread(A) and max|t_resid C| > max|t_raw C|
steps: Read parquet; n_input_rows; drop_duplicates (identifier, date) keep last; sort; months = sorted unique dates
For each model regressors = controls + momentum set; loop months in order
Per month dropna; skip below minimum; Z; Xd = [1, Z]
If index >= OOS start and history non-empty: pred, quintiles, spread row (date, model, n_assets, q1_count, q5_count, q1_return, q5_return, q5_minus_q1, ic) when Q1 and Q5 non-empty
Fit OLS, append to history; coefficient row with alpha and slopes (signals not in model -> NaN)
n_months_model_x = valid months; n_oos_months_model_x = spread rows; mean and NW t per momentum slope
fmb_results.json (task_id, nw_lag, counts, avg_beta_model_c_*, tstat_model_c_*, residual_beats_raw); CSVs sorted by date then model, na_rep empty
conventions: append the current month's regression only after predicting
empty cells literally empty, never nan or 0
NW textbook 1/T denominator, not statsmodels HAC
dates YYYY-MM-DD; stable sort
pitfalls: defensive edge-case code can alter counts

title: 10-K inline-XBRL and HTML table fact extraction with B minus A comparison
frame: DIKETAHUI: dua zip 10-K (A dan B) berisi .htm inline XBRL, glossary; daftar kunci dengan akhiran __inA, __inB, __BoverA. DITANYAKAN: fakta sampul (dei), nilai tabel badan (properti, margin, capex, segmen, arus kas, buyback, pinjaman, SBC, pejabat), selisih B - A numerik. RUMUS: nilai = angka pertama baris berlabel (tahun terbaru) x pengali unit tabel; EntityPublicFloat = teks x 10^scale; fuel_only = including - excluding; __BoverA = B - A. JAWAB: 1) buka zip, pilih .htm utama; 2) regex ix:nonNumeric/nonFraction untuk dei (DocumentType, kotak centang AnnualReport, PeriodEndDate -> ISO, RegistrantName, Security12bTitle join TradingSymbol via contextRef, PublicFloat); 3) HTML -> baris: hapus ix:header, -> newline, -> pipa, gabung baris lanjutan berawalan pipa; 4) anchor + label, ambil angka; kurung = negatif; 5) susun kunci, B - A; tulis.
formulas: table value = first numeric cell of the labelled row x table unit multiplier (thousands or millions)
EntityPublicFloat = float(text without commas) x 10^scale
Fuel_Only = Including_Fuel - Excluding_Fuel
__BoverA = B - A (int for ints; floats rounded to strip noise), numeric non-boolean fields only
parenthesised = negative; cells with only $, % or dash skipped
steps: Locate zips by accession prefix; read the main inline-XBRL .htm member

dei via regex on ix tags: DocumentType, EntityRegistrantName as filed; DocumentAnnualReport = ballot box checked; DocumentPeriodEndDate = nested fiscal-year-end text + following year -> YYYY-MM-DD; Security12bTitle per TradingSymbol on contextRef; EntityPublicFloat with scale
Flatten body: drop ix:header, row/paragraph closers -> newline, cell closers -> pipe, strip tags, unescape, merge wrapped pipe-leading lines
Properties after the LAST ITEM 2 PROPERTIES heading: total sq ft = second number of unit-count row x thousand; average = last number of a size row with 3 or 5 numbers
Margin table: Net sales, Gross profit percentage row, Operating income (millions); capex rows; segment Operating income after Including/Excluding Fuel anchors

Cash flow operating (positive) and investing (negative kept); repurchases (count, total x million, avg price float); short-term borrowings Variable rate and weighted rate = LAST number; SBC row; officer row with Corporate Affairs: name first cell, age last number
Assemble key__inA, key__inB, key__BoverA
