title: 8-K event classification, extraction and base x severity x liquidity alpha score
frame: DIKETAHUI: beberapa 8-K HTML, universe.csv (ticker, company_name, liquidity_bucket), params.json (konsensus per filing, base_scores, cap/denominator, pengali CEO/CFO, ambang dan pengali debt, pengali likuiditas, ambang long/short), helper html_to_text. DITANYAKAN: per filing ticker, event_date, event_type, item_numbers, skor, signal; agregat. RUMUS: midpoint = X jika 'X plus or minus p%', (A+B)/2 jika rentang; change = (mid - cons)/cons*100; score = base severity liquidity; severity guidance = 1 + min(|change|, cap)/denom; departure = pengali peran; debt = pengali besar jika amount >= ambang; long jika score >= thr_long, short jika <= thr_short, else hold. JAWAB: 1) HTML -> teks, normalisasi spasi; 2) ticker universe pertama sebagai kata utuh di sampul, fallback nama; 3) tanggal 'Date of Report: Month D, YYYY' -> ISO; 4) item 'Item X.XX' sebelum SIGNATURE, urut, pipa; 5) klasifikasi guidance (jika konsensus ada) -> departure -> debt; 6) skor, signal; 7) tulis.
formulas: midpoint: 'expected to be $X billion plus or minus p%' -> X; '$A to $B' -> (A+B)/2; billions x1000 -> millions; guidance_change_pct = (mid - consensus)/consensus*100
severity: guidance 1 + min(|change_pct|, cap)/denominator; departure multiplier by role; debt large multiplier if amount >= threshold else small
event_alpha_score = base_score[event]*severity*liquidity_multiplier[bucket]
signal = long if score >= long_threshold; short if <= short_threshold; else hold
results: mean score, long/short counts, top_long = ticker at argmax, top_short at argmin, net = sum, gross = sum|score|
steps: Import html_to_text from the data dir; convert; replace NBSP/replacement chars; collapse spaces
Ticker: first universe ticker as whole word in the cover text; fallback company-name match
event_date from the Date of Report line (case-insensitive) -> YYYY-MM-DD
item_numbers: lines starting Item d.dd before SIGNATURES; dedupe; sort numerically; pipe-join

Classify: guidance when consensus exists (sign decides raise/cut); else departure sentence (resign/step down/retire + title, CEO flag); else debt: issued $N principal minus included over-allotment, in millions
Score, signal; filing_signals.csv sorted by filing_id with the stated columns
results.json; solution.json intermediates (num per event type as float, guidance_change_pct_<id>, ceo_departure_flag_<id>, debt_amount_musd_<id>, mean multipliers, mean/net/gross)
conventions: extract dollar amounts line by line; never split sentences on '.'
debt = initial principal before greenshoe
numeric CSV columns as numbers; thresholds inclusive; all constants from params.json
pitfalls: two filings can share a ticker; pick top tickers by score

title: Lexicon sentiment momentum L/S with ex-ante vol target, IC and Jensen alpha
frame: DIKETAHUI: close harian per ticker, posts JSONL (timestamp, ticker, text, likes, retweets, replies), kata bullish/bearish, mkt_rf, params (lookback L, min posts, nl, ns, cost bps, engagement_weight, vol_target, VL, cap); AF. DITANYAKAN: posts valid, skor berbobot, return, Sharpe, MDD, IC, IC IR, alpha/beta. RUMUS: sent = #bullish - #bearish, token regex [a-z]+ lowercase; mult = 1 + ln(1 + likes + 2 retweets + 3 replies); final = sent mult; agg = sum final per tanggal kalender, reindex hari dagang, 0 jika kosong; sig = agg_t - mean(agg_{t-L..t-1}), NaN jika count < min; w = +-1/(nl+ns); scaler = min(target/sqrt(AF w'Sigma w), cap) jika t >= L+VL; strat_t = sum w_{t-1} r_t - cost_{t-1}; cost = sum|dw| bps/1e4. JAWAB: 1) pivot harga, pct_change; 2) filter likes >= 0; skor; 3) agregasi, sinyal; 4) bobot hanya hari dengan >= nl+ns sinyal valid; 5) vol target; 6) P&L dengan lag; metrik; IC sig_t vs r_{t+1}; OLS pada mkt_rf; tulis.
formulas: sentiment = count(tokens in bullish) - count(tokens in bearish), tokens = re.findall([a-z]+, lower(text)); final = sentiment*(1 + ln(1 + likes + 2 retweets + 3 replies)) when enabled
agg = sum of final by calendar date, reindexed to trading days, missing 0; signal = agg - shift(1).rolling(L).mean(); NaN where count < min posts
weights +1/(nl+ns) top nl, -1/(nl+ns) bottom ns, only days with >= nl+ns valid signals (stable sort)
vol target for i >= L+VL: Sigma = cov(last VL returns, ddof=1); pv = sqrt(max(w Sigma w,0) AF); w *= min(target/pv, cap)
turnover = sum|w_t - w_{t-1}| (first = sum|w_0|); cost = turnover*bps/1e4; strat_t = sum w_{t-1} r_t - cost_{t-1}, drop first

total = prod(1+strat)-1; ann = (1+total)^(AF/n)-1; sharpe = mean/std(ddof=1) sqrt(AF); mdd = max((peak-eq)/peak); IC_t = spearman(sig_t, r_{t+1}) on >= 3 tickers; ic_ir = mean/std(ddof=1); OLS strat = a + b mkt_rf; alpha_annualized = a AF
steps: Load params, lexicon sets (lower), prices pivot date x ticker, pct_change, trading days
Posts JSONL; num_posts; keep likes >= 0 -> num_valid_posts; sentiment, final; mean_weighted_score = mean of nonzero finals (num_scored_nonzero)
date = normalized timestamp; aggregate sum and counts by (date, ticker); reindex; fill 0
signal; mask by count; weight matrix per day
Ex-ante vol-target scaling with warm-up and cap
Turnover, cost; gross = (W.shift(1)*rets).sum; strat = gross - cost.shift(1), drop first; equity, total, annualized, sharpe, mdd, ann vol, win rate
IC series (finite only); mean_ic, std_ic (ddof=1), ic_ir
Inner join with mkt_rf; OLS lstsq; alpha_daily, beta, r_squared, alpha_tstat; results.json, solution.json
conventions: only likes < 0 invalid; weekend posts counted but not rolled into trading days
cost of the day-t rebalance hits the t+1 row with the t+1 return
covariance-based ex-ante vol; scaler capped
Sharpe ddof=1 sqrt(AF); MDD positive; annualized return geometric
pitfalls: tokeniser choice moves the backtest by tens of percent; keep regex [a-z]+

title: Long-only SMA golden/death-cross backtest, next-open execution, metrics
frame: DIKETAHUI: OHLCV harian dengan adj_close (sinyal/valuasi) dan adj_open (eksekusi); jendela SMA cepat w_f dan lambat w_s; modal awal C0; hari dagang per tahun A seperti ditetapkan tugas. DITANYAKAN: daftar trade, cumulative_return harian, metrik (total_return, final_capital, annualized_return, annualized_volatility, sharpe_ratio, max_drawdown, calmar_ratio, num_trades, win_rate, total_pnl, num_trading_days). RUMUS: diff_i = SMA_f,i - SMA_s,i; golden cross: diff_{i-1} <= 0 dan diff_i > 0; death cross: diff_{i-1} >= 0 dan diff_i < 0; eksekusi di adj_open_{i+1}; shares = floor(cash/px); V_t = cash + shares*adj_close_t; r_t = V_t/V_{t-1} - 1, r_1 = 0; cum = cumprod(1+r); MDD = max((runmax-cum)/runmax). JAWAB: 1) sort tanggal naik, SMA rolling mean. 2) loop hari, satu posisi, beli/jual di open hari berikutnya, posisi sisa ditutup di adj_close hari akhir. 3) V_t, r_t, cum_t. 4) ann_ret = mean(r)*A, ann_vol = std(r,ddof=1)*sqrt(A), sharpe = ann_ret/ann_vol, calmar = ann_ret/MDD. 5) tulis file.
formulas: SMA_t(w) = rolling(w).mean() of adj_close
cross_up_i = (SMA_f[i-1]-SMA_s[i-1] <= 0) and (SMA_f[i]-SMA_s[i] > 0); cross_down uses >= 0 then < 0
shares = floor(cash/adj_open[i+1]); pnl = shares*(sell_px - buy_px)
V_t = cash + shares*adj_close_t; r_t = (V_t - V_{t-1})/V_{t-1}, r_first = 0; cum_t = cumprod(1+r)
annualized_return = mean(r)*A; annualized_volatility = std(r, ddof=1)*sqrt(A); sharpe = ann_ret/ann_vol, rf = 0
max_drawdown = max((running_max(cum)-cum)/running_max(cum)); calmar = ann_ret/max_drawdown
total_return = (final_capital - C0)/C0; win_rate = #(pnl>0)/#SELL; total_pnl = sum(SELL pnl)
steps: Load price CSV with parse_dates, sort by date ascending, reset index.
Compute both SMAs on adj_close; signals only where both SMAs are non-NaN; initialise prev_diff from the first such day.
Walk days: on cross_up while flat and i+1 exists, buy floor(cash/adj_open[i+1]) shares; record BUY (signal_date = day i, exec_date = day i+1, price = adj_open[i+1], pnl empty).
On cross_down while holding, sell all at adj_open[i+1]; record SELL with pnl = shares*(px - buy_px) rounded 2 dp.
After loop, if holding: forced SELL at last adj_close, signal_date = exec_date = last date.
Portfolio value every day (warm-up days = cash) after that day's execution; r with first = 0; cumulative_return = cumprod(1+r) starting at 1.0.
Metrics per formulas; final_capital = ending cash; num_trades = #BUY rows; num_trading_days = #rows.

Write results.json nested under the ticker key; trades.csv columns ticker,type,signal_date,exec_date,price,shares,pnl; daily_portfolio.csv columns date,cumulative_return; plotly HTML line plus hline at 1.0 with the stated title/axis labels.
conventions: Signal from day i SMAs, execution at day i+1 adj_open; forced close at last adj_close
std ddof=1; annualise with the stated trading-day count; risk-free 0
dates YYYY-MM-DD; money rounded 2 dp; ratios raw floats; counts as int
Each BUY = one trade; pnl only on SELL rows (empty on BUY)
pitfalls: Never signal while an SMA is NaN
Daily value must exist for every row including warm-up

title: Hill and Smith (GPD-MLE) tail index across k with asymptotic CIs
frame: DIKETAHUI: harga penutupan harian P_t; himpunan nilai k; tingkat kepercayaan (z) seperti ditetapkan. DITANYAKAN: per k: xi_hill, se_hill, ci; xi_smith, sigma_smith, se_xi, ci; mean kedua estimator dan korelasi Pearson lintas k; best_k = k dengan se_xi terkecil; tail_is_heavy = mean_xi_smith > 0. RUMUS: X_t = -log(P_t/P_{t-1}); urutkan turun X_(1) >= X_(2) >= ...; ambang u_k = X_(k+1); Hill: xi = (1/k) sum_{i<=k} log X_(i) - log u_k, se = xi/sqrt(k); Smith: GPD MLE pada excess Y_i = X_(i) - u_k (i<=k) dengan lokasi 0 -> (xi, sigma); se_xi = (1+xi)/sqrt(k); CI = est -+ z*se. JAWAB: 1) sort tanggal, log-return, negasi, sort turun. 2) per k Hill + se + CI. 3) per k excess, genpareto.fit(floc=0), se_xi, CI. 4) mean dan np.corrcoef(xi_hill, xi_smith). 5) best_k = argmin se_xi; tulis empat file.
formulas: X_t = -log(P_t/P_{t-1}); sorted descending; threshold u_k = sorted[k] (0-based) = (k+1)-th largest
xi_hill(k) = mean(log(sorted[:k])) - log(u_k); se_hill = xi_hill/sqrt(k)
ci_lower, ci_upper = xi -+ z*se with z the two-sided normal quantile for the stated level
excess_k = sorted[:k] - u_k; (xi, loc=0, sigma) = scipy.stats.genpareto.fit(excess, floc=0)
se_xi = sqrt((1+xi)^2/k) when xi > -0.5 else NaN (asymptotic Fisher information)
correlation = Pearson corr of xi_hill and xi_smith over the k grid; tail_is_heavy = mean_xi_smith > 0
steps: Load CSV, parse date, sort ascending; prices = close; losses = -diff(log close).
Sort losses descending; assert n >= max(k)+1.
For each k: threshold = sorted[k]; Hill xi, se, CI; build hill_estimates.csv with columns k,xi_hill,se_hill,ci_lower,ci_upper.
For each k: excesses sorted[:k] - threshold; fit GPD with floc=0; shape = params[0], scale = params[2]; se_xi, CI; smith_estimates.csv columns k,xi_smith,sigma_smith,se_xi,ci_lower,ci_upper.
comparison.json: mean_xi_hill, mean_xi_smith, correlation (floats).
summary.json: best_k = int(k[argmin(se_xi)]), xi_hill_at_best_k, xi_smith_at_best_k, tail_is_heavy (bool).
conventions: Threshold is the (k+1)-th largest loss, index k in the 0-based descending array
Hill se = xi/sqrt(k); Smith se from (1+xi)/sqrt(k) passed the checker (observed-information inverse also acceptable)
Cast numpy scalars to float/int/bool before json.dump
One row per k, in the given k order
pitfalls: Using sorted[k+1] as threshold shifts every Smith estimate
GPD fit must fix loc = 0

title: Two-asset GBM calibration, Margrabe exchange and Kirk spread prices with MC check
frame: DIKETAHUI: dua seri harga harian; r, q1, q2 seperti ditetapkan; grid maturitas T, grid moneyness m, grid rho; jumlah path MC N; hari dagang A. DITANYAKAN: S1_0, S2_0, sigma1, sigma2, rho, n_returns; harga Margrabe per T dan sigma_exchange; harga Kirk per (T,K) dengan K = m*(S1_0+S2_0)/2 plus mc_price dan mc_std_err; sensitivitas rho pada K=0; ringkasan error maksimum. RUMUS: r_i = log(S_t/S_{t-1}) pada tanggal yang sinkron; sigma_i = std(r_i,ddof=1)*sqrt(A); rho = corr Pearson; sigma_ex = sqrt(s1^2+s2^2-2 rho s1 s2); Margrabe: d1 = [ln(S1/S2)+(q2-q1+sigma_ex^2/2)T]/(sigma_ex sqrt T), d2 = d1 - sigma_ex sqrt T, V = S1 e^{-q1T}N(d1) - S2 e^{-q2T}N(d2); Kirk: F_i = S_i e^{(r-q_i)T}, b = F2/(F2+K), sigma_K = sqrt(s1^2 - 2 rho s1 s2 b + s2^2 b^2), d1 = [ln(F1/(F2+K)) + sigma_K^2 T/2]/(sigma_K sqrt T), V = e^{-rT}[F1 N(d1) - (F2+K) N(d2)]. JAWAB: 1) inner-join tanggal, sort, log-return. 2) kalibrasi. 3) Margrabe per T. 4) Kirk per (T,K) + MC. 5) grid rho. 6) summary.
formulas: log-returns on inner-joined dates; sigma_i = std(r_i, ddof=1)*sqrt(A); rho = corrcoef(r1, r2); spots = last common close
sigma_exchange = sqrt(s1^2 + s2^2 - 2*rho*s1*s2)
Margrabe: d1 = (ln(S1/S2) + (q2 - q1 + 0.5*sig_ex^2)*T)/(sig_ex*sqrt(T)); d2 = d1 - sig_ex*sqrt(T); V = S1*e^{-q1 T}*N(d1) - S2*e^{-q2 T}*N(d2)
Kirk: F_i = S_i*e^{(r-q_i)T}; b = F2/(F2+K); sig_K = sqrt(s1^2 - 2*rho*s1*s2*b + (s2*b)^2); d1 = (ln(F1/(F2+K)) + 0.5*sig_K^2*T)/(sig_K*sqrt(T)); V = e^{-rT}*(F1*N(d1) - (F2+K)*N(d1 - sig_K*sqrt(T)))

MC: Z ~ N(0,I) @ L^T with L = cholesky([[1,rho],[rho,1]]); S_iT = S_i0*exp((r - q_i - 0.5*s_i^2)T + s_i*sqrt(T)*Z_i); price = mean(e^{-rT} max(S1T - S2T - K, 0)); std_err = std(disc payoff, ddof=1)/sqrt(N)
K = m*avg_spot, avg_spot = (S1_0 + S2_0)/2; mc_validates = max|Kirk - MC| <= 3*max(mc_std_err)
steps: Read both CSVs (qf_toolkit.read_table used), parse dates, sort, inner-merge on date keeping close columns.
Log-returns via log(close/close.shift(1)).dropna(); n_returns; mean/std/skew/excess kurtosis per stock; sigma_i, rho, spots; write calibration.json with S1_0,S2_0,sigma1,sigma2,rho,n_returns,D1,D2,r.
margrabe_prices.csv: rows per T with T,margrabe_price,sigma_exchange (qf_toolkit.margrabe_price available).

For each T draw one set of N correlated normals (fixed seed) and reuse across strikes; for each m compute K, Kirk price (qf_toolkit.kirk_spread_price_spot), mc_price, mc_std_err; kirk_prices.csv columns T,K,spread_moneyness,kirk_price,mc_price,mc_std_err sorted by T then K.
correlation_sensitivity.csv: for each rho in grid at the stated T and K = 0: rho_grid,margrabe_price,kirk_price_K0.

summary.json: sigma_exchange, max_mc_error_margrabe (K=0 rows), max_mc_error_kirk (all rows), mc_validates, rho_sensitivity_range = max - min Margrabe over rho grid, mean_kirk_price, margrabe at the stated T.
conventions: Inner join on date before returns; first row dropped
std ddof=1 and annualise by the stated trading-day count
Discount payoff before averaging; std_err uses ddof=1 over discounted payoffs
Margrabe at T and rho equals Kirk at K=0 at the same inputs; margrabe_prices row must equal correlation_sensitivity row at the calibrated rho
pitfalls: Negative K allowed only while F2 + K > 0
Use D1, D2, r exactly as given in calibration.json keys

title: Residualised-signal Fama-MacBeth alpha, beta-neutral turnover-capped long-short book
frame: DIKETAHUI: panel bulanan (identifier, date) dengan ret_lead1m, S sinyal, C kontrol termasuk beta; ambang N_min saham, lookback L bulan koefisien, ambang kesepakatan tanda M, fraksi leg f, cap turnover tau, biaya c per sisi, posisi bulan pertama P0 seperti ditetapkan. DITANYAKAN: hasil bulanan (gross/net return, turnover, beta/dollar exposure, gross leverage), ringkasan, koefisien bulan terakhir, bobot bulan terakhir. RUMUS: winsor pada persentil 1/99 dalam universe; resid_s = s - X b, b = pinv(X) s, X = [1, kontrol]; Z = (resid - mean)/std(ddof=0) (0 jika std 0); slope bulan m: pinv([1, Z]) ret; stable = median(36 slope) jika #sign sama >= M, else 0; alpha = Z stable; w_raw = +-1/n_leg; proj(w) = w - X(X'X)^+X'w, X = [1, beta]; w_tgt = proj/sum|proj|; turnover = 0.5 sum|w_tgt - w_prev|. JAWAB: 1) dedup, sort, universe per bulan. 2) Z panel, slope per bulan valid. 3) dari posisi P0: median/sign filter, alpha, rank desc tie id asc, leg top/bottom floor(f n). 4) proyeksi, normalisasi, cap turnover. 5) return, biaya, exposure. 6) ringkasan.
formulas: winsorised x = clip(x, percentile(x,1), percentile(x,99)) within the formation universe each month
residual: b = pinv([1, C]) @ s; Z = (r - mean r)/std(r, ddof=0), all 0 if std is 0 or NaN
slopes_m = pinv([1, Z_m]) @ ret_lead1m (rows with ret non-missing), valid if universe >= N_min and non-missing ret >= N_min
stable_j = median(last L slopes_j) if sum(sign(slopes_j) == sign(median)) >= M else 0; alpha = Z @ stable
projection: w - X @ pinv(X'X) @ X' @ w with X = [1, beta_raw] on the names involved; w_target = w_proj/sum|w_proj|

turnover = 0.5*sum|w_t - w_prev| on the union of names; if > tau: w_mid = w_prev + (tau/turnover)(w_tgt - w_prev), re-project, renormalise, if still > tau shrink linearly to exactly tau without renormalising
net = sum w ret_lead1m (missing -> 0) - c*sum|w - w_prev|; summary vol ddof=0, x12 and sqrt(12), MDD from wealth path starting at 1
steps: Read parquet (row count from metadata before dedup); identifier to int64; drop_duplicates(identifier,date, keep=last); sort by date then identifier (stable sort).
Per month: universe = rows with all signals and controls non-missing; winsorise; residualise each signal on intercept + controls via pinv; z-score ddof=0.
Per valid month regress ret_lead1m on intercept + residualised signals; store slopes.
From the stated first eligible position: take the last L valid coefficient months strictly before t (skip if fewer); median, sign-agreement count, stable coefficients; alpha.
Order np.lexsort((ids, -alpha)); n_long = n_short = floor(f*n), skip if below the stated minimum; w_raw equal weights; project with raw beta on selected names; normalise gross to 1 (skip if gross 0).
Turnover cap vs previous final weights aligned on the union; apply the cap branch and the final linear shrink.
Compute gross_return, transaction_cost (two-way sum), net_return, beta_exposure (raw beta), dollar_exposure, gross_leverage; append monthly row.
monthly_results.csv columns date,n_eligible,n_long,n_short,n_coeff_months_used,gross_return,transaction_cost,net_return,turnover,beta_exposure,dollar_exposure,gross_leverage.

summary.json keys exactly as listed incl. n_skipped_months = max(0, n_dates - first_pos) - n_tradable; coefficients_last_rebalance.csv signal order as listed; final_month_weights.csv sorted by final_weight desc then identifier asc, identifier cast to str only at write.
conventions: Integer identifier for all sorts and tie-breaks; string only at write time
Raw beta (not winsorised) for projection, exposure and the reported beta column
Population std (ddof=0) for z-scores and monthly vol; numpy default median
First tradable month always trips the cap, gross leverage ends below 1 by design
dates YYYY-MM-DD; no rounding; floats as Python float
pitfalls: Winsorised beta in the projection shifts returns in the 4th significant figure and breaks zero beta exposure
Do not renormalise after the final shrink

title: Five VaR/ES methods (HS, Normal, t, age-weighted, EWMA), 10-day scaling, Kupiec backtest
frame: DIKETAHUI: harga long-format (date, symbol, close) untuk dua aset; notional V; alpha {a}; lambda_age, lambda_ewma; horizon H; jendela minimum backtest W seperti ditetapkan. DITANYAKAN: ringkasan data; VaR$ dan ES$ 1-hari dan H-hari untuk lima metode; backtest HS alpha tinggi (exceedances, Kupiec p-value); metode paling/kurang konservatif, rentang VaR, vol EWMA tahunan. RUMUS: r_i = diff(log p_i); r_p = mean(r_1, r_2); HS: q = percentile(r_p, 100(1-a)), VaR = -q, ES = -mean(r <= q); Normal: VaR = -(mu + sd z_{1-a}), ES = -mu + sd phi(z)/(1-a); t: (nu, loc, scale) = t.fit, VaR = -(loc + scale t_q), ES = -loc + scale f(t_q)/(1-a) (nu + t_q^2)/(nu-1); age-weighted: w_i ~ lam^{n-i} dinormalkan, sort r naik, kumulatif, VaR = -r pada indeks pertama cumw >= 1-a, ES = -rata-rata berbobot sampai indeks itu; EWMA: S_t = lam S_{t-1} + (1-lam) r_t r_t', sd_p = sqrt(w'Sw), VaR/ES normal mean 0. JAWAB: 1) pivot, dropna, log-return. 2) 1-hari per metode. 3) H-hari: parametrik x sqrt(H), simulasi pada jumlah bergulir H hari. 4) backtest expanding. 5) summary.
formulas: r_i = log(p_i).diff().dropna() on inner-aligned dates; r_p = mean of the two log-returns; dollar = measure*V
HS: q = np.percentile(r, 100*(1-a)); VaR = -q; ES = -mean(r[r <= q])
Normal: z = norm.ppf(1-a); VaR = -(mu + sd*z); ES = -mu + sd*norm.pdf(z)/(1-a); sd ddof=1
StudentT: nu,loc,scale = t.fit(r); tq = t.ppf(1-a, nu); VaR = -(loc + scale*tq); ES = -loc + scale*t.pdf(tq,nu)/(1-a)*(nu + tq^2)/(nu-1)
AgeWeightedHS: w = lam^(n-1-i) normalised (newest largest); sort r ascending; k = searchsorted(cumsum(w), 1-a); VaR = -r_k; ES = -sum(r[:k+1] w[:k+1])/sum(w[:k+1])
EWMA: S = lam*S + (1-lam)*x x' over the sample (seeded with a short sample covariance); sd_p = sqrt(w' S w), w = equal weights; VaR/ES = normal with mu = 0; ewma_current_vol = sd_p*sqrt(A)
H-day: parametric methods x sqrt(H); HS and age-weighted on rolling(H).sum() of r_p
Kupiec: LR = -2[(T-x)ln(1-p) + x ln p - (T-x)ln(1-phat) - x ln phat], p-value = chi2.sf(LR, 1), 0 ln 0 = 0
steps: Read CSV, pivot_table(index=date, columns=symbol, values=close), sort index, keep both symbols, dropna; counts n_<sym> = unique dates per symbol, n_aligned = rows after dropna.
Log-returns matrix R, portfolio rp = R.mean(axis=1); data_summary.json with n_aligned, n_returns, portfolio_mean, portfolio_std (ddof=1), correlation.
Fit mu, sd, t params, EWMA covariance; for each alpha compute the five 1-day (VaR, ES) pairs; rows method,alpha,var_dollar,es_dollar in the stated method order; write var_1day.csv.
10-day rows with the same layout: scaled parametric, overlapping-sum HS and age-weighted; write var_10day.csv.

Backtest: for t from W to n-1, VaR_t = HS at the high alpha on rp[:t]; exceedance if -rp[t] > VaR_t; Kupiec p-value; backtest.json keys n_test_days,n_exceedances,exceedance_rate,expected_rate,kupiec_pvalue.
summary.json: most/least conservative = argmax/argmin of high-alpha 1-day var_dollar over methods; var_range_99 = [min, max]; ewma_current_vol.
conventions: Losses reported positive in dollars = measure times notional
Method labels exactly HS, Normal, StudentT, AgeWeightedHS, EWMA; alphas as given
Portfolio return is the simple average of the two log-returns, not log of the average
Normal method keeps the sample mean; EWMA method uses zero mean
pitfalls: Guard Kupiec log terms when x = 0 or x = T

title: Two-factor Heston characteristic-function pricing, IV surface, parity, Dupire local vol
frame: DIKETAHUI: S0, r, q; dua faktor varians (kappa_j, theta_j, sigma_j, rho_j, v_j0) seperti ditetapkan; grid K dan T; dua skema integrasi (quad pada batas/limit yang ditetapkan; Gauss-Legendre n titik pada [0, U]). DITANYAKAN: matriks harga call dan put, IV Black-Scholes, cek paritas, local vol Dupire pada strike interior, ringkasan. RUMUS: faktor independen -> phi(u) = exp(iu(ln S0 + (r-q)T) + sum_j [C_j + D_j v_j0]) dengan b = kappa - rho sigma iu, d = sqrt(b^2 + sigma^2(iu + u^2)), g = (b-d)/(b+d), e = exp(-dT), D = (b-d)/sigma^2 (1-e)/(1-ge), C = kappa theta/sigma^2 [(b-d)T - 2 ln((1-ge)/(1-g))]; P1 = 1/2 + 1/pi int Re[e^{-iu lnK} phi(u-i)/(iu phi(-i))]du, P2 = 1/2 + 1/pi int Re[e^{-iu lnK} phi(u)/(iu)]du; Call = S e^{-qT}P1 - K e^{-rT}P2; Put = K e^{-rT}(1-P2) - S e^{-qT}(1-P1); Dupire sigma^2 = (C_T + rK C_K)/(0.5 K^2 C_KK). JAWAB: 1) bandingkan skema pada T terpendek. 2) harga grid. 3) brentq IV. 4) paritas. 5) Dupire interior. 6) plot + summary.
formulas: per factor little-trap form: b = kappa - rho*sigma*i*u; d = sqrt(b^2 + sigma^2*(i*u + u^2)); g = (b-d)/(b+d); e = exp(-d*T); D = (b-d)/sigma^2*(1-e)/(1-g*e); C = kappa*theta/sigma^2*((b-d)*T - 2*log((1-g*e)/(1-g)))
phi(u) = exp(i*u*(ln S0 + (r-q)*T) + sum_j (C_j + D_j*v_j0))
P1 = 0.5 + (1/pi) int Re[exp(-i*u*lnK)*phi(u-i)/(i*u*phi(-i))] du; P2 = 0.5 + (1/pi) int Re[exp(-i*u*lnK)*phi(u)/(i*u)] du
call = S0*e^{-qT}*P1 - K*e^{-rT}*P2; put_direct = K*e^{-rT}*(1-P2) - S0*e^{-qT}*(1-P1); put_parity = call - S0*e^{-qT} + K*e^{-rT}
Gauss-Legendre: nodes,w = leggauss(n); eta = 0.5*(nodes+1)*U; w = 0.5*U*w; integral = w @ f(eta)
IV: brentq(bs_call(sig) - price, lo, hi, xtol as stated); NaN if no bracket

Dupire (q=0): sigma_loc^2 = (C_T + r*K*C_K)/(0.5*K^2*C_KK); C_T, C_K by np.gradient (central interior, one-sided edges); C_KK central second difference at interior strikes; den < 1e-15 -> NaN else sqrt(max(ratio, 1e-10))
steps: Define the characteristic function as a product over the independent variance factors; vectorise over u.

Price every strike at the shortest maturity with both quad and Gauss-Legendre; integration_comparison.csv with K,T,price_quad,price_gl,abs_diff plus a final metadata row K='chosen_method', T=<name>, other fields empty strings; choose gauss_legendre (full range, no negative deep-OTM prices).
Price the full call and put grids with the chosen method; option_prices.csv and put_prices.csv as matrices with index label K and maturity columns.
Invert Black-Scholes per cell with brentq inside the stated bracket; iv_surface.csv same layout.
put_parity_check.csv rows K,T,put_direct,put_parity,abs_diff for all grid points.
Dupire local vol on interior strikes only (rows K[1..n-2], all maturities); local_vol_surface.csv.
Plots: 3D IV surface with the stated title and axis labels; smile slices at the stated maturity indices with legend; 3D local vol surface.

summary.json: chosen_method, iv_min/max/mean (nan-aware), atm_iv at K nearest S0 and T nearest the stated value, skews = IV(K_min) - IV(K_max) at the two stated maturities, num_nan, put_parity_max_diff, local_vol_atm, local_vol_range.
conventions: Little-trap (Albrecher) form of C, D avoids complex-log branch jumps at long maturities
Direct put from the same P1, P2 so parity holds to machine precision
Matrix CSVs: rows strikes ascending with header K, columns maturities ascending
ATM = strike closest to S0 (interior strikes for local vol)
pitfalls: The symmetric pairwise-difference rule cannot pick a method; decide by integration range/sign evidence
Coarse maturity grid inflates short-dated wing local vol; expected

title: GARCH(1,1) vol, zero bond plus down-and-out call note, fair value, breakeven, delta-normal VaR/ES
frame: DIKETAHUI: log-return harian; parameter note: notional N, S0, K, barrier B, r, T, participation p; tingkat kepercayaan a; hari dagang A. DITANYAKAN: fair_value, markup_pct, note_var, note_es, breakeven_vol, garch_persistence, long_run_variance, garch_vol, bond_pv, option_unit_price, option_value, n_options, option_delta, note_delta plus intermediates. RUMUS: GARCH(1,1) zero-mean normal pada 100 r (arch), omega/1e4; pers = alpha + beta; LRV = omega/(1-pers); garch_vol = sqrt(A LRV); bond = N e^{-rT}; n_opt = p N/S0; opsi = down-and-out call analitik (B < S0): lambda = (r + s^2/2)/s^2, y = ln(B^2/(S K))/(s sqrt T) + lambda s sqrt T, c_di = S (B/S)^{2 lambda} N(y) - K e^{-rT} (B/S)^{2 lambda - 2} N(y - s sqrt T) jika B <= K, c_do = c_BS - c_di; fair = bond + n_opt c_do; markup = (N - fair)/N*100; breakeven: fair(s) = N; delta = diferensi sentral; note_delta = n_opt delta; VaR = z |note_delta| S0 s_d, ES = |note_delta| S0 s_d phi(z)/(1-a), s_d = garch_vol/sqrt(A). JAWAB: 1) fit GARCH. 2) bond, n_opt, opsi. 3) fair, markup, breakeven, delta. 4) VaR/ES. 5) tulis dua JSON.
formulas: arch_model(100*r, mean='Zero', vol='GARCH', p=1, q=1, dist='Normal'); omega = params[omega]/1e4; alpha, beta; persistence = alpha + beta; LRV = omega/(1 - persistence); garch_vol = sqrt(A*LRV)
bond_pv = N*exp(-r*T); n_options = participation*N/S0

c_BS = S N(d1) - K e^{-rT} N(d2); lambda = (r + 0.5 s^2)/s^2; y = ln(B^2/(S K))/(s sqrt T) + lambda s sqrt T; c_di = S (B/S)^{2 lambda} N(y) - K e^{-rT} (B/S)^{2 lambda - 2} N(y - s sqrt T) for B <= K; c_do = c_BS - c_di (0 if S <= B)
fair_value = bond_pv + n_options*c_do(garch_vol); markup_pct = (N - fair_value)/N*100; breakeven_vol: brentq(fair(s) - N, lo, hi)
option_delta = (c_do(S0+h) - c_do(S0-h))/(2h), h = S0*1e-4; note_delta = n_options*option_delta
sd_daily = garch_vol/sqrt(A); dollar = note_delta*S0*sd_daily; VaR = z_a*|dollar|; ES = |dollar|*phi(z_a)/(1-a)
steps: Load params.json and returns.csv; sort by date; numeric log_return array.
Fit GARCH(1,1) zero-mean normal on scaled returns; descale omega; persistence, long-run variance, annualised long-run vol used as the pricing vol.
Bond PV, number of options, analytic down-and-out call price at the pricing vol; option_value = n*price.
fair_value, markup_pct, breakeven vol by root-finding fair(s) = notional (NaN if no root), central-difference delta, note delta.
One-day delta-normal VaR and ES at the stated level.

results.json with all keys as floats; solution.json as {'intermediates': {name: {'value': v}}} using glossary term names (garch_omega, garch_alpha, garch_beta, persistence, LRV, vol, bond, option price/value, n_options, deltas).
conventions: Pricing vol = annualised long-run GARCH vol sqrt(A*omega/(1-alpha-beta))
Barrier below spot and strike -> down-and-out call via Reiner-Rubinstein, no dividends
markup measured against notional, may be negative
Delta-normal one-day VaR/ES with positive-loss sign; every float cast to Python float
pitfalls: Checker tolerance is roughly a few percent on results.json fields; a wrong vol choice (forecast vs long-run) fails

title: Dual-curve OIS discount and 3M LIBOR projection bootstrap, repricing, swap NPV and PV01
frame: DIKETAHUI: conventions.json (day count, frekuensi, interpolasi, kalender), kuotasi OIS, deposito, IRS 3M; spesifikasi swap (effective, maturity, notional, fixed_rate, pay_receive, bump pv01). DITANYAKAN: kurva OIS (DF, zero kontinu), kurva LIBOR (DF, zero, forward 3M), reprice setiap instrumen, NPV/PV legs/PV01 swap, ringkasan. RUMUS: OIS & deposito: D(T) = 1/(1 + r tau_ACT360); t = ACT/365.25; zero = -ln D/t; interpolasi DF log-linear dalam t, ekstrapolasi zero datar; F_j = (P_L(t_{j-1})/P_L(t_j) - 1)/tau_ACT360; fixed annuity A = sum tau_30/360 D_OIS(t_i) (semi-annual); float PV = sum tau_ACT360 F_j D_OIS(s_j) (quarterly); par = floatPV/A; NPV pay_fixed = float - fixed; PV01 = |NPV(bump zero LIBOR +b bp) - NPV|. JAWAB: 1) OIS dulu (closed form). 2) deposito closed form -> pilar LIBOR. 3) IRS berurutan: brentq pada DF LIBOR di maturitas agar par model = par input, diskonto OIS, proyeksi kurva LIBOR percobaan. 4) reprice semua. 5) nilai swap + PV01. 6) summary.
formulas: DF_OIS(T) = DF_dep(T) = 1/(1 + rate*ACT360(val, T)); t = ACT/365.25(val, T); zero_rate_continuous = -ln(DF)/t
log-linear DF interpolation in t: ln DF = (1-w) ln D0 + w ln D1; outside pillars DF = exp(-z_end*t) with z_end the nearest pillar zero
F_j = (DF_L(t_{j-1})/DF_L(t_j) - 1)/ACT360(t_{j-1}, t_j); forward_3m column uses pillar_date to pillar_date + 3 months
fixed annuity = sum_i 30/360(t_{i-1}, t_i)*DF_OIS(t_i) on the backward semi-annual schedule; float PV = sum_j ACT360*F_j*DF_OIS(s_j) on the backward quarterly schedule; par = floatPV/annuity
npv = float_leg_pv - fixed_leg_pv for pay_fixed (reverse for receive_fixed); fixed_leg_pv = N*fixed_rate*annuity; float_leg_pv = N*floatPV
PV01 = |npv_bumped - npv|, bump: ln DF_L -> ln DF_L - b*1e-4*t on LIBOR pillars only
steps: Read conventions.json and obey it; parse quote CSVs; spot date = valuation + spot lag business days on the stated calendar.
Bootstrap OIS pillars in closed form, sort by time; write ois_discount_curve.csv columns pillar_date,time_years,discount_factor,zero_rate_continuous.
Deposits in closed form become the first LIBOR pillars.

For each IRS in maturity order: brentq on the trial DF at maturity so model par (OIS discounting, trial LIBOR projection, schedules generated backward from maturity, unadjusted) equals the quote; append pillar.
libor_forward_curve.csv columns pillar_date,time_years,libor_discount_factor,zero_rate_continuous,forward_3m.
repriced_quotes.csv: instrument_type in {ois, deposit, irs_3m}, tenor_label, input_par_rate, model_par_rate, residual_bps = (model - input)*1e4.
swap_valuation.json: npv, fixed_leg_pv, float_leg_pv, pv01, pay_receive.
summary.json: OIS and LIBOR zeros at valuation + 60 and + 120 months via interpolation, libor_10y_par_swap_rate from the 10Y row maturity, max_bootstrap_residual_bps.
conventions: Build OIS before LIBOR; inside the root-finder discount with OIS and project with the trial LIBOR curve
Fixed leg 30/360 semi-annual, float leg ACT/360 quarterly, both discounted on OIS
First stub period starts at the effective/spot date; schedules backward, unadjusted
NPV sign follows pay_receive; only LIBOR zeros are bumped for PV01
Tight root tolerance so residuals are below 1e-6 bp
pitfalls: Templates often use the trial curve for both discounting and projection (single-curve) and ACT/360 on the fixed leg
Deriving spot date from the trade's effective date instead of the convention

title: Simulated-loss VaR/ES: analytic truth vs historical, normal, t and KDE estimators by RMSE
frame: DIKETAHUI: N sampel, seed, daftar distribusi dengan parameternya (normal baku; t dengan nu; campuran p N(0,1) + (1-p) N(0,s2^2)), level alpha {a}. DITANYAKAN: VaR/ES analitik per distribusi dan alpha; estimasi empat metode; RMSE per metode; metode terbaik per distribusi dan keseluruhan. RUMUS: kerugian = nilai sampel; VaR_a = F^{-1}(a); ES_a = (1/(1-a)) int_{VaR}^inf x f(x) dx. Normal(mu,s): VaR = mu + s z_a, ES = mu + s phi(z_a)/(1-a). t(nu) baku: VaR = t_nu^{-1}(a), ES = f_nu(q)/(1-a) (nu + q^2)/(nu - 1). Campuran: brentq pada p Phi(x) + (1-p) Phi(x/s2) = a; ES dengan quad. Historical: np.quantile(x, a), ES = mean(x >= VaR). Param normal: mean, std ddof=0. Param t: t.fit, VaR = loc + scale t_q, ES quad x f(x). KDE: gaussian_kde silverman, CDF pada grid, interp, ES integral ekor /(1-a). RMSE = sqrt(mean(err^2)). JAWAB: 1) satu RandomState, urutan draw tetap. 2) nilai benar. 3) 24 estimasi. 4) RMSE per metode. 5) terbaik = min(var_rmse + es_rmse).
formulas: rng = RandomState(seed); normal(0,1,N); standard_t(nu,N); u = uniform(N); mixture = where(u < p, normal(0,1,N), normal(0,s2,N)) with both full vectors drawn
Normal: VaR = z_a, ES = phi(z_a)/(1-a); Student-t: VaR = t.ppf(a,nu), ES = t.pdf(q,nu)*(nu + q^2)/((nu-1)*(1-a))
Mixture: VaR = brentq(p*Phi(x) + (1-p)*Phi(x/s2) - a, wide bracket); ES = quad(x*f_mix(x), VaR, inf)/(1-a)
historical: VaR = np.quantile(x, a) (linear); ES = mean(x[x >= VaR])
parametric_normal: mu = mean, s = std(ddof=0); VaR = mu + s*z_a; ES = mu + s*phi(z_a)/(1-a)
parametric_t: nu,loc,scale = t.fit(x); VaR = loc + scale*t.ppf(a,nu); ES = quad(x*t.pdf(x,nu,loc,scale), VaR, inf)/(1-a)
kernel_density: kde = gaussian_kde(x, bw_method='silverman'); CDF on a fine grid; VaR = interp(a, CDF, grid); ES = integral of x*kde(x) over [VaR, inf)/(1-a)
RMSE_method = sqrt(mean over (dist, alpha) of err^2) separately for VaR and ES; best = argmin(var_rmse + es_rmse)
steps: Create one RandomState(seed); draw samples in the listed order (normal, t, then mixture uniforms and both component vectors).
true_values.json: {dist: {str(alpha): {var, es}}} using closed forms and brentq/quad for the mixture.

For each distribution, method, alpha compute (var_estimate, es_estimate); estimates.csv columns distribution,method,alpha,var_estimate,es_estimate with the stated method and distribution names, row order distribution -> method -> alpha.
comparison.json: method_rmse {method: {var_rmse, es_rmse}} over all cells; best_method_per_distribution = argmin over methods of (RMSE_var + RMSE_es) computed over that distribution's alphas.
summary.json echoes n_samples, seed, alpha_levels, distributions, methods and overall_best_method = argmin(var_rmse + es_rmse).
conventions: Losses are the sample values (upper tail); no sign flip
ddof=0 for the MLE normal fit; alpha JSON keys are str(alpha)
ES integrals divided by (1-alpha), not by the integrated tail mass
Combined score = sum of the two RMSEs, not RMSE of stacked errors
quad is scipy.integrate.quad; trapezoid from numpy/scipy.integrate
pitfalls: Drawing only the selected mixture components or using default_rng changes every number
Forgetting the (nu + q^2)/(nu - 1) factor in the t ES

title: Clean OTM option chain, fair variance strike by trapezoidal log-contract replication
frame: DIKETAHUI: params (spot S, r, q, target_expiry, T, forward F, filter: min_volume, max_relative_spread, exclude_zero_bid), rantai opsi (expiry, strike, call/put bid/ask, volume); notional varians N_var dan skenario sigma_RV. DITANYAKAN: jumlah strike input/kept/put/call, K_var2, fair_vol, iv_atm, atm_var, premium, selisih vol, PnL skenario. RUMUS: mid = (bid+ask)/2; OTM = put jika K < F else call; keep jika volume >= v_min, otm_bid > 0, (otm_ask-otm_bid)/otm_mid <= s_max; IV per strike: BS(S,K,T,r,q,sigma) = otm_price (brentq); K_lo < F <= K_hi: w = (F-K_lo)/(K_hi-K_lo), iv_atm = (1-w) iv_lo + w iv_hi; dK_0 = K_1-K_0, dK_{n-1} = K_{n-1}-K_{n-2}, dK_i = (K_{i+1}-K_{i-1})/2; w_i = dK_i/K_i^2; K_var2 = (2 e^{rT}/T) sum w_i otm_price_i; fair_vol = sqrt(K_var2); VRP = K_var2 - atm_var; pnl = N_var (sigma_RV^2 - K_var2). JAWAB: 1) filter expiry target, mid, OTM, tiga filter, sort strike. 2) IV per strike. 3) ATM interpolasi. 4) replikasi. 5) skenario dan results.json.
formulas: call_mid = (call_bid + call_ask)/2; put_mid = (put_bid + put_ask)/2; otm_is_put = strike < F; otm_price/bid/ask from the OTM side; otm_mid = (otm_bid + otm_ask)/2
keep = (volume >= min_volume) & (otm_bid > 0) & ((otm_ask - otm_bid)/otm_mid <= max_relative_spread)
iv_strike = root of BS_price(kind, S, K, T, r, q, sigma) - otm_price (brentq, tight xtol); kind = put if otm_is_put else call
K_lo = last kept strike < F; K_hi = first kept strike >= F; w = (F - K_lo)/(K_hi - K_lo); iv_atm = (1-w)*iv_lo + w*iv_hi; atm_var = iv_atm^2
K_var2 = (2*exp(r*T)/T)*sum(w_i*otm_price_i); fair_vol = sqrt(K_var2); variance_risk_premium = K_var2 - atm_var; fair_vol_minus_atm_iv = fair_vol - iv_atm
scenario: realized_variance = sigma_RV^2; pnl = N_var*(realized_variance - K_var2)
steps: Load params.json and the chain; restrict to expiry == target_expiry; n_strikes_input = row count.
Compute mids, OTM side, otm_mid; apply the three filters; sort kept strikes ascending; n_strikes_kept, n_otm_puts_kept (strike < F), n_otm_calls_kept.
Implied vol per kept strike on the OTM price (qf_toolkit.implied_vol used; spot, not forward, as underlying).
Straddle the forward with kept strikes and interpolate iv linearly on strike; atm_var.
Trapezoidal weights on the non-uniform kept grid; K_var2, fair_vol, premium fields.

Scenario list with name, sigma_RV, realized_variance, pnl; write results.json with target_expiry, forward_price, counts, fair_variance_strike, fair_vol, iv_atm_forward, atm_var, variance_risk_premium, fair_vol_minus_atm_iv, scenarios.
conventions: Use the supplied forward; never recompute F
Spread filter uses the OTM side mid
Only the target expiry is used; other expiries ignored
Ints cast to int, floats to float; identities (atm_var = iv_atm^2 etc.) hold exactly
pitfalls: Uniform rectangle dK on a filtered grid gives a wrong K_var2
Using the other side's mid in the spread filter changes the kept set

title: Par-curve spline bootstrap, dated bond/FRN/callable analytics, KRD-PCA hedge, stale vs re-hedge
frame: DIKETAHUI: snapshot par yield Treasury pada dua tanggal; universe instrumen berdated (bullet, callable, FRN); jadwal liabilitas, kendala hedge (bound, target bucket, jumlah faktor), skenario stres; panel par yield harian. DITANYAKAN: kurva zero, analitik instrumen, KRD + eksposur PCA, bobot hedge awal, hedge stale vs re-hedge, hasil stres, ringkasan. RUMUS: g(T) = z(T) T; titik <= 6M: g = ln(1 + yT); knot lain: solve g_n agar par bond semi-annual (kupon y/2 pada 0.5,...,T) harga 100 dengan DF antar knot dari g linear; kurva harga = CubicSpline not-a-knot g melalui (0,0) dan knot; DF = e^{-g}; forward = g'(T). Harga dirty = sum CF DF(ACT/365); accrued 30/360 US (FRN: kupon*(v-last)/(next-last)); clean = dirty - AI. KRD_k = -(P+ - P-)/(2h P) dengan bump +-h hanya pada tenor par k lalu re-bootstrap; eksposur faktor = KRD . loading (tanda dibalik agar liabilitas positif). Objective = 10 sum gap KRD target^2 + sum gap faktor^2 + sum (error stres %)^2, SLSQP, sum w = 1, bounds. JAWAB: 1) kurva t0/t1. 2) analitik. 3) KRD, PCA. 4) hedge t0. 5) t1 stale + re-hedge. 6) stres + summary.
formulas: money-market knot (T <= 0.5): g = log1p(y*T); coupon knot: brentq on g_T so sum c_i exp(-interp(t_i, knots, g)) = 100 with c = 100 y/2 at t = 0.5..T
pricing curve: sp = CubicSpline([0, T...], [0, g...], bc_type='not-a-knot'); DF(t) = exp(-sp(t)); zero = g/T; forward = sp(T, 1)
fixed CFs: dates rolled back from maturity in 6M steps; t = ACT/365; AI = c*N*days30/360US(prev, v)/360; dirty = sum CF*DF(t); clean = dirty - AI
FRN between resets: coupon = N*last_reset_rate/freq; dirty = (N + coupon)*DF(t_next); AI = coupon*(v - last)/(next - last)
callable: dirty = min(noncall PV, PV of CFs to first call + call price); call_price_binding = truncated < noncall
eff dur = (P- - P+)/(2h P), convexity = (P+ + P- - 2P)/(h^2 P) with +-h parallel par bump and re-bootstrap; DV01 = D_eff*dirty*1e-4; KRD_k same with bump only at tenor k
PCA: eigh(cov(diff(par panel in decimals))), top 3 loadings; exposure = KRD vector @ loadings; flip loading sign so liability exposure > 0
stress error bps = (portfolio %chg - liability %chg)*1e4; twist linear in T between short and long bumps; curvature = wing + (belly - wing)*exp(-0.5((T - centre)/width)^2)
steps: Load snapshots, instruments, liability schedule, par panel; sort knots by maturity.
Bootstrap g sequentially (linear-g during bootstrap), build the not-a-knot spline for pricing; zero_curve CSVs with maturity,par_yield,zero_rate,discount_factor,forward_rate.

Price each instrument at t0 (dirty, accrued, clean), YTM (semi-annual on ACT/365 times, bisection), Macaulay = PV-weighted t, modified = Mac/(1 + y/2), effective duration/convexity, DV01; callable extras; FRN extras.

KRD per par tenor for every instrument and the liability by re-bootstrapping bumped par curves; PCA loadings from daily par changes; krd_factor_exposures_t0.csv with entity, KR_<tenor> columns, PC1..PC3, plus LIABILITY row.
Hedge t0: SLSQP from equal weights, weights sum to 1 within bounds, objective as in formulas; hedge_t0.json with weights, objective_value, target KRDs, factor exposures, stress_errors_bps.
t1: rebuild curve and exposures; stale = t0 weights on t1 exposures; re-hedge solved fresh (equal start and stale start, keep best); hedge_t1.json incl. improved_scenarios_count.
stress_results.json records for phases t0, t1_stale, t1_rehedged x every scenario with pv change pct and hedging_error_bps; summary.json gate booleans and all_checks_passed.
conventions: Sub-6M knots use simple accrual 1 + yT, not semi-annual compounding
Bootstrap with linear g between knots, then price with the spline (matches checker)
Continuous zero and forward rates in decimals; dates ISO; per-100 prices
Target-bucket KRD term weighted x10 relative to factor and stress terms
Key labels as strings 5.0, 10.0, 20.0
pitfalls: Spline-consistent or spline-during-bootstrap solves shift long zeros by bp
Judge root-finder convergence by residual, not scipy status

title: Annual par bootstrap, bond analytics, KRD immunisation, Svensson fit, spot-shift stress
frame: DIKETAHUI: par yield pada maturitas bulat 1..M (kupon tahunan), daftar obligasi (face, coupon, maturity), arus kas liabilitas, tenor KRD, interval brentq, titik awal Svensson, skenario stres (bp). DITANYAKAN: d(t), spot, forward; price, ytm, durasi, konveksitas, krd, z_spread per obligasi; PV/durasi/KRD liabilitas; alokasi dolar long-only yang mencocokkan PV, KRD_2, KRD_5; parameter Svensson + RMSE; PV terstres. RUMUS: d(n) = (1 - c_n sum_{i<n} d(i))/(1 + c_n); r(T) = -ln d/T; f(T) = ln(d(T-1)/d(T)), f(1) = r(1); P = sum CF d(t); YTM: sum CF/(1+y)^t = P; Mac = sum t CF d/P; Mod = Mac/(1+y); Conv = sum t(t+1) CF d/(P(1+y)^2); KRD_K: r(K) += 1bp, d = e^{-rt}, KRD = -(P_b - P)/(P 1bp); z: sum CF e^{-(r+z)t} = P; Svensson r(T) = b0 + b1 g1 + b2 (g1 - e^{-T/l1}) + b3 (g2 - e^{-T/l2}), g_i = (1-e^{-T/l_i})/(T/l_i). JAWAB: 1) bootstrap. 2) analitik per obligasi. 3) liabilitas. 4) SLSQP: sum x = PV_L, x.KRD_k/sum x = KRD_L,k. 5) L-BFGS-B multi-start min SSE. 6) stres pada spot.
formulas: d(n) = (1 - c_n*sum_{i<n} d(i))/(1 + c_n) (qf_toolkit.bootstrap_par freq=1); spot r(T) = -ln d(T)/T; forward f(T) = (r(T)T - r(T-1)(T-1))/1, f(1) = r(1)
price = sum CF_t d(t); ytm = brentq on sum CF/(1+y)^t - price over the stated interval (qf_toolkit.bond_ytm freq=1)
macaulay = sum t CF d(t)/P; modified = macaulay/(1 + ytm); convexity = sum t(t+1) CF d(t)/(P (1+ytm)^2) (qf_toolkit.duration_convexity)
KRD_K = -(P(r with r_K + 1bp, d = exp(-r t)) - P)/(P*1bp), one-sided; zero for streams with no flow at K
z_spread: brentq on sum CF exp(-(r(t) + z) t) - price over the stated interval
immunisation: minimise sum (x/PV_L)^2 s.t. sum x = PV_L, sum x KRD_k / sum x = KRD_L,k for the target tenors, x >= 0; units = x/price; portfolio KRD = x.KRD/sum x
Svensson r(T) = b0 + b1 g1 + b2 (g1 - e^{-T/l1}) + b3 (g2 - e^{-T/l2}); SSE vs bootstrapped spots; RMSE = sqrt(SSE/n)

stress: shift spot rates by bp (parallel; steepener linear from short to long; butterfly np.interp over key points), d = exp(-(r + shift) t), revalue fixed units and liability; change = stressed - base
steps: Read par_yields, bonds, liability (qf_toolkit.read_table/read_json); bootstrap d(1..M); spot and forward; discount_factors.csv columns maturity_years,discount_factor,spot_rate,forward_rate.

Per bond: annual CFs (coupon each year, face at maturity); price, ytm, durations, convexity, krd at the stated tenors, z_spread; bond_analytics.csv columns bond_id,price,ytm,macaulay_duration,modified_duration,convexity,krd_2,krd_5,krd_10,z_spread.
Liability PV, Macaulay, KRDs with the same machinery; liability_analytics.json keys pv_liability,macaulay_duration,krd_2,krd_5,krd_10.

SLSQP long-only dollar allocations with equality constraints on PV and the target KRDs (retry with looser ftol if needed); immunization_portfolio.json with per-bond units and dollar_allocation plus portfolio_pv and portfolio KRDs incl. the diagnostic tenor.
Svensson L-BFGS-B from the primary start plus alternates, keep lowest SSE; nelson_siegel.json beta_0..beta_3, lambda_1, lambda_2, rmse.
Stress scenarios on spot rates; stress_test.csv columns scenario,portfolio_pv,liability_pv,portfolio_pv_change,liability_pv_change.
conventions: Annual coupons, settlement on valuation date, no accrued
Continuous compounding for spot/forward output; annual compounding for ytm, modified duration, convexity
KRD is a one-sided +1bp point bump of the spot at the tenor only (not triangular)
Round to stated decimals only at write time
Parameter order [b0, b1, b2, b3, l1, l2] with b0, l1, l2 bounded positive
pitfalls: z_spread of a bond priced off the same curve is ~0; use it as a sanity check

title: Treasury par-yield spreads, PCA of daily changes, forwards, fixed-lambda Nelson-Siegel
frame: DIKETAHUI: panel harian par yield (persen) per tenor, tanggal MM/DD/YYYY urut terbaru dulu; daftar tenor untuk PCA/NS; pemetaan tenor ke tahun; lambda NS tetap dan tebakan awal seperti ditetapkan. DITANYAKAN: statistik spread (bp) + tanggal maksimum; eigen top 3, rasio varians, kumulatif, loading PC1; forward f(t1,t2); parameter NS + RMSE pada tanggal pertama/terakhir; tanggal dan perubahan 10Y harian terbesar. RUMUS: spread_bp = (y_a - y_b)*100; butterfly = 2 y_5 - y_2 - y_10; dy = diff(y)*100 (bp) setelah sort naik; C = cov(dy, ddof=1); eigh, urut turun; flip PC1 jika sum < 0; ratio = eig/sum(eig); f(t1,t2) = (y2 t2 - y1 t1)/(t2 - t1); NS: y = b0 + b1 g + b2 (g - e^{-x}), x = tau/lambda, g = (1-e^{-x})/x; RMSE = sqrt(mean(res^2)). JAWAB: 1) parse tanggal, sort naik. 2) spread mean/std(ddof=1)/idxmax. 3) PCA. 4) forward dari baris terakhir. 5) least_squares NS per tanggal. 6) argmax |diff 10Y|, tanggal = hari kedua pasangan.
formulas: spread_2s10s_bp = (y10 - y2)*100; butterfly_bp = (2*y5 - y2 - y10)*100; term_premium_bp = (y30 - y3m)*100; std with ddof=1
dy = yields[tenors].diff().dropna()*100 (bp); cov = np.cov(dy, rowvar=False, ddof=1); eigenvalues, eigenvectors = eigh(cov) sorted descending
pc1 = eigvec[:,0]; if sum(pc1) < 0: pc1 = -pc1; explained = eig/sum(eig); cumulative_top3 = sum(explained[:3])
f(t1,t2) = (y(t2)*t2 - y(t1)*t1)/(t2 - t1) with yields in percent on the last date
NS: x = tau/lambda; g = (1 - exp(-x))/x; y_hat = b0 + b1*g + b2*(g - exp(-x)); least_squares(residuals, x0) with fixed lambda; rmse = sqrt(mean(residual^2))
max move: d = y10.diff().dropna()*100; idx = argmax |d|; change_bp = d[idx], date = date at idx
steps: Read CSV; parse Date with the stated format; sort ascending; reset index.
Spread series in bp; mean, std (ddof=1), idxmax date formatted YYYY-MM-DD, max value.
PCA on the covariance of daily bp changes for the listed tenors; top-3 eigenvalues, ratios, cumulative, signed PC1 loadings as a list of floats.
Forward rates from the last row with the stated tenor-to-year mapping.
Nelson-Siegel fit per stated date with least_squares from the stated initial guess; betas and rmse_pct.
Largest absolute 10Y daily change: signed change and its date; assemble nested results.json with the stated keys.
conventions: All spreads and changes in basis points = percent*100
Covariance PCA (not correlation) with ddof=1; eigh then sort descending
PC1 sign flipped so the loading sum is positive
Dates written YYYY-MM-DD; floats via float()
pitfalls: Data arrives newest-first; sort before differencing
The max-move date is the later day of the pair

title: Sequential par-rate bootstrap to continuous zeros with linear zero interpolation and forwards
frame: DIKETAHUI: maturitas T_n (tahun), par rate c_n, frekuensi kupon f. DITANYAKAN: zero_rates, discount_factors, forward_rates per maturitas (kunci string maturitas, dibulatkan sesuai instruksi). RUMUS: tanggal kupon t_k = k/f, k = 1..T_n f; paritas: 1 = (c/f) sum_{k<T f} df(t_k) + (1 + c/f) df(T); closed form df(T) = (1 - (c/f) sum df(t_k))/(1 + c/f) jika semua t_k lebih awal sudah diketahui; z(T) = -ln df/T; df(t) antar pilar = exp(-z(t) t) dengan z linear antara pilar; jika ada t_k di celah antara pilar terakhir dan T_n, z(t_k) bergantung z(T_n): selesaikan z(T_n) dengan brentq agar harga par = 1; fwd(T) = (z(T) T - z(T_prev) T_prev)/(T - T_prev), fwd pilar pertama = z. JAWAB: 1) sort maturitas. 2) per maturitas: hitung jumlah kupon = round(T f); df pada tanggal kupon via pilar/interp; closed form atau root-find. 3) simpan df, z. 4) forward. 5) bulatkan dan tulis.
formulas: coupon dates t_k = k/f, k = 1..round(T*f); par: 1 = (c/f)*sum_{k<Tf} df(t_k) + (1 + c/f)*df(T)
closed form when all earlier t_k are known: df(T) = (1 - (c/f)*sum df(t_k))/(1 + c/f)
z(T) = -ln df(T)/T; df(t) = exp(-z(t) t); z(t) = z_lo + (z_hi - z_lo)(t - t_lo)/(t_hi - t_lo)
gap case: solve z(T_n) by brentq so the par bond prices to 1 with z interpolated between (T_{n-1}, z_{n-1}) and (T_n, z_n)
fwd(T_n) = (z(T_n) T_n - z(T_prev) T_prev)/(T_n - T_prev); fwd(first) = z(first)
steps: Load curve_data.json: maturities, par_rates, coupon_freq; sort maturities with their rates.
For each maturity in order: enumerate coupon dates by years*frequency; df at known pillars directly, between pillars by linear zero interpolation, before the first pillar flat.
If every earlier coupon date is resolvable use the closed form; otherwise root-find the new pillar zero so the par identity holds.
Store df and z; after all pillars compute forwards between consecutive pillars.
Verify every par bond reprices to 1 with the same interpolation; write results.json with zero_rates, discount_factors, forward_rates keyed by str(maturity), rounded as instructed.
conventions: Interpolate linearly in zero rate (not df or log df); continuous compounding for outputs
Coupon count = maturity in years times frequency, never the list index
Keys are str(maturity) so integer maturities give '1', '2'; rounding at output only
Forward uses the previous pillar, not T-1, when pillars are not consecutive
pitfalls: Counting coupons by list position silently drops coupons on gapped grids
Flat-extrapolating the last df into a gap instead of interpolating toward the pillar being solved
